title: T-ROC Global Launches Retail360, Transforming Retail Execution with AI
content_encoded_text: T-ROC Global has unveiled Retail360, a cutting-edge AI-powered platform set to revolutionize in-store performance by integrating artificial intelligence, machine learning, and real-time data analytics. This proprietary ecosystem, developed entirely in-house, comprises six core AI-driven solutions: Optinomics, WorkLink, NextStop, VisionIQ, SmartPix, and Navigator, each designed to streamline the retail execution process from planning to post-visit analysis. Brian Kava, President of T-ROC Global, emphasized the transformative potential of Retail360, stating it represents the convergence of artificial intelligence with tangible retail impact, enabling every store visit to become an opportunity for growth. The platform's ability to provide clarity, consistency, and control across numerous retail locations sets it apart from traditional retail execution tools. A notable success story involves a global electronics brand that leveraged Retail360 to identify and rectify execution issues across its retail footprint. The platform uncovered nearly 30% of store visits had undetected problems, such as shelf irregularities and unauthorized pricing changes, demonstrating its capacity to convert retail chaos into actionable, data-driven strategies. Retail360's forward-looking approach aims to redefine retail execution by enhancing predictive analytics, resource allocation, and shopper engagement. With its emphasis on smarter tasking and autonomous insight loops, the platform is poised to make the future of retail more resilient and less reactive to unforeseen challenges. title: Annovis Bio Inc. Secures 18-Month NYSE Compliance Extension
content_encoded_text: Annovis Bio Inc. (NYSE: ANVS), a clinical-stage platform company focused on developing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, has successfully secured an 18-month compliance extension from the New York Stock Exchange. This extension, effective from March 26, 2025, allows the company additional time to meet the NYSE's minimum market capitalization and stockholders' equity requirements. The approval of Annovis Bio's compliance plan ensures that its shares will continue to be listed and traded on the NYSE, contingent upon the company meeting specified milestones and adhering to other listing standards during this period. The NYSE's decision underscores a significant vote of confidence in Annovis Bio's strategic direction and its commitment to addressing the complex challenges of neurodegeneration. The company's innovative approach targets multiple neurotoxic proteins simultaneously, aiming to halt or reverse the progression of debilitating diseases. This compliance extension has no immediate impact on Annovis Bio's operational activities or its obligations to report to the Securities and Exchange Commission, allowing the company to remain focused on its research and development efforts. For further details on Annovis Bio's compliance plan and its implications for investors and the broader medical community, the full press release can be accessed here . This development is particularly noteworthy for stakeholders in the biotech and pharmaceutical sectors, as it highlights the potential for Annovis Bio's therapies to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients suffering from neurodegenerative diseases. title: Nicola Mining Inc. Launches AI-Enhanced Drill Program at New Craigmont Copper Project
content_encoded_text: Nicola Mining Inc. (TSX.V: NIM) (FSE: HLIA) (OTCQB: HUSIF) has commenced its 2025 diamond drilling campaign at the New Craigmont Copper Project, located near Merritt, British Columbia. This ambitious program aims to drill between 4,000 and 5,000 meters across five priority zones, including two new targets identified through a partnership with ALS Geoanalytics (GoldSpot Discoveries Ltd.), leveraging artificial intelligence to enhance exploration efforts. The primary objective is to delineate porphyry-style copper mineralization and further explore key areas such as MARB, CAS, West Craigmont/WP, and the newly discovered Draken prospect. The drilling campaign, with an estimated budget of $1.5 to $2 million, is scheduled to continue through September. It incorporates advanced data collection techniques, including portable X-ray fluorescence (pXRF) and short-wave infrared (SWIR) spectroscopy, to refine geological models and support future exploration strategies. These methods are expected to provide valuable insights into the mineral composition and potential of the New Craigmont Project, which spans 10,913 hectares along the southern end of the Guichon Batholith, adjacent to Highland Valley Copper, Canada's largest copper mine. Nicola Mining Inc. holds a 100% ownership of the New Craigmont Project, a high-grade copper property, and the Treasure Mountain Property, which includes over 2,200 hectares of mineral claims and leases. The company also operates a fully permitted mill and tailings facility near Merritt, capable of processing both gold and silver mill feed through gravity and flotation processes. This drilling program represents a significant step forward in the company's exploration efforts, potentially unlocking new copper resources and contributing to the local and national mining sectors. title: HeartBeam Inc. Receives FDA Clearance for Innovative Cable-Free ECG System
content_encoded_text: HeartBeam Inc. (NASDAQ: BEAT) has reached a significant milestone with the FDA 510(k) clearance of its innovative ECG system, a compact, cable-free device designed for arrhythmia detection. This clearance not only validates the system's safety and efficacy but also paves the way for HeartBeam to revolutionize remote cardiac care by enabling patients to record and share ECGs from anywhere. The device, which is about the size of a credit card, allows patients to use an app-guided system to record a 30-second ECG. This recording is then automatically uploaded to the cloud for physician review, facilitating timely and informed medical decisions. The company's upcoming Early Access Program aims to involve early adopters and healthcare providers in the initial phase before the system's broader market release. This regulatory achievement is a stepping stone for HeartBeam's future innovations, including the development of a 12-lead ECG synthesis, AI-based arrhythmia detection, and remote heart attack risk scoring. These advancements are part of HeartBeam's broader vision to transform cardiac care by providing continuous, predictive insights outside traditional clinical settings, thereby improving patient outcomes and accessibility to care. This financial endeavor underscores the company's commitment to expanding its footprint in the global cybersecurity market, offering Swiss-hosted solutions for secure communications and data management. Sekur's product lineup includes encrypted emails, secure messengers, and other communication tools, catering to a diverse clientele ranging from individual consumers to businesses and governments worldwide. The implications of this private placement are significant for Sekur Private Data Ltd. as it seeks to enhance its market presence and compete more effectively in the rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape. By securing additional funding, the company is better positioned to innovate and meet the growing demand for privacy-focused communication solutions. This development not only highlights Sekur's growth trajectory but also reflects the increasing importance of cybersecurity in today's digital age, where data privacy and security have become paramount concerns for users across the globe. content_encoded_text: Peapack-Gladstone Financial Corporation and Peapack Private Bank & Trust have announced the addition of Blerina Limaj to their team as Senior Managing Director and Group Director, marking a significant step in strengthening their commercial banking services in New York. Stern School of Business and a Bachelor of Science in Business Management and Finance from Brooklyn College, Limaj's academic background complements her professional achievements. Her appointment is a testament to Peapack Private's commitment to enhancing its commercial banking and wealth management services, aiming to provide innovative solutions to its clients. This strategic hire underscores Peapack Private's focus on leveraging seasoned professionals to expand its footprint in the competitive New York banking sector. Limaj's track record of leading high-performing teams and her expertise in treasury and cash management services, trade finance, and commercial lending will be invaluable as the bank seeks to grow its commercial banking division and strengthen its client relationships. title: Rising Temperatures Pose Increased Heart Risks, Warns American Heart Association
content_encoded_text: The American Heart Association has issued a warning about the increased risk of heart-related deaths due to the extreme heat sweeping across the U.S., with forecasts predicting record-breaking temperatures in the Northeast and Midwest. According to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, over 1,200 Americans die annually from extreme heat, a number that is expected to rise significantly, especially among those with cardiovascular diseases. A study published in the American Heart Association's journal, Circulation, suggests that deaths from cardiovascular diseases related to extreme heat could more than double in the next two decades. The heat and dehydration force the heart to work harder, which can be particularly dangerous for individuals with pre-existing heart conditions and the elderly. Certain medications prescribed for heart conditions may also exacerbate the body's reaction to heat, making it crucial for those on such medications to take extra precautions during heatwaves. The Association recommends several strategies to mitigate the risks during hot weather, including avoiding outdoor activities during peak sun hours, wearing appropriate clothing, staying hydrated, and recognizing the signs of heat exhaustion and heat stroke. Symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and nausea should not be ignored, as they can escalate to more severe conditions requiring immediate medical attention. Despite the risks, maintaining physical activity is important, with suggestions to adjust exercise times to cooler parts of the day or find indoor alternatives. The American Heart Association emphasizes the importance of being informed and prepared to protect heart health during the summer months. title: ESGold Corp. Advances Montauban Project with New Technical Milestones
content_encoded_text: ESGold Corp. (CSE: ESAU) (OTCQB: ESAUF) has announced notable advancements in the construction and technical development of its Montauban Project in Quebec, a pre-production gold and silver operation. The installation of Humphrey Spirals, a critical component of the gravity separation system, has been completed, enabling the processing of historical tailings at a capacity of up to 1,000 tonnes per day. This development is a key step in establishing the project's future output capacity. The company has also finalized its Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA), focusing exclusively on tailings material, with further updates and data releases expected in the near future. Concurrently, spiral circuit concentrate testing is underway, with results anticipated to guide optimization strategies for recovery rates and reagent efficiency. These efforts are part of ESGold's broader strategy to leverage the current high price of gold, offering a potentially lower-cost entry into gold exposure with higher returns. In addition to these operational milestones, ESGold is developing a comprehensive 3D geological model based on seismic and historical data, further enhancing the project's technical foundation. The company's progress at the Montauban Project underscores its commitment to advancing towards operational viability, with significant implications for investors and the mining sector at large. The rapid adoption of robotics in healthcare underscores the industry's commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technology to improve patient care. As these technologies continue to evolve, their impact on healthcare delivery and insurance models is expected to grow, marking a significant milestone in the intersection of technology and medicine. title: Walmart and Free Rein Coffee Honor Veterans and U.S. Manufacturing on Capitol Hill
content_encoded_text: Walmart and Free Rein Coffee, co-founded by actor and veteran advocate Cole Hauser, recently hosted a coffee giveaway event on Capitol Hill to honor veterans and spotlight Walmart's dedication to American-made products. The event, part of Walmart's annual U.S. Manufacturing Fly-In, took place at the Capitol Complex, offering veterans complimentary coffee from Free Rein Coffee, a brand deeply connected to the veteran community. Cole Hauser, known for his role in the TV series Yellowstone, personally served coffee to veterans, expressing his passion for supporting veterans, first responders, and other essential workers. Melody Richard, SVP of Merchandising at Walmart, reiterated the company's commitment to U.S. manufacturing, noting Walmart's goal to invest $350 billion in American-made products by 2021, with over two-thirds of Walmart's inventory sourced from the U.S. The event also featured remarks from Sean Corrigan, a retired Colonel and Executive Vice President of the Special Operations Warrior Foundation, and Rye Barcott, a U.S. Marine veteran and CEO of With Honor, both praising Walmart and Free Rein Coffee for their support of veterans and American manufacturing. Walmart's annual fly-in event underscores its 40-year legacy in American manufacturing, with this year's gathering including meetings with lawmakers to discuss further commitments to U.S.-made products. In addition to the coffee giveaway, Walmart announced the opening of applications for its 12th annual Open Call, a pitch event for U.S. entrepreneurs to showcase their products to Walmart leaders. This initiative reflects Walmart's ongoing efforts to support small businesses and American manufacturing, with 15 entrepreneurs from the greater DMV area invited to participate in this year's Open Call event at Walmart's headquarters. title: Thompson Thrift Unveils The Hadley, a Luxury For-Rent Villa Community in North Port, Florida
content_encoded_text: Thompson Thrift, a nationally recognized real estate company, has officially opened The Hadley, a new 268-unit luxury for-rent villa community in North Port, Florida. This development introduces a refined housing option to the area, catering to those seeking upscale comfort and convenience. The community, located at 3000 S Sumter Blvd., features single-story layouts with private entrances and upscale finishes, designed to offer the comfort and privacy of a single-family residence. The Hadley boasts a variety of amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, resort-style swimming pool, community grilling areas, and a pet spa, among others. Its strategic location near Interstate 75 and U.S. Highway 41 provides residents with easy access to retail, dining, and major employers in the region. The opening of The Hadley represents a significant milestone for Thompson Thrift and the North Port community, offering a unique rental experience in a booming city on Florida's west coast. During the ribbon-cutting ceremony, Thompson Thrift demonstrated its commitment to community engagement by presenting a check to the Loveland Center, a local non-profit organization. The Hadley is expected to be fully completed by February 2026, with resident move-ins already underway. This development underscores Thompson Thrift's reputation as a trusted partner in developing high-quality, attractive multifamily communities. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Best Friends Fur Ever and SARC Maryland Surpass Fundraising Goal to Support Survivor Pet Housing
content_encoded_text: The collaboration between Best Friends Fur Ever (BFFE) and the Sexual Assault/Spouse Abuse Resource Center (SARC) in Maryland has achieved a significant milestone by surpassing its fundraising target of $7,000. This effort supports the development of an onsite kennel at SARC, a facility designed to allow survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault, and stalking to stay with their pets during their time of need. The initiative addresses a critical barrier that often prevents survivors from seeking help, emphasizing the importance of keeping families and their pets together in times of crisis. Luisa Caiazzo, President and CEO of SARC, highlighted the fundraiser's significance, stating it embodies compassion and safety, removing obstacles for survivors. The event, held on June 14th at Concord Point in Havre de Grace, featured a family-friendly parade and activities, drawing community support and raising awareness for SARC's mission. Best Friends Fur Ever contributed over $2,000 to the cause, with co-founders Pat and Kelly Cullum matching the amount, demonstrating their commitment to the cause. Kelly Cullum of BFFE expressed pride in supporting SARC's vision, underscoring the belief that every family member, including pets, deserves safety and love. The successful fundraiser not only met but exceeded its goal, thanks to the generosity of the community, sponsors, and volunteers. This achievement marks a step forward in ensuring that survivors do not have to choose between their safety and their pets, reinforcing the community's role in supporting vulnerable individuals and their animal companions. title: YieldClub Launches Crypto Savings App with High APY, Secures $2.5M in Funding
content_encoded_text: YieldClub has announced the launch of its mobile application designed to simplify the process of earning high yields on cryptocurrency savings, with the potential to earn up to 12% Annual Percentage Yield (APY) on stablecoins. This development comes as the company secures $2.5 million in pre-seed funding from a group of notable fintech and crypto investors, including Pharsalus, Flex Capital, The House Fund, and Superlayer, alongside strategic angel investments from tech leaders such as Kevin Chou and Sam Shank. The app, created by CEO Mahesh Vellanki and CTO Michael Li, aims to bridge the gap between traditional finance and the high-return potential of decentralized finance (DeFi). YieldClub's platform offers an intuitive interface, easy onboarding through social login, and regionally optimized methods for converting cash to stablecoins, all while ensuring users retain full control over their funds through a non-custodial model. With the current financial landscape pushing consumers towards alternatives to low-interest savings options, YieldClub's timing is strategic. The platform utilizes audited DeFi protocols like Morpho to generate yield on stablecoins, providing users with exposure to higher returns without the volatility associated with other cryptocurrencies. This approach is particularly appealing in international markets experiencing rapid stablecoin adoption, such as Brazil. The $2.5 million pre-seed funding will support the app's public launch, expand its yield-generating options, enhance partnerships for cash-to-crypto conversion, and grow the team. Future plans include introducing a debit card for spending stablecoin balances while earning yield and exploring tokenized stock offerings for international users, all within the non-custodial framework. YieldClub is now available for preorder on the Apple App Store , with a full public launch scheduled for June 23, 2025, on both Apple and Android devices. This initiative represents a significant step towards making DeFi's benefits accessible to a broader audience, simplifying what has traditionally been a complex space for the average consumer. content_encoded_text: Wylie & Rum, located at 45 Moreland Ave. SE in Atlanta, is set to host a vibrant Drag Bingo event on Tuesday, June 24, from 7:30 to 10:00 p.m., as part of Pride Month celebrations. The choice of Wylie & Rum as the venue adds a special touch to the event, given its reputation for serving an 'unapologetically inauthentic' take on Caribbean cuisine and its vibrant atmosphere. The restaurant's commitment to creating a welcoming space for all aligns perfectly with the spirit of Pride Month and the goals of Joining Hearts. This event underscores the importance of community support and the power of collective action in addressing critical social issues, all while celebrating diversity and inclusion. title: Richard McMaster's 'Voyage Of Life' Ebook Available for Free Download
content_encoded_text: Richard McMaster, a bestselling author known for his depth and emotional resonance in storytelling, has announced that the ebook version of his inspirational historical fiction novel, 'Voyage Of Life', will be available at no charge from June 23 through June 24, 2025. This offer presents an opportunity for readers to delve into a story that explores the complexities of life, love, and the human spirit through the lens of the 'Baby Boomer' generation. 'Voyage Of Life' is not just a novel; it's an exploration of overcoming life's obstacles, told through the metaphor of Thomas Cole's Voyage of Life paintings. The story follows Sean Buchanan, whose life mirrors the paintings' stages—childhood, youth, manhood, and old age—each represented by the women he loves. The narrative weaves through themes of loss, perseverance, and the surprising twists of fate, culminating in a reunion with his first love. McMaster's work has been praised for its ability to evoke a wide range of emotions, from joy to sorrow, and for its thoughtful reflection on life's journey. The novel has garnered acclaim from readers and critics alike, with one reviewer noting its capacity to make readers 'smile, hesitate, and cry,' while Dennis Keller of The Hudson Weekly highlighted McMaster's skill in creating fully-formed characters and engaging plots. 'Voyage Of Life' is considered one of McMaster's signature works, alongside other notable titles such as 'Aaron's War' and 'A Love Divided By Time', which have also received widespread praise for their compelling narratives and emotional depth. This limited-time offer allows readers to experience McMaster's storytelling prowess without cost, making 'Voyage Of Life' accessible to a broader audience. The ebook will be available for download at Amazon , where McMaster's other works can also be found. This initiative not only highlights McMaster's generosity but also underscores the importance of literature in exploring and understanding the human condition. title: Cardiff Innovates Small Business Financing with Flexible Working Capital Solutions
content_encoded_text: Traditional banking systems have long dominated the commercial lending space, yet many small businesses find themselves at a disadvantage due to stringent qualification criteria, sluggish approval processes, and a lack of flexibility. Cardiff, spearheaded by CEO William Stern, is addressing these challenges head-on by redefining the concept of merchant cash advances (MCA) into what is now known as Revenue Based Financing. This innovative approach provides small businesses with working capital solutions that are not only fast and flexible but also tailored to meet their evolving needs. Since its inception in 2004, Cardiff has expanded its offerings beyond MCAs to include business lines of credit and a streamlined term loan product. These solutions are designed to bypass the traditional barriers to capital, offering quicker turnarounds and fewer hurdles for businesses. The transition from MCAs to working capital loans represents a significant shift in financial mechanics, introducing fixed terms and clear repayment schedules. This evolution allows business owners to plan with confidence, avoiding the unpredictability and cash flow disruptions associated with traditional MCAs. One of the most notable advantages of Cardiff's approach is the speed of funding. Unlike traditional banks, which may take weeks or even months to process a loan, Cardiff can approve applications and disburse funds within 24 to 48 hours. This rapid access to capital can be crucial for small businesses navigating slow seasons or looking to seize growth opportunities. Stern highlights the efficiency of Cardiff's technology and underwriting process, which leverages real-time data to assess a business's health, moving beyond outdated credit models that fail to capture the dynamism of small businesses. Cardiff's application process is designed for simplicity, requiring minimal paperwork and offering human support throughout. This accessibility is particularly beneficial for businesses in industries with fluctuating incomes, such as restaurants, retail shops, and contractors. By focusing on the business's potential rather than just credit scores, Cardiff opens up financing opportunities for a broader range of entrepreneurs, many of whom have been overlooked by traditional lending institutions. Under Stern's leadership, Cardiff has emerged not just as a lender but as a strategic partner for small businesses. By modernizing the MCA model into a transparent and flexible working capital product, Cardiff is empowering entrepreneurs to grow their businesses, support their families, and contribute to the broader economy. This commitment to innovation and inclusivity underscores Cardiff's role in redefining small business financing for the modern era. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Safe Harbor Marinas Faces Class Action Lawsuit Over Alleged Deceptive Billing Practices
content_encoded_text: A national class action lawsuit has been filed against Safe Harbor Marinas, LLC, and SHM Charleston Boatyard, LLC, alleging deceptive billing practices that have unfairly inflated customer invoices. The lawsuit, represented by Kelley | Uustal along with co-counsel, claims that the defendants engaged in a 'bait-and-switch' scheme, adding unauthorized charges to final bills. This practice, described as part of a systematic approach across Safe Harbor's 138 marinas in 24 states, has raised significant concerns about corporate accountability in the maritime services sector. The complaint, filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina Charleston Division, details how Miami Charter Yacht, LLC, experienced these practices firsthand. The company's 76-foot San Lorenzo yacht, 'Vasiliki,' was subjected to unauthorized surcharges and fees during repairs in late 2024. This case exemplifies the alleged widespread deceptive practices that the lawsuit seeks to address, including breach of contract and violations of South Carolina's Unfair Trade Practices Act. Cristina Pierson, a Partner at Kelley | Uustal, emphasized the coercive nature of Safe Harbor's policies, particularly the 'cash for splash' policy, which requires customers to pay in full before their vessel can leave the marina. The lawsuit aims to secure damages, restitution, and injunctive relief for affected boat owners nationwide, spotlighting the need for transparency and fairness in maritime services billing practices. title: American Heart Association Mourns the Loss of Former CEO Cass Wheeler
content_encoded_text: The American Heart Association has announced the passing of Cass Wheeler, its former Chief Executive Officer, who died at the age of 84 after a battle with a neurodegenerative illness. Wheeler, who led the Association from 1998 to 2008, was a pivotal figure in transforming the organization into a global leader in cardiovascular health and stroke prevention. Under Wheeler's guidance, the American Heart Association underwent significant structural and operational changes, including the consolidation of its affiliates into a more efficient, unified corporate structure. His tenure was marked by the launch of influential campaigns such as Go Red for Women™ , which brought attention to heart disease in women, and the establishment of the American Stroke Association. These initiatives have had a lasting impact on public health policies and awareness. Wheeler's leadership extended beyond the American Heart Association. He was actively involved in various nonprofit boards and commissions, contributing to the broader conversation on health, governance, and economic opportunity. His work with the Panel on the Nonprofit Sector and the Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production highlighted his commitment to societal well-being. Colleagues and friends remember Wheeler not only for his professional achievements but also for his personal qualities. Nancy Brown, current CEO of the American Heart Association, described him as a mentor and a relentless champion for those at risk of cardiovascular disease. His legacy is evident in the millions of lives touched by the initiatives he helped to establish and the continued work of the Association in advancing heart health and stroke prevention. Wheeler's contributions to public health and his dedication to the mission of the American Heart Association have left an indelible mark on the organization and the communities it serves. His family has requested that donations be made to the American Heart Association in his honor, continuing his lifelong commitment to building health and hope for everyone, everywhere. title: Exploring Hypogamy: The Shift in Modern Relationship Dynamics
content_encoded_text: The traditional dating paradigm, historically dominated by hypergamy—the practice of seeking partners of higher social or economic status—is undergoing a significant transformation. As women achieve greater success in education and the workforce, a new trend, hypogamy, is emerging. This phenomenon sees successful women forming relationships with partners who may not match their economic or educational standing but offer emotional support, sexual compatibility, and shared values. Richard Procida, Esq., an author and attorney with a background in gender studies and men's rights advocacy, is set to lead a discussion on this topic. The event, titled 'Dating Down or Rewriting the Rules? Smart Women, Hypogamy, and the Future of Relationships,' aims to dissect whether hypogamy represents a genuine shift in societal values or merely a media narrative. It will also explore what modern, successful women truly seek in relationships and the possibility of love transcending traditional status dynamics. Scheduled for July 6th at 2:00 pm PDT, the discussion will be hosted online via Zoom. Procida, who founded the Nonpartisan Red Pill Men's Group, brings a unique perspective to the conversation, having transitioned from pro-feminist writing to advocating for a balanced approach to gender issues. His insights, shaped by personal experiences and the Red Pill movement, contribute to a broader understanding of contemporary relationship dynamics. By examining hypogamy, the discussion seeks to shed light on the changing priorities of successful women in love and partnership, offering a fresh perspective on what it means to find compatibility in the modern world. title: NovaPads Launches Model Y Mattress Pro for Enhanced Tesla Camping Experience
content_encoded_text: NovaPads has announced the launch of its flagship product, the Model Y Mattress Pro, specifically designed for Tesla Model Y and Juniper owners. This innovative mattress aims to transform the Tesla camping experience by offering unparalleled comfort and convenience. The product was born out of the founder's personal struggle to find a suitable mattress for his Model Y, leading to the creation of a solution that addresses common discomforts associated with Tesla camping. The Model Y Mattress Pro stands out due to its custom-tailored design, achieved through advanced 3D scanning technology to ensure a perfect fit in the Model Y's trunk. Its unique Air-Foam technology combines the comfort of memory foam with the compact storage benefits of air mattresses, featuring high-pressure air chambers and a 4.5-inch high-resilience foam layer for optimal comfort. Additionally, the built-in compression pump simplifies setup and storage, making the mattress highly convenient for users. Further enhancing the Tesla camping experience, the mattress is made with odor-free TPU material, includes grooves to avoid blocking rear AC vents and the touchscreen, and comes with a free removable bed sheet. NovaPads' commitment to quality and customer service is evident in their range of products designed to improve on-the-go comfort for Tesla owners. title: Scientist Calls for Transparency in Scientific Funding and Innovation to Save Lives and Taxpayer Money
content_encoded_text: Dario Crosetto, an Italian-American scientist, is spearheading a call for increased transparency and accountability within the scientific community, particularly targeting the allocation of billions in taxpayer funds to research projects that may not deliver on their promises. Crosetto's inventions, the 3D-Flow and 3D-CBS (3D Complete Body Screening), represent potential breakthroughs in both particle physics and medical imaging, offering cost-effective solutions to early cancer detection and efficient data processing in high-energy physics experiments. Crosetto's 3D-Flow technology, recognized as a breakthrough in 1993, enables the accurate detection of objects traveling at the speed of light, with applications ranging from particle physics to early cancer detection. Despite its proven potential, Crosetto claims his innovations have been sidelined in favor of less efficient, more costly alternatives, such as the FPGA-based systems currently under construction at CERN for the 2026-2036 experiments. These systems, according to Crosetto, are fundamentally flawed and destined to fail, wasting billions in taxpayer money. The implications of Crosetto's call for transparency extend beyond the scientific community, touching on the ethical use of public funds and the potential to save countless lives through early cancer detection. His 3D-CBS device, designed for cost-effective screening, could halve premature cancer mortality rates, a claim supported by simulations but yet to be experimentally proven due to lack of funding. Crosetto's efforts to bring his inventions to light have been met with resistance, leading him to appeal directly to the public, Members of the European Parliament, and U.S. Congressmen to demand accountability from institutions like CERN. He advocates for a public, face-to-face meeting to compare the scientific merits and cost-effectiveness of his 3D-Flow system against CERN's FPGA-based solutions, emphasizing the need for evidence-based decision-making in science. The stakes are high, with Crosetto estimating that over $4 billion in taxpayer funds have already been wasted on inadequate systems. His proposal for a transparent review of competing technologies not only aims to prevent further financial waste but also to unlock the life-saving potential of his medical imaging invention. As the debate over scientific transparency and innovation funding continues, the broader implications for public health, scientific integrity, and fiscal responsibility remain at the forefront of Crosetto's campaign. From development and scriptwriting to production, post-production, and final distribution, each phase is designed to maintain the project's thematic and visual integrity. Jesani's creative direction and Firefly's musical vision guide the project, with a diverse team of directors bringing each video to life. This visual album aims to redefine the boundaries between narrative cinema and music, offering an immersive experience that combines urban realism with surreal dreamscapes. 'Find Your Light' is not just an album but a transformative journey, promising to leave a lasting impact on the independent music and film industries by pushing the envelope of what visual albums can achieve. title: Creative Biolabs Expands Skincare Research with Multi-source Exosome Products
content_encoded_text: Creative Biolabs has unveiled a groundbreaking lineup of exosome skincare research products, sourcing from umbilical cord, milk, and plants, to revolutionize the skincare industry. This initiative not only broadens the scope of exosome applications in skincare but also enhances the efficiency of transitioning research into tangible products. Exosomes derived from human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells (UCMSC) are at the forefront of this innovation, celebrated for their regenerative and anti-aging capabilities. Creative Biolabs employs advanced freeze-drying technology to ensure these exosomes maintain their bioactivity and stability, offering cosmetic companies a reliable foundation for developing high-efficacy skincare solutions. Milk-derived exosomes are another highlight, rich in bioactive factors and known for their excellent permeability and stability. These exosomes represent a blend of scientific advancement and the gentle approach of skincare, catering to the growing consumer demand for scientifically backed skincare ingredients. Plant-derived exosomes, such as those from aloe, coconut, and ginseng, introduce a natural dimension to the lineup. These nanoscale vesicles efficiently deliver plant-based active compounds, offering multifunctional benefits including antioxidant and anti-aging effects, thereby pushing natural skincare into a new era of precision and innovation. Beyond providing high-quality raw materials, Creative Biolabs supports skincare development teams with customized services, including ingredient screening and activity testing, to ensure successful research outcomes. This comprehensive approach underscores the company's commitment to leading innovation in exosome application technologies within the skincare industry. title: Ferrari 250 GT Red Special Spyder Joins Ron Sturgeon Collection as a Tribute to Italian Design
content_encoded_text: The Ron Sturgeon Collection has welcomed a remarkable new addition, a 1970 Ferrari 250 GT Red Special Spyder, a handcrafted tribute to one of the rarest and most elegant Italian designs in automotive history. This recreation draws inspiration from the 1957 Berlinetta Speciale, originally created by Pinin Farina for Prince Bernhard of the Netherlands, embodying the styling and spirit of a true one-off masterpiece. Under its sculpted long bonnet, the Spyder boasts a high-revving powerplant equipped with triple Weber carburetors, delivering an estimated 320 horsepower. The vehicle's performance is further enhanced by a five-speed manual transmission, ventilated disc brakes, and a quad-exit exhaust system, ensuring both power and presence on the road. The classic Ferrari flair is captured through its 15' Borrani wire wheels and distinctive design elements such as an oval grille, independent front bumperettes, sculpted fender vents, and curved tailfins with taillights perched on top. Inside, the Spyder features a wood-rimmed steering wheel adorned with the iconic prancing horse, fronting Veglia Borletti gauges that include a 180-mph speedometer and an 8k-rpm tachometer. Additional instrumentation is elegantly housed above the center stack, blending functionality with timeless design. Ron Sturgeon, founder of the DFW Car & Toy Museum, remarked on the significance of this addition, stating, 'This car is an homage to one of Ferrari's most exclusive commissions. It may be a recreation, but the craftsmanship and character are unmistakably Maranello.' The Ferrari 250 GT Red Special Spyder stands as a testament to the timeless appeal of Italian automotive design, from its royal lineage to its roaring tribute. title: BHS, Inc. Launches Modular Charging Solutions for Electric Industrial Vehicles
content_encoded_text: BHS, Inc., a prominent manufacturer of custom material handling equipment, has unveiled a new line of modular solutions designed for industrial vehicle charging stations. This innovative product family is centered around the Universal Forklift Charger Stand (CSU), complemented by configurable cable management tools such as the Cable Retractor Reel Mounts (CSU-PX) and heavy-duty Cable Retractor Reels (CRR). Trent Boothe, Inside Sales Manager of BHS, emphasized the importance of adaptable charging infrastructure as electric fleets expand, stating that a one-size-fits-all approach is no longer sufficient. The Universal Forklift Charger Stands are designed with versatility in mind, featuring shelves or horizontal mounts to accommodate battery chargers of nearly any design. This allows a single stand to power multiple industrial trucks simultaneously, including but not limited to forklifts. Boothe highlighted the system's flexibility, noting its ability to support various types of electric vehicles without the need for extensive floor plan redesigns. This modular approach extends to charger cables as well, with Cable Retractor Reel Mounts offering multiple articulating arms for safe and efficient cable guidance to any charging position. Available now, the CSU, CSU-PX, and CRR products embody BHS' commitment to advancing electrification across industries. While particularly suited for forklift fleets, these solutions also provide compact and efficient charging stations for electric equipment in warehousing, logistics, air travel, manufacturing, and other sectors transitioning to electric vehicle fleets. title: Elite Elevators Launches India's First CE-Certified Gearless Home Lift, The X300
content_encoded_text: Elite Elevators India has set a new benchmark in the home mobility sector with the launch of the X300, India's first CE-certified gearless home elevator. This achievement not only highlights the company's commitment to quality and innovation but also positions India as a competitive player in the global market for residential mobility solutions. The X300, entirely made in India, combines European safety and design standards with Indian manufacturing prowess, offering a product that is both world-class and uniquely tailored to Indian homes. The X300 stands out for its innovative features, including four unique ride modes, smart app control for real-time monitoring, a 21-inch cabin display, and fully powder-coated components for durability. Designed specifically for Indian homes, it requires no deep pit or machine room, minimal civil work, and offers quick installation in various residential settings. With prices starting from ₹16.50 lakhs, the X300 is an energy-efficient and customizable solution, making premium home mobility accessible to a wider audience. This milestone is a testament to Elite Elevators' partnership with TK Access Solutions of Germany, blending Indian manufacturing with European standards. The company's success, with over 10,000 installations worldwide, underscores the growing demand for high-quality home elevators that combine safety, style, and innovation. The X300 is not just a product but a symbol of India's capability to produce world-class home mobility solutions that cater to global standards. For those interested in experiencing the X300 firsthand, Elite Elevators invites homeowners, designers, and developers to visit their showrooms across 32 cities in India. Here, they can explore the features of the X300 and consult with professionals to find the perfect home elevator solution. This launch represents a significant step forward for Elite Elevators and the Indian manufacturing sector, showcasing the potential to create products that meet international standards while addressing the specific needs of the Indian market. title: Alsco Uniforms Expands Toronto Presence with Acquisition of Topper Linen
content_encoded_text: Alsco Uniforms, a global leader in uniform and linen laundry services, has announced the acquisition of Topper Linen, a move that significantly expands its operational footprint in the Greater Toronto Area. This acquisition not only strengthens Alsco's service capabilities but also underscores its commitment to maintaining long-standing relationships and trust within the Toronto community, a value deeply ingrained in both companies' histories. Bob Steiner, CEO of Alsco Uniforms, highlighted the importance of this acquisition as a step forward in the company's growth strategy. The integration of Topper Linen's Toronto facility and fleet into Alsco's operations will enhance the company's ability to serve a diverse range of businesses, including those in the industrial, healthcare, hospitality, and food and beverage sectors. The rebranding of Topper's assets under the Alsco Uniforms name is expected to be completed over the coming months, ensuring a seamless transition for customers and employees alike. Tim Topornicki, President of Topper Linen, expressed confidence in the alignment of values between the two companies, particularly in their shared commitment to service excellence. The acquisition ensures that Topper Linen's employees will remain in place, preserving the local expertise and service continuity that customers have come to expect. With this acquisition, Alsco Uniforms now operates two laundry facilities in Toronto, further solidifying its presence in the region. Jim Kearns, Alsco's chief operating officer, emphasized the strategic importance of this move, noting that it provides a strong foundation for serving the Toronto area more effectively. Alsco Uniforms plans to continue its expansion across North America, with a focus on growing its sales and service teams to support its broader growth initiatives. Alsco Uniforms' acquisition of Topper Linen is a testament to the company's ongoing commitment to providing hygienically clean uniforms, linens, and other essential products to businesses worldwide. With over 80 mixed-processing facilities in North America, Alsco continues to lead the uniform and linen rental industry, offering reliable and exceptional service to more than 350,000 customers across 13 countries. The segment provided a valuable platform for Schwob to advocate for the integration of acoustical considerations in the blueprint of buildings, a practice that could lead to healthier, more productive communities. As cities continue to grow and spaces become more densely populated, the insights shared by Schwob could inform future projects, ensuring that sound design is not an afterthought but a fundamental component of architectural planning. title: Skills Frameworks Identified as Critical for Talent Mobility Success
content_encoded_text: A recent study conducted by the HR Research Institute in partnership with SHL underscores the pivotal role of structured skills frameworks in the success of internal talent mobility programs. The research, titled 'Talent Mobility Programs 2025,' delves into the challenges and opportunities organizations face in implementing effective internal mobility strategies. Despite 54% of HR professionals acknowledging the positive impact of internal mobility on retention and business outcomes, the study reveals a significant gap in the infrastructure necessary to fully leverage these benefits. One of the key findings from the report is the advantage organizations gain by assessing both employee skills and job requirements, enabling them to match individuals to suitable roles more efficiently. However, the study also points out that over half of the respondents struggle with translating and measuring skills due to cumbersome skill libraries or vague role profiles. This challenge is compounded by the fact that only 8% of organizations possess a concise and user-friendly skills framework, which is essential for facilitating successful mobility. The research identifies several barriers to effective talent mobility, including a preference among managers for external hires (33%), limited budgets (28%), and outdated technology (18%). To overcome these obstacles, the study recommends that HR leaders integrate mobility into their core talent strategy, educate managers on the value of internal advancement, invest in scalable technology, and refine skills frameworks for greater clarity and usability. Debbie McGrath, Chief Instigator and CEO of HR.com, emphasizes the synergy between reskilling and internal mobility, noting that a clear understanding of employee skills and job requirements is crucial for success. The study suggests that skills frameworks could serve as the foundational element organizations need to execute their mobility strategies effectively. The full research report is available for download, offering HR professionals actionable insights to enhance their talent mobility programs and drive workforce agility. title: Telvantis Inc. Reports Strong May Revenue and Confirms Optimistic Full-Year Forecast
content_encoded_text: Telvantis Inc., a prominent U.S.-based technology-driven telecommunications and enterprise solutions provider, has reported a robust revenue of approximately $20.6 million for the month of May 2025. This performance not only marks a significant recovery for the company but also sets a positive tone for its financial outlook, with expectations to surpass $200 million in revenues for the full year. The company's current run rate of about $20 million in monthly revenue significantly outperforms its 2024 figures, highlighting a promising upward trend in its financial health. The company's gross margin for May stood at approximately $150 thousand, with an operating loss of about $227 thousand before financing costs. Despite the loss, Telvantis anticipates an expansion in gross profit and a reduction in costs in the upcoming quarters, with May's gross margin being the strongest so far this year. The second quarter of 2025 has already shown substantial improvements over the first quarter, in terms of revenues, gross margins, and operating profit, although these figures are yet to be audited. Daniel Contreras, CEO of Telvantis Inc., expressed optimism about the company's performance, stating, 'This month of May was strong and we believe that we will close June even stronger.' Contreras also mentioned the company's plans to work with auditors to provide reviewed numbers for the first half of 2025 after the quarter's close, further emphasizing the company's commitment to transparency and growth. Telvantis's recent strategic acquisitions in the U.S. and Ireland have broadened its portfolio to include advanced 5G technologies, cloud-based communications platforms, and enterprise-grade services. These moves are part of the company's forward-thinking strategy to cement its position as a leader in the rapidly evolving telecommunications landscape. However, the company cautions investors about the inherent risks and uncertainties in forward-looking statements, advising against undue reliance on them. title: Accredited Solutions, Inc. Launches CDRChain, a Blockchain-Based Marketplace for Telecom Settlement
content_encoded_text: Accredited Solutions, Inc. (OTC: ASII) has announced the launch of CDRChain, a blockchain-based marketplace aimed at transforming the settlement process for call detail records (CDRs) and SMS traffic among telecom carriers, MVNOs, and global partners. This innovative platform leverages blockchain technology to offer near real-time transaction validation and settlement, addressing the inefficiencies inherent in traditional billing and clearing systems. CDRChain's introduction comes as a response to the longstanding challenges faced by the telecom industry, including delayed payments, high administrative costs, and the risk of fraud. By utilizing an immutable ledger and smart contract functionality, the platform promises to streamline operations, enhance transparency, and foster trust among all parties involved in the settlement process. Eduardo Brito, CEO of Accredited Solutions, highlighted the transformative potential of CDRChain for the telecom settlement industry. The platform's features include accelerated settlement times, reduced fraud risk, operational efficiency, cost savings, and unparalleled transparency, making it a comprehensive solution for the industry's needs. With no direct competitors offering a similar blockchain-based solution, CDRChain is poised to become the central hub for global SMS and voice traffic settlements. The platform's launch is a significant step forward in the telecom industry's evolution towards more efficient and secure transaction processes. For more information about CDRChain and to join the waiting list for early access, visit https://cdrchain.ai/ . Accredited Solutions anticipates having a minimum viable product (MVP) with three test clients interconnected by the end of the third quarter of this year, marking a pivotal milestone in the platform's development and adoption. title: California's Donor Milk Law Spurs 30% Demand Increase, Calls for More Donors
content_encoded_text: California's Assembly Bill 3059, known as the Human Milk Bill, has marked a significant advancement in neonatal care by expanding insurance coverage and hospital access to donor milk, resulting in a 30% increase in demand. This surge has put pressure on the current supply, highlighting the urgent need for more nursing mothers to donate milk to ensure vulnerable newborns receive this essential nutrition. The legislation mandates commercial insurance coverage for medically necessary pasteurized donor human milk and removes the requirement for hospitals to have a tissue bank license to distribute milk from a licensed tissue bank. These changes have made donor milk more accessible and affordable for families, but the donor base has not expanded at the same rate as the demand, risking delays in care for infants in need. Jennifer Benito, CEO of Mothers’ Milk Bank California, emphasized the importance of community action to bridge the supply gap. The organization has introduced new donation options to make the process easier for donors, including Saturday screening appointments, at-home milk pick-up services, and additional drop-off locations. These efforts aim to meet the growing demand for donor milk, which is now being used not only in NICUs but also in Well Baby and Postpartum units, where it has shown to reduce feeding complications and support infant health. With over 36,000 preterm births recorded in California in 2023, the need for donor milk is more critical than ever. Mothers’ Milk Bank California is calling on eligible nursing mothers to donate, stressing that every ounce can make a significant difference in the lives of newborns. The success of AB3059 depends on the community's response to this call for donations, ensuring that all babies who need donor milk can access it without delay. title: Cryptocurrency Industry at a Crossroads Under Trump Administration
content_encoded_text: The cryptocurrency industry is experiencing a pivotal moment under the Trump administration, with significant legislative proposals poised to redefine its regulatory landscape. The Financial Innovation and Technology for the 21st Century Act (FIT21) and the Bitcoin Strategic Reserve Act represent potential milestones in providing clarity and legitimacy to digital assets. FIT21 aims to delineate regulatory oversight between the CFTC and SEC based on the decentralization of a digital asset's underlying blockchain, while the Bitcoin Strategic Reserve Act could establish a national reserve for Bitcoin, enhancing its global standing. Despite the optimism, the industry remains fraught with volatility and skepticism. The launch of memecoins by President Trump and his wife has been viewed by some as undermining the seriousness of digital assets. Moreover, the absence of immediate regulatory changes post-inauguration has left room for speculation about the administration's commitment to cryptocurrency reform. Analysts like Geoff Kendrick of Standard Chartered Bank warn of a potential 10-20% market sell-off if anticipated policy changes fail to materialize. For investors seeking exposure to the cryptocurrency sector, Direxion’s Daily Crypto Industry Bull 2X and Bear 1X Shares (ARCA: LMBO and ARCA: REKT) offer leveraged and inverse exposure to the industry's short-term trends. However, these instruments carry significant risks, including the possibility of substantial losses, and are recommended only for sophisticated investors capable of managing such volatility. The cryptocurrency industry stands at a crossroads, with the potential for regulatory clarity and growth on one hand, and the risks of volatility and unfulfilled expectations on the other. Investors and enthusiasts alike must navigate this landscape with caution, balancing optimism with a realistic assessment of the challenges ahead. title: Sarah M. Allen Honored with 2025 Excellence Award by The Boston Estate Planning Council
content_encoded_text: Sarah M. Allen, JD, LL.M., AEP®, a shareholder and director at Rice, Heard & Bigelow, has been honored with the 2025 Excellence Award by the Boston Estate Planning Council (BEPC). This prestigious award acknowledges her professional excellence in estate planning and her substantial contributions to the community. Allen was recognized during the BEPC’s Annual Gala on May 21, 2025, at the Sheraton Boston Hotel. Robert G. Bannish, President of RHB, praised Allen for her dedication and leadership, noting her role as a professional trustee and family advisor for numerous beneficiaries and charities. With over twenty years of experience in estate planning, Allen's expertise and personal demeanor have made her a respected figure among her colleagues and the estate planning community. Allen's involvement with the BEPC spans many years, including serving as its president in 2019-2020 and receiving the BEPC President’s Award. Her leadership extends to her roles as chair of the Boston Foundation’s Professional Advisor Committee and Professional Advisor Network, further demonstrating her commitment to the field. At Rice, Heard & Bigelow, the oldest company of individual professional trustees in the country, Allen continues to provide discreet, personal service through long-standing trustee relationships. Her previous role as a partner and co-manager of the estate planning department at Pabian & Russell, LLC, along with her education from Syracuse University and Boston University School of Law, has equipped her with the knowledge and skills to excel in her profession. LaFleur Minerals' focus on establishing itself among quality gold-mining operations, alongside industry giants like Barrick Mining Corporation and Royal Gold, underscores the significance of its emergence in the sector. The implications of LaFleur Minerals' strategic positioning are manifold. For the mining sector, LaFleur's entry signifies the ongoing attractiveness of Canada's gold-producing regions, reinforcing the country's status as a global mining leader. As gold continues to be a safe haven amid economic uncertainties, the rise of players like LaFleur Minerals highlights the dynamic interplay between market trends and strategic resource development. title: G6 Hospitality's Revenue Management Program Achieves Significant Growth
content_encoded_text: G6 Hospitality, the parent company of Motel 6 and Studio 6, has reported that its Revenue Management Services (RMS) program has significantly outperformed the broader portfolio and market benchmarks. The program, which utilizes proprietary automation tools and strategic oversight, has enabled participating properties to achieve an 11% year-over-year revenue growth in the first quarter of 2025, doubling the growth rate of non-RMS properties and surpassing industry standards. The success of the RMS program is attributed to its comprehensive approach, including daily competitive set monitoring and bi-weekly strategy calls with dedicated revenue managers. This allows property managers to concentrate on guest experience while G6's experts optimize pricing and promotional strategies. Notably, properties under the RMS program achieved a 10% higher Average Daily Rate (ADR) compared to their non-RMS counterparts, highlighting the program's effectiveness in revenue optimization. Digital channels have particularly benefited from the RMS program, with app and website bookings for managed properties growing by 11.5% in Q1 2025, in contrast to a 4.4% decline in the rest of the portfolio. This growth is driven by advanced dynamic pricing and OTA optimization, supported by a central performance marketing team. The momentum continued into April 2025, with RMS properties posting a 9% revenue growth and an 11% increase in web channel bookings, further demonstrating the program's impact. Sonal Sinha, CEO of G6 Hospitality, emphasized the program's role in empowering franchisees with cutting-edge tools and strategic expertise to drive results. The recent launch of the AI-powered My6 app, which has already increased direct bookings by 14% year-over-year, complements the RMS program's objectives. Together, these initiatives reflect G6 Hospitality's commitment to leveraging technology and data to foster growth, enhance guest satisfaction, and support franchisee success. title: Standard Lithium Ltd. Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Appointments
content_encoded_text: Standard Lithium Ltd. (NYSE American: SLI) has announced the addition of two seasoned executives to its leadership team, marking a significant step in its journey towards sustainable lithium production. Daniel Rosen joins as Vice President of Strategy and Investor Relations, bringing over 13 years of experience in corporate strategy, finance, and capital markets from his previous roles at Rio Tinto and Arcadium Lithium. Tim Sobel has been appointed Vice President of Health, Safety, Social and Environment (HSSE), offering more than 30 years of global operational risk and safety expertise from his tenure at DP World and Sunoco Logistics. The appointments come at a pivotal time for Standard Lithium as it progresses towards first production. CEO David Park highlighted the critical role both executives will play in advancing the company's projects, including its flagship initiatives in the Smackover Formation, a world-class lithium-brine asset spanning Arkansas and Texas. The company's partnership with global energy leader Equinor ASA on the South West Arkansas Project and its collaboration with LANXESS Corp. on the phase 1A project in southern Arkansas are central to its strategy for achieving commercial-scale lithium production. Standard Lithium's focus on sustainable development and its application of a scalable and fully integrated direct lithium extraction (DLE) and purification process underscore its commitment to environmental stewardship and innovation in the lithium sector. The expertise of Rosen and Sobel is expected to bolster the company's strategic initiatives and operational excellence as it navigates the challenges and opportunities of the green energy transition. title: LaFleur Minerals Inc. Advances Plans for Beacon Gold Mill Restart and Swanson Project Drilling
content_encoded_text: LaFleur Minerals Inc. (CSE: LFLR) (OTCQB: LFLRF) (FSE: 3WK0) is making significant strides in its plans to restart production at the Beacon Gold Mill in Val-d’Or, Québec, by early 2026. This initiative is bolstered by a Preliminary Economic Assessment and a 5,000-metre diamond drilling program at the nearby Swanson Gold Project. The Beacon Mill, a facility capable of processing 750 tonnes per day, has undergone over C$20 million in upgrades and is fully permitted. Its strategic location amidst numerous gold deposits, including the Swanson Project, which boasts an NI 43-101 mineral resource of 123,400 ounces indicated and 64,500 ounces inferred, positions LaFleur for potential success in the current gold market. The company is in the final stages of preparing a bulk sample plan involving up to 100,000 tonnes and additional mill enhancements estimated at approximately C$5.6 million. With gold prices exceeding $3,300 per ounce, LaFleur is keen on accelerating its path to production and expanding its resource base through focused exploration efforts. The Swanson Gold Project, encompassing 16,600 hectares, is rich in gold and critical metals, with easy road access and a rail line enhancing its development potential. The Beacon Gold Mill, now fully refurbished and permitted, is being considered not only for processing mineralized material from Swanson but also for custom milling operations for other nearby gold projects. This development is significant as it underscores LaFleur Minerals' commitment to leveraging its assets in the Abitibi Gold Belt to create long-term value. The restart of the Beacon Gold Mill and the exploration at the Swanson Project could mark a pivotal moment for the company, especially in a market where gold prices are favorable. The strategic enhancements and drilling programs are aimed at maximizing the potential of these projects, contributing to the local economy and the broader mining sector. title: Lexaria Bioscience Corp. Achieves Global Patent Milestone with 50 Patents
content_encoded_text: Lexaria Bioscience Corp., a leader in drug delivery platform innovation, has announced the granting of two new international patents, elevating its global patent portfolio to 50. This achievement underscores the company's commitment to broadening its intellectual property and enhancing its position in the pharmaceutical industry. The new patents include one in Australia for the treatment of epilepsy and another in Japan for the sublingual delivery of nicotine, both utilizing Lexaria's proprietary DehydraTECH™ technology. The patent for epilepsy treatment expands Lexaria's protection outside the USA, where it already holds six patents, and is set to expire in 2044. The nicotine delivery patent in Japan complements existing patents in the USA and Canada, with an expiration in 2043. These developments are significant given the epilepsy drug market's projected growth to over $15 billion by 2032 and the global retail oral nicotine market's expected annual growth rate of 26% until at least 2030. Rich Christopher, CEO of Lexaria, highlighted the strategic importance of these patents in facilitating commercial deals within the pharmaceutical sector and building long-term value for stakeholders. The company's DehydraTECH™ technology has demonstrated potential in increasing bio-absorption and improving drug delivery across the blood-brain barrier, offering promising avenues for treating epilepsy and enhancing nicotine absorption. With the epilepsy market serving approximately 50 million people in the US alone and the nicotine pouch market anticipated to reach $25.4 billion by 2030, Lexaria's latest patents position it at the forefront of addressing significant health and wellness challenges. The company's achievement of 50 worldwide patents represents a decade-long vision coming to fruition, setting a solid foundation for future innovations and collaborations in the drug delivery space. With 13 U.S. and 4 international patents, HeartBeam is poised to redefine cardiac health management by making advanced diagnostics accessible outside traditional medical settings. HeartBeam's participation in the iAccess Alpha Virtual Summer Conference underscores the significance of its technology in the evolving landscape of cardiac care. By enabling remote monitoring and diagnosis, the company's innovations have the potential to significantly improve patient outcomes and reduce the burden on healthcare facilities. This presentation represents a key opportunity for HeartBeam to demonstrate the value of its technology to investors and the broader medical community, marking an important step forward in the company's mission to transform cardiac care. Constructed with high-modulus Toray carbon fibers, it aims to reduce weight while enhancing performance. With over 40 professional players now using Newton shafts and increasing interest from club fitters and distributors, Newton Golf anticipates sustained growth and recognition in the golf industry through 2025. This victory underscores the importance of innovation in sports equipment, demonstrating how Newton Golf's commitment to applying Newtonian principles to golf club design can lead to tangible success on the course. The company's focus on scientifically advanced equipment that offers stability, control, and performance is proving to be a game-changer for professional golfers seeking consistency and accuracy in their game. title: UGI Advises on Safety and Energy Efficiency Amid Extreme Heat
content_encoded_text: With excessive heat warnings in effect and the potential for record-breaking temperatures, UGI Utilities, Inc. has issued a series of recommendations aimed at ensuring public safety and promoting energy efficiency. The utility company emphasizes the importance of adjusting programmable thermostats to higher temperatures when away from home, sealing leaks around doors and windows, and utilizing fans as an alternative to air conditioning to reduce energy consumption. UGI also advises on the critical need to recognize the symptoms of heat-related illnesses, such as heat exhaustion and heat stroke, which can be life-threatening. Symptoms include headache, nausea, dizziness, confusion, and in severe cases, loss of consciousness. The company urges the public to stay hydrated and to check on vulnerable individuals, including the elderly, infants, and those with chronic health conditions, who are more susceptible to the adverse effects of extreme heat. In addition to health and safety tips, UGI highlights the importance of energy conservation measures, such as closing blinds and shades to block out the sun's heat and keeping air conditioning filters clean to ensure efficient operation. The company reassures customers of its commitment to safety and service, offering 24-hour emergency response for any service issues. UGI Utilities, Inc., serving over 760,000 customers, continues to prioritize the well-being of its community by providing timely and practical advice during extreme weather conditions. The integration of both companies' technologies, tools, and best practices is expected to further enhance service delivery and operational efficiency without compromising the high standards that have defined their success. Josh Aberman, CEO of Lehman Pipe, welcomed the Cole team, emphasizing the partnership's focus on growth and the continued trust of their customers. This strategic acquisition underscores the importance of partnerships in driving growth and innovation in the industrial distribution sector. By combining their strengths, Lehman Pipe and Cole Industrial are set to offer unparalleled service and value to their customers, marking a significant step forward in their shared vision for the future. title: Jaime & Blanca Jarrín Foundation and Los Defensores Launch 2025 Scholarships to Empower Future Leaders in Law and Journalism
content_encoded_text: The Jaime & Blanca Jarrín Foundation (JBJF), alongside Los Defensores, has announced the commencement of its 2025 Scholarship Application Program, targeting college students pursuing degrees in Law and Journalism. This initiative, running from June 23 through July 20, underscores the theme 'The Power of Believing,' highlighting the significant impact of mentorship and support in fostering resilience and self-confidence among students from underserved communities. Nicole Cordero, Vice President of Community Affairs and Marketing at Los Defensores, emphasized the life-changing effect of hearing 'I believe in you' from a mentor, a sentiment at the core of this year's program. The partnership between JBJF and Los Defensores aims to bridge educational gaps and nurture the next generation of Latino leaders in fields where their voices are critically needed. Jaime Jarrín, MLB Hall of Famer and co-founder of the JBJF, shared the foundation's commitment to investing in youth education as a means to strengthen communities. The scholarship program not only provides financial assistance but also reinforces the belief in students' potential to succeed and lead. Eligibility for the JBJF Scholarship includes a minimum 3.0 GPA, demonstrated financial need, and enrollment at a California-based school. Applicants are required to submit basic and family information, a resume, a letter of recommendation, academic transcripts, and responses to a brief questionnaire. Cruzzanna Hernandez, a 2023 JBJF Scholarship Recipient, shared her transformative experience, highlighting how the scholarship supported her educational journey at CSULB and empowered her to inspire others through her story. For more information or to apply, visit https://www.losdefensores.com/scholarship/ . This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Insurers Raise Concerns Over Increasing Fires on Ships Transporting Electric Vehicles
content_encoded_text: The maritime transport of electric vehicles (EVs) has introduced new risks that are causing alarm among insurers. Unlike traditional vehicles powered by internal combustion engines, EVs present unique challenges when it comes to fire safety on ships. The lithium-ion batteries that power these vehicles can catch fire under certain conditions, and such fires are notoriously difficult to extinguish, posing a significant risk to the safety of the crew, the vessel, and its cargo. Recent incidents have highlighted the potential dangers, with fires linked to EVs becoming more common. These incidents have prompted insurers to reevaluate the risks associated with transporting EVs by sea. The concern is not just about the frequency of these fires but also about their intensity and the difficulty in controlling them, which can lead to total losses of the vessels involved. The situation has sparked a debate about the need for electric vehicle manufacturers to address these safety concerns. Companies like Mullen Automotive Inc. (NASDAQ: MULN) are at the forefront of the EV industry, and their response to these challenges could set a precedent for how the sector addresses maritime safety. The latest news and updates relating to Mullen Automotive Inc. are available in the company’s newsroom at https://ibn.fm/MULN . As the demand for electric vehicles continues to grow, the industry must find solutions to ensure their safe transport. This includes developing better fire suppression systems for ships carrying EVs and possibly redesigning battery packs to reduce the risk of fire. The implications of not addressing these issues could be significant, not just for the insurance industry but for the global push towards cleaner transportation options. title: Research Reveals Why Most Smokers Avoid Lung Cancer Despite Tobacco Use
content_encoded_text: Recent research has shed light on the puzzling phenomenon that the majority of smokers do not develop lung cancer, despite the well-documented risks associated with tobacco use. The study, which delves into the biological underpinnings of this observation, suggests that certain smokers possess robust defense mechanisms that significantly reduce their likelihood of developing the disease. These findings could pave the way for advanced preventive measures and targeted therapies for those at risk. Tobacco smoke contains numerous carcinogens known to damage DNA and initiate cancerous growths in lung tissue. However, the study highlights that only a minority of smokers succumb to lung cancer, indicating the presence of protective biological factors in others. Researchers are now focusing on identifying these factors, which could lead to breakthroughs in understanding cancer resistance and developing new treatments. For individuals who do develop lung cancer, the study underscores the importance of accessing effective treatment options. Innovations in therapy, such as those being explored by companies like Calidi Biotherapeutics Inc. , are critical in the fight against this deadly disease. The research not only contributes to the scientific community's understanding of lung cancer but also offers hope for smokers and former smokers worldwide. title: US~Observer Investigates Morpheus Research Amid Concerns Over Market Manipulation
content_encoded_text: The US~Observer, a national investigative news outlet, has initiated an investigation into Morpheus Research, a short-report entity with reported endorsements from Hindenburg Research founder Nate Anderson. This probe comes after Morpheus Research published reports on Solaris Energy Infrastructure (NYSE: SEI), Backblaze (NASDAQ: BLZE), Abacus Global Management (NASDAQ: ABL), and Mercurity Fintech Holding (NASDAQ: MFH), which were followed by notable stock price declines ranging from 5% to over 30%. Concerns have been raised regarding Morpheus Research's transparency, including its funding sources and its connections to Hindenburg alumni. Despite Anderson's claims of no formal affiliation with Morpheus, his endorsement in March 2025 and the timing of Morpheus's launch shortly after Hindenburg's shutdown have led to speculation about possible coordination and the continued use of short-selling strategies. The US~Observer's investigation aims to uncover whether Morpheus Research utilized insider information, collaborated with hedge funds, or benefited from undisclosed positions. The outcomes of this investigation could have significant implications for investor protection and the integrity of financial markets, especially as questions arise about the legality and ethical standards of Morpheus's operations. title: Vision Marine Technologies Inc. Acquires Nautical Ventures to Pioneer Integrated Electric Boat Dealership in North America
content_encoded_text: Vision Marine Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ: VMAR), a frontrunner in high-voltage electric marine propulsion, has completed the acquisition of Nautical Ventures Group, a prestigious U.S. boat dealership and the 2024 Boating Industry 'Dealer of the Year'. This strategic acquisition heralds the establishment of North America's inaugural combined electric boat propulsion and dealership platform, integrating Vision Marine's innovative E-Motion(TM) powertrain with Nautical Ventures' expansive retail network, diverse inventory, and comprehensive service capabilities. With nine locations across Florida and a portfolio featuring renowned brands such as Axopar, Yamaha, and Beneteau, Nautical Ventures offers Vision Marine direct entry into one of the globe's most vibrant boating markets. This acquisition not only enhances Vision Marine's direct-to-consumer sales channels but also introduces additional revenue streams, setting the stage for nationwide expansion. The transaction, financed through a combination of cash, a seller's note, and stock, was expertly advised by ThinkEquity. This merger is a pivotal development in the marine industry, signaling a shift towards sustainable boating solutions. By combining Vision Marine's cutting-edge electric propulsion technology with Nautical Ventures' retail expertise, the partnership is poised to accelerate the adoption of zero-emission marine vehicles, contributing to environmental conservation and offering boaters high-performance alternatives to traditional internal combustion engines.
