RapidFire Safety & Security, offering comprehensive fire, life safety, and electronic security services to the commercial sector, is on a mission to build a world-class platform across the Midwest, Southwest, and Western United States through its 'Buy & Build' strategy. This strategic hire underscores RapidFire's commitment to leveraging experienced leadership to navigate the complexities of expansion in the competitive fire, life safety, and security industries. title: Clarion Partners Invests in Bozeman, Montana with Highmark Development
content_encoded_text: Clarion Partners, LLC, a prominent real estate investment manager, has entered the Bozeman, Montana market through a partnership with Wentworth Property Company to develop Highmark. This new 162-unit townhome and apartment community is situated in a Qualified Opportunity Zone on over 8 acres within the South University District. Highmark, which began leasing in April 2025 and is set for completion by late 2025, aims to provide high-quality rental housing in one of the U.S.'s fastest-growing micropolitan areas. The development offers a diverse range of housing options, from single-bedroom apartments to three-story townhomes, catering to both families and students. Its strategic location less than half a mile from Montana State University and under two miles from Downtown Bozeman enhances its appeal. Jason Glasser, Managing Director at Clarion Partners, highlighted Bozeman's unique combination of outdoor lifestyle and growing education and technology sectors as key factors in the investment decision. Highmark's units are designed with modern amenities, including 10-ft ceilings, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and private outdoor spaces for townhomes. The community also features a clubroom, fitness center, and over 300 parking spaces, among other amenities. This project represents Clarion Partners' commitment to investing in areas with high growth potential and addressing the critical need for affordable housing. Clarion Partners' portfolio includes significant investments in Qualified Opportunity Zones and neighboring submarkets, underscoring its strategy to leverage tax incentives for community development. With over $73 billion in assets under management, the firm continues to expand its footprint in promising real estate markets across the U.S. and Europe. title: Bestselling Comedy Ebook 'Jewish Thighs on Broadway' to Be Free for Two Days on Amazon
content_encoded_text: Jewish Thighs on Broadway: Misadventures of a Little Trouper,' a bestselling comedy ebook by Penny Orloff, will be available for free on June 25 and 26, 2025, at Amazon. The ebook has achieved bestseller status in several categories, including Comedy, Biographies of Comedians, Humorous Literary Fiction, and Theatre Biographies. The book offers a unique perspective on the glamorous yet challenging world of showbiz, revealing the realities behind the public personas of celebrities. Orloff's work is described as a quirky, funny first-person story based on slightly fictionalized true events involving famous people. It has been compared to 'The Devil Wears Prada' for its mix of celebration and revenge, targeting the sparkling profession with a dark underside. Orloff's novel features an oddball immigrant family, on-again-off-again lovers, diets from Hell, and a Rogue's Gallery from the Showbiz underworld, ensuring laughter on every page. The ebook version will be available for free at Amazon . The book has received acclaim from notable figures and reviewers alike. Metropolitan Opera Leading Tenor Jacques Trussel praised it as 'ravishingly descriptive and continuously entertaining,' while Theater Puget Sound's review highlighted its 'wonderfully evocative language, lots of humor, tears where they belong.' Amazon reviewers have also lauded the book for its humor and larger-than-life characters. This limited-time offer provides an opportunity for readers to explore the humorous and insightful world of 'Jewish Thighs on Broadway,' shedding light on the complexities of the performing arts industry through Orloff's engaging narrative. title: New Book Sheds Light on the Realities of Moving Abroad Solo After 60, as Portugal Tops List for US Expats
content_encoded_text: With an increasing number of Americans contemplating a move abroad, Portugal has become the premier destination for US expats, attributed to its affordable living costs, hospitable culture, and relaxed way of life. Barbara Grassey's latest publication, 'American Expat: Moving Abroad Solo After 60,' delves into the authentic experience of relocating to a foreign country later in life, blending humor, sincerity, and practical advice. The book, which officially launched on June 24th on Amazon , provides a behind-the-scenes look at the process of starting anew in Portugal, beyond the idealized portrayals often seen on social media. Grassey describes the journey as less about the glamour of travel and more about the realities of adaptation, stating, 'It's not so much Eat, Pray, Love — it's more Move, Panic, Adapt.' This narrative is particularly relevant as more Americans, driven by factors such as political unrest, financial considerations, and the pursuit of a better quality of life, are choosing to relocate abroad. The book serves as a resource for those in the midst of or considering such a transition, offering guidance on visas, financial planning, and the emotional aspects of moving abroad, alongside insights into daily life in Portugal. 'American Expat: Moving Abroad Solo After 60' is not just a memoir but a tool for those looking to reinvent their lives, especially women over 50, who represent a significant portion of this demographic shift. Grassey's work underscores the message that reinvention is achievable at any stage of life, with the right mix of community support and personal curiosity. Available in both paperback and ebook formats on Amazon , Grassey's book is a testament to the growing trend of Americans seeking fulfillment and adventure beyond their home country's borders. title: Dr. Wade Newman: A Lifetime of Dedication to Healthcare and Community Service
content_encoded_text: Dr. Wade Newman has established a legacy of service, leadership, and compassionate healthcare through his extensive career as a dental professional, military officer, and humanitarian. With over two decades of experience, Dr. Newman's work transcends the confines of his dental practice, Eagle Valley Family Dentistry, reflecting a deep commitment to improving lives both locally and globally. Beginning his journey with a Bachelor of Science in Administration of Justice from Penn State University, Dr. Newman initially served as a police officer, showcasing his early dedication to community welfare. His transition into dentistry was marked by academic and clinical excellence, earning his Doctorate of Dental Surgery from West Virginia University School of Dentistry in 2000. A mission to Guatemala during his dental studies ignited a lifelong passion for humanitarian work, leading him to volunteer with organizations like Mission of Mercy and Give Kids a Smile, providing essential dental care to underserved populations. Dr. Newman's military service as a Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Air National Guard further exemplifies his commitment to service, including critical missions such as delivering dental care in Bani Bangou, Africa. His philosophy that healthcare is a calling has guided his efforts to make a tangible difference in the lives of those he serves. In an effort to support the next generation of healthcare professionals, Dr. Newman recently introduced the Dr. Wade Newman Grant for Healthcare Students. This initiative offers financial assistance to undergraduate students pursuing healthcare-related fields, encouraging them to reflect on the experiences that inspired their career paths. Applications for the grant are open until September 15, 2025. Beyond his philanthropic and military contributions, Dr. Newman has held significant roles in organized dentistry, including President of the Pennsylvania Dental Association. At Eagle Valley Family Dentistry, which he co-leads with his son, Dr. Newman continues to provide patient-centered care, embodying his ideals of compassion and excellence. His career is a testament to the vital role dedicated professionals play in enhancing community health and inspiring future leaders in healthcare. title: Global Study Highlights Growing Mismatch in Ecosystem Services Supply and Demand
content_encoded_text: A recent global study has shed light on the increasing disparities between the supply and demand of four critical ecosystem services: food production, carbon sequestration, soil conservation, and water yield. Published in Environmental Science and Ecotechnology, the research provides a detailed analysis of these trends from 2000 to 2020, utilizing satellite data and multi-model coupling to offer a pixel-level view of global changes. The findings indicate a general trend towards surplus in food production and soil conservation, yet highlight alarming deficits in carbon sequestration and water yield, particularly in densely populated or industrialized regions. The study identifies climate change and human activities as the primary forces behind these mismatches, with human influence more pronounced in food production and carbon sequestration, and climate variability more impactful on soil conservation and water yield. Dr. Wei Wu, the corresponding author, emphasizes the importance of understanding the interaction between climate change and human activities for developing effective land-use and conservation strategies. The study's insights are crucial for policymakers and conservationists, offering a foundation for targeted interventions to address ecological mismatches in a warming and increasingly crowded world. title: SocialPilot Releases Data-Backed TikTok Strategy Guide to Demystify Platform Engagement
content_encoded_text: SocialPilot has introduced a comprehensive TikTok Strategy Guide, derived from the analysis of over 1.5 million posts, aiming to shed light on effective engagement strategies for the platform. This guide emerges as TikTok's influence on content discovery and commerce continues to grow, offering marketers a data-driven approach to navigate its complexities. The research uncovers several key findings, including the optimal posting frequency of 6-15 times per week for maximum engagement, the importance of caption length with 101-200 characters yielding higher engagement rates, and the effectiveness of using 1-5 hashtags for better reach. Additionally, it highlights the dominance of short videos under 30 seconds in shares and visibility, despite the rising popularity of long-form content. Jimit Bagadiya, Co-Founder and CEO of SocialPilot, emphasized the guide's role in simplifying the digital marketing landscape for agencies, creators, and brands. Tejas Mehta, Co-Founder, added that the guide aims to reduce the guesswork and burnout associated with keeping up with TikTok's fast-evolving trends by providing clear, actionable data. The guide has quickly gained traction among industry professionals, trending on LinkedIn and being adopted by leading marketers. SocialPilot plans to release more platform-specific reports, reinforcing its commitment to empowering small teams with data to compete effectively in the digital arena. SocialPilot's initiative underscores its position as a key resource for marketing teams, offering not just tools for social media and review management but also strategic insights to drive decision-making. The TikTok Strategy Guide is available for free, furthering SocialPilot's mission to level the playing field for agencies and brands in the digital space. title: Caregivers Prioritize Communication Technology in Senior Living Job Decisions
content_encoded_text: The senior living industry is witnessing a significant shift in workforce expectations, with caregivers increasingly inquiring about the availability of specific communication technologies during job interviews. This trend underscores the importance of modern tools in attracting and retaining staff in a sector grappling with severe staffing shortages. According to a 2023 Nationwide study, 96% of assisted living communities report workforce challenges, making the adoption of caregiver-friendly technology a critical factor in staffing strategies. Greg Robertson, SVP and General Manager at Notify, a healthcare software company, highlighted the growing preference for smartphone-based caregiver communication tools. Operators have shared that new hires specifically ask if Notify is in use, preferring it over traditional methods due to its ease of use and efficiency. This preference is rooted in the stark contrast between outdated equipment, such as pagers and walkie-talkies, and modern smartphone applications that consolidate all alerts and communications into a single platform. The shift towards unified communication platforms like Notify not only enhances caregiver satisfaction but also improves operational efficiency. By routing all alerts—nurse call and life safety—to one smartphone app, caregivers can coordinate responses more effectively without the need to carry multiple devices. This modernization effort is particularly relevant as the population aged 85 and older is projected to grow to 19 million by 2060, necessitating the adoption of technologies that can support adequate care teams. With less than 30% of senior living organizations retaining over 80% of new staff after one month, the role of technology in staff retention cannot be overstated. The ability to replace bulky, outdated equipment with a single smartphone has been well received by caregivers, making their daily tasks smoother and more manageable. Furthermore, the detailed reporting and analytics provided by platforms like Notify offer leadership insights into caregiver responses, ensuring that their contributions are fully recognized and valued. As the senior living industry continues to evolve, meeting the technological expectations of the workforce will be paramount in addressing staffing shortages and ensuring the delivery of high-quality care. The adoption of advanced communication tools represents a step forward in modernizing care delivery and simplifying operations, ultimately benefiting both caregivers and the seniors they serve. title: Creative Biolabs Advances mRNA Therapeutics with Comprehensive Solutions
content_encoded_text: The biotech industry is witnessing a significant leap forward in mRNA therapeutics, thanks to Creative Biolabs' innovative end-to-end solutions. The company's full-stack mRNA platform is designed to tackle historical challenges such as stability, delivery, and scalability, paving the way for groundbreaking treatments in immunotherapy, gene therapy, and beyond. Creative Biolabs offers a one-stop mRNA therapeutics development service, incorporating advanced modifications like nucleoside tweaks and capping technology to enhance translational accuracy and shelf life. This is crucial for the global distribution of mRNA-based treatments. The platform spans a wide range of applications, including mRNA for immunotherapies, gene therapies, protein replacement therapies, regenerative medicine, therapeutic antibody-coding mRNA, pharmacology optimization, and vaccine development. Among its standout offerings is the custom sARNA synthesis service, which leverages self-amplifying RNA to produce more protein per dose. This innovation reduces production costs and increases efficacy, making it particularly suitable for vaccines and oncology applications. Clients simply need to provide the gene name or sequence, and Creative Biolabs handles the rest, from codon optimization to mRNA synthesis and purification. Another breakthrough is the targeted LNP synthesis platform, which addresses the limitations of traditional lipid nanoparticles in reaching difficult immune cells. Creative Biolabs' engineered nanoparticles can deliver payloads directly to HIV reservoir cells and cancer targets, achieving remarkable results in viral reactivation. To ensure the reliability of mRNA therapeutics development, Creative Biolabs has implemented a series of safety and efficacy assessments. This commitment to quality is underscored by the company's participation in key industry events, such as the 5th Oligonucleotides for CNS Summit and the 16th World Bispecific Summit, where it shares insights and fosters collaborations. For those interested in the latest advancements in hybrid mRNA vaccine design, Creative Biolabs offers an on-demand webinar on EABR nanoparticles as a platform technology. This resource provides valuable knowledge on combining nanoparticle engineering with the versatility of mRNA. Creative Biolabs is at the forefront of the mRNA revolution, offering the tools and expertise needed to transform bold scientific concepts into real-world solutions. Its comprehensive services and commitment to innovation are setting new standards in the development of mRNA therapeutics. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Creative Biolabs Advances Liposome Technology for Enhanced Drug Delivery
content_encoded_text: Liposomes, spherical lipid bilayer vesicles, are emerging as a revolutionary drug delivery mechanism capable of transporting both hydrophobic and hydrophilic molecules. Creative Biolabs has positioned itself as a leader in this field, offering comprehensive lipid-based delivery services tailored to diverse client requirements. The company's LipoDrive™ Platform, alongside microfluidics technology, ensures precise liposome and nanoparticle formation, achieving consistent particle sizes and encapsulation efficiency. To address the challenges in drug development, Creative Biolabs has engineered various liposome types, including conventional, PEGylated, and cationic liposomes. These innovations aim to enhance biologic stability and release profiles, catering to the pharmaceutical industry's needs. The application of liposomes spans anticancer therapies, vaccines, and gene delivery systems, offering improved drug solubility, stability, and targeted delivery with minimized off-target effects. Creative Biolabs' commitment to liposome research and development is evident in its broad spectrum of services and products. From biomedicine to agriculture, the company provides liposome-based solutions for drugs, cosmetics, and veterinary medicine. This versatility underscores the potential of liposomes to transform therapeutic approaches across multiple sectors. The biopharmaceutical industry's rapid evolution has amplified the significance of liposome technology. Creative Biolabs is at the forefront of this advancement, dedicated to meeting the industry's pressing demands and fostering medical progress. title: Lake Tahoe Storm Tragedy Highlights Need for Boating Safety and Legal Accountability
content_encoded_text: The sudden and severe storm that hit Lake Tahoe on June 21, 2025, resulted in a tragic boating accident, leaving six dead and two missing, highlighting the unpredictable dangers of lake conditions and the critical need for preparedness and legal accountability. The Wagner Law Group has announced the opening of an Injury Hotline for victims of the storm, which brought high winds and large waves, causing a 27-foot Chris Craft vessel to capsize with approximately 10 people on board. According to reports, the storm conditions escalated quickly, with winds exceeding 30 knots and waves over 8 feet, catching many boaters off guard. The U.S. Coast Guard and multiple agencies responded to the scene, rescuing two individuals who were hospitalized, while the condition of the missing persons remains uncertain due to the cold water temperatures and overnight snow levels dropping to 8500 feet. Buth Wagner, Personal Injury Lawyer and Founder of The Wagner Law Group, emphasized the importance of examining the facts to determine accountability and prevent future tragedies. The firm, known for securing significant settlements for accident victims, including boating accidents, is offering legal support to those affected by the storm. The incident raises questions about boating safety practices and the responsibility of individuals and entities in ensuring safe conditions on the water. The aftermath of the storm is still being assessed, with potential for additional casualties and property damage. The Wagner Law Group's expertise in personal injury and wrongful death cases positions them to assist victims in navigating the legal complexities following such disasters. The firm's commitment to advocating for victims' rights underscores the broader implications of the tragedy for boating safety and legal accountability in the face of natural disasters. title: Medicus Pharma Ltd. Advances Non-Invasive Treatment for Basal Cell Carcinoma
content_encoded_text: Skin cancer, particularly basal cell carcinoma (BCC), represents a significant health challenge in the United States, with over 5 million cases diagnosed annually. The current standard treatments involve surgical procedures, which, while effective, leave a gap for non-surgical alternatives. Medicus Pharma Ltd. (NASDAQ:MDCX) is addressing this unmet need with its innovative SkinJect microneedle patch, a non-invasive treatment that delivers chemotherapy directly to tumor cells, potentially revolutionizing BCC care. The SkinJect patch utilizes dissolvable microneedles to administer doxorubicin, a chemotherapeutic agent, directly to the affected area, aiming to kill tumor cells and stimulate an immune response to prevent recurrence. This method promises a less painful and more convenient treatment option compared to traditional surgery. Preliminary results from Phase I trials have shown promising safety and tolerability, with Phase II trials currently underway to further assess efficacy. Medicus Pharma's approach could significantly impact the $15 billion BCC treatment market by offering a cost-effective, less invasive alternative. With the potential to reduce treatment costs and wait times, SkinJect represents a significant advancement in skin cancer care. Additionally, the company is exploring applications beyond human medicine, including treatments for squamous cell carcinoma in horses, highlighting the broad potential of its technology. Investor interest in Medicus Pharma has been bolstered by its strategic initiatives, including the acquisition of Antev Ltd. and a recent $7 million public offering to fund ongoing clinical trials. These developments underscore the company's commitment to expanding its portfolio and advancing its innovative treatments. As Medicus Pharma continues to progress through clinical trials, its work could herald a new era in the treatment of skin cancer, offering hope to millions of patients worldwide. title: ABVC BioPharma Strengthens Investment in AiBtl BioPharma with Equity Conversion and Future Funding Commitment
content_encoded_text: ABVC BioPharma, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, has announced the conversion of a $100,000 convertible note into 10,000 shares of common stock in AiBtl BioPharma Inc. at a conversion price of $10 per share, backed by an independent third-party valuation. This move underscores ABVC's commitment to AiBtl, with plans to invest up to $20 million over time to support AiBtl's licensing obligations and collaboration with global pharma partners for Phase III development. The strategic investment aligns with ABVC's capital-light strategy, focusing on innovative partnerships through licensing and equity models. AiBtl holds exclusive rights to ABVC's CNS drug candidates, ABV-1504 and ABV-1505, under a licensing agreement that includes equity, milestone payments, and royalties. This partnership not only strengthens AiBtl's pipeline advancement but also positions ABVC to benefit from future revenues. Dr. Uttam Patil, ABVC Chief Executive Officer, emphasized the company's dual role as both licensing partner and anchor investor, highlighting the investment's role in AiBtl's success and ABVC's financial prospects. The collaboration between ABVC and AiBtl represents a significant step forward in the development of botanical-based therapeutics for CNS disorders, with a focus on Asia-Pacific markets and potential global partnerships. This development is crucial as it highlights the growing importance of strategic investments in the biopharmaceutical sector, particularly in the development of innovative treatments for CNS disorders. The commitment of up to $20 million by ABVC not only provides AiBtl with the necessary resources to advance its drug candidates but also reflects confidence in the potential of botanical-based therapies to address unmet medical needs. title: MultiRater Surveys and HR.com Partner to Enhance Employee Development Programs
content_encoded_text: The collaboration between MultiRater Surveys, a cloud-based leadership survey provider, and HR.com, the largest network of human resources professionals, marks a significant step forward in employee development programs. This partnership is set to offer HR.com members access to an automated employee feedback tool, designed to foster cutting-edge leadership and employee development initiatives. HR.com's mission to elevate competence, confidence, leadership, and job performance among HR professionals worldwide is bolstered by this alliance. With over 2 million HR professionals relying on HR.com for career advancement, the integration of MultiRater Surveys' innovative tools is expected to significantly enhance the quality of leadership development programs available to them. MultiRater Surveys specializes in customizable leadership and employee surveys, enabling organizations to tailor development programs that meet their specific needs. The inclusion of AI-powered MyMentor Insights further allows for the implementation of interactive online leadership development programs across all levels of management without the need for additional resources. The urgency for such initiatives is underscored by findings from the DDI Global Leadership Forecast 2023, which revealed a stark gap in leadership quality and readiness within organizations. With only 40% of managers confident in their company's leadership quality and a mere 12% of organizations prepared to fill critical leadership roles, the need for effective development programs has never been more critical. Debbie McGrath, Chief Instigator and CEO of HR.com, emphasized the transformative potential of this partnership. By providing HR professionals with accessible and innovative tools, the collaboration aims to address the evolving challenges of the future workplace, ensuring the development of strong leadership pipelines within organizations. This partnership represents a practical solution to the barriers of cost and time that often hinder the implementation of effective leadership programs. By offering a cost-effective and timely approach to leadership development, MultiRater Surveys and HR.com are setting a new standard for employee development programs, making it feasible for organizations to extend these opportunities to all levels of management. title: Comcast Expands High-Speed Internet Access to Paola and Hillsdale, Kansas
content_encoded_text: Comcast has successfully expanded its next-generation network to Paola and Hillsdale, Kansas, connecting more than 4,000 homes and businesses to reliable, high-speed, symmetrical Internet. This significant development not only enhances the digital infrastructure of the region but also promotes economic growth and positions residents and local businesses for success in an increasingly digital world. The expansion introduces a range of services from Xfinity and Comcast Business, including Internet, mobile, entertainment, and security services, to the area for the first time. The completion of this project marks a milestone for Miami County, as highlighted by Janet McRae, Economic Development Director for Miami County. McRae praised Comcast's dedication to safety during the construction process and expressed optimism about the new opportunities this expansion will bring to the community. The project, celebrated with a ribbon-cutting event at Paola's Town Square, also saw Comcast donating $2,500 to My Father's House, a local nonprofit dedicated to assisting the underserved rural population. Randi Shannon, City Manager of Paola, and April Damron, Executive Director of the Paola Chamber of Commerce, both emphasized the importance of high-speed Internet as essential infrastructure. They highlighted how this expansion will improve access, foster economic growth, and enhance the quality of life for residents and businesses alike. Comcast's state-of-the-art network is designed to support the needs of today's constantly connected world, offering multi-gigabit Internet speeds, 99.9 percent reliability, and built-in security features. For consumers, Comcast's residential services under the Xfinity brand now offer a full suite of products, including Internet, video, mobile, voice, and home security. Businesses can benefit from Comcast Business's comprehensive solutions tailored to help organizations of all sizes achieve their goals. Beyond infrastructure, Comcast is committed to increasing economic mobility in the community through programs like Internet Essentials, which provides eligible households with low-cost, high-speed Internet and affordable computers. This expansion represents a significant investment in the future of Paola and Hillsdale, bridging the digital divide and setting the stage for innovation, entrepreneurship, and an improved quality of life for the community. title: NOA Lithium's Fresh Water Discovery at Rio Grande Project Signals Major Advancement
content_encoded_text: The discovery of a fresh water source by NOA Lithium Brines Inc. at its 100%-owned Rio Grande Project in Argentina's Lithium Triangle represents a critical milestone in the project's development. This finding is particularly significant in the arid regions of the Lithium Triangle, where water is as scarce as it is essential for lithium brine projects. The strategic location of this water source, near areas with the highest lithium concentration, could streamline the development of production facilities and evaporation ponds, potentially reducing both capital and operating costs. Gabriel Rubacha, NOA's Chief Executive Officer, emphasized the importance of this discovery, noting its alignment with the company's preliminary assessment for locating a production facility. The water well, drilled to a depth of 190 meters, is situated in the northern section of the project, close to identified high lithium concentration areas. This discovery is one of three fresh water targets at Rio Grande, indicating potential for further water resource expansion. NOA Lithium's strategic position in the Lithium Triangle, with over 140,000 hectares across three prospective salars, places it among industry leaders in one of Argentina's most mining-friendly jurisdictions. The company's progress, including this water discovery and the upcoming Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) in Q3 2025, underscores its potential to become a significant lithium producer. With global lithium demand on the rise, driven by electric vehicle adoption and energy storage needs, NOA's advancements at the Rio Grande Project highlight its emerging role in the lithium supply chain. title: FDA Approval of Keytruda® in Head and Neck Cancer Highlights Potential for Gedeptin® Combination Therapy
content_encoded_text: The recent U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of Keytruda® (pembrolizumab) for the treatment of resectable, locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) has significant implications for the development of combination therapies, including GeoVax Labs, Inc.'s Gedeptin®. This approval not only marks a pivotal advancement in the treatment of head and neck cancer but also validates the therapeutic approach behind GeoVax's Gedeptin® development program, which seeks to combine the targeted cytotoxicity of Gedeptin® with the systemic immune activation provided by checkpoint inhibitors like pembrolizumab. An editorial in the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM) highlighted the study leading to the FDA's approval as the first to demonstrate the benefits of PD-1 inhibition in the curative setting for HNSCC, suggesting a shift in neoadjuvant immunotherapy paradigms. GeoVax is leveraging this development by planning a Phase 2 clinical trial of Gedeptin® in combination with a checkpoint inhibitor for patients with locally advanced HNSCC scheduled for curative-intent surgery. The trial, expected to commence in 2026, will assess pathologic response, recurrence rates, and immunologic changes, aiming to optimize patient outcomes through a biomarker-driven approach. David Dodd, Chairman and CEO of GeoVax, remarked on the significance of the FDA approval and NEJM publication, stating that it heralds a new era in curative-intent cancer therapy. The combination of Gedeptin® therapy with pembrolizumab is anticipated to not only enhance local tumor eradication but also to stimulate systemic anti-tumor immunity, potentially reducing both local and distant recurrence. Dr. Kelly McKee, GeoVax’s Chief Medical Officer, added that Gedeptin's tumor-targeted cytotoxicity could improve the efficacy of immunotherapy, especially in the perioperative period, where priming anti-tumor immunity is crucial. Gedeptin®, a gene-directed enzyme prodrug therapy (GDEPT), delivers a cytotoxic agent selectively within the tumor microenvironment, offering dual cytotoxicity and immune modulation with minimal systemic exposure. With Orphan Drug Designation from the FDA for the treatment of oral and pharyngeal cancers, Gedeptin® represents a promising avenue for enhancing the effectiveness of checkpoint inhibitors and overcoming tumor immune resistance in solid tumors. The initiative is expected to improve scalability, EBITDA margins, and position the company to seize strategic opportunities in the digital health services market. title: Axim Biotechnologies Seeks FDA CLIA Waiver for Lactoferrin Diagnostic Test
content_encoded_text: Axim Biotechnologies, Inc. has taken a significant step towards broadening the accessibility of its Lactoferrin diagnostic test by filing a Pre-Submission with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Waiver. This move is aimed at facilitating the diagnosis and monitoring of Aqueous Deficient Dry Eye Disease (ADDE) by enabling the test's administration in non-laboratory settings. The TearScan Lf test, already FDA 510(k)-cleared, is designed to measure Lactoferrin levels in tears, which are indicative of lacrimal gland function. Reduced Lactoferrin levels are found in 80% of ADDE patients, making this test a crucial tool for distinguishing ADDE from other forms of Dry Eye Disease and avoiding ineffective treatments. The potential CLIA Waiver would allow ophthalmologists and optometrists to administer the test without the need for CLIA certification, significantly expanding its clinical use. The Pre-Submission process is a preliminary step that allows Axim to engage with the FDA to clarify regulatory expectations and minimize potential delays in the formal waiver application process. Following FDA feedback, the company plans to conduct a comparative clinical study to support its CLIA Waiver Application, with submission expected later this year. The FDA's review of the application is typically completed within 90 days. Catalina Valencia, CEO of Axim Biotechnologies, emphasized the importance of this milestone in the company's strategy to enhance the accessibility of its diagnostic tests. The achievement of a CLIA Waiver for the Lactoferrin test, and subsequently for the IgE test, is anticipated to revolutionize the diagnosis of Dry Eye Disease and ocular allergies, offering earlier and more accessible diagnostic options. This development is expected to unlock significant commercial opportunities in the U.S. market and position TearScan Lf as a leading diagnostic tool in the Dry Eye Disease segment. title: Venmo QR Codes Drive Contactless Payment Revolution in Business Transactions
content_encoded_text: The surge in Venmo QR code adoption underscores a significant shift in how businesses and consumers engage in transactions, leveraging the convenience and security of contactless payments. With the QR code payment market on track to hit $51.58 billion by 2032, Venmo's innovative approach is setting a new standard in the mobile payments ecosystem. In 2024 alone, Venmo transactions saw an 8.9% increase year-over-year, highlighting the growing preference for wallet-free commerce solutions. Edrian Ostulano, PR and Communications Manager at QR TIGER, emphasizes the transformative impact of QR code-based payments on the customer experience, combining speed, safety, and convenience. This technology not only simplifies transactions but also fosters a higher level of trust and transparency between businesses and their customers. With over 2 million U.S. sellers now accepting Venmo and 65% of users actively scanning payment QR codes, the platform's influence is undeniable. The widespread availability of QR scanners on smartphones has played a pivotal role in this shift, with 91% of iOS and 86% of Android devices equipped to handle QR code transactions. Venmo's QR code payment feature, introduced in 2017, has become a cornerstone of the U.S. mobile payments landscape, inspiring other platforms like Apple Pay and Google Pay to integrate similar functionalities. Businesses are finding Venmo QR codes particularly beneficial, as they eliminate the need for specialized hardware and allow for instant payments through unique QR codes generated for each business profile. These codes can be printed on various materials or shared digitally, offering flexibility and ease of use. The integration of social notifications further enhances the payment process, providing instant confirmation without the hassle of manual checks. Security remains a top priority, with Venmo QR codes incorporating instant verification, PIN or biometric security, and end-to-end encryption to protect every transaction. This combination of speed, security, and scalability makes QR codes an attractive option for businesses looking to modernize their checkout processes and cater to the evolving preferences of consumers. As the global user base for QR code payments is expected to surpass two billion by 2025, the potential for further adoption across various sectors is immense. QR TIGER's insights into the explosive growth of Venmo QR codes highlight the broader movement towards contactless, efficient, and secure payment methods, marking a new era in business transactions. title: URAA Capitalizes on Surging Uranium Demand Driven by AI and Nuclear Energy Growth
content_encoded_text: The demand for uranium is witnessing a significant surge, fueled by the growing interest in artificial intelligence (AI) and the global push towards nuclear energy as a cleaner alternative. This trend is underscored by the U.S.'s reliance on imported uranium, with only a minimal fraction being produced domestically. The Trump administration's executive order declaring a national energy emergency and the allocation of $2.7 billion in congressional funding to revive domestic fuel production for nuclear power plants mark pivotal steps towards reducing this dependency. According to the World Nuclear Association, uranium demand is projected to increase by 28% from 2023 to 2030, with a further 51% rise anticipated between 2031 and 2040. This surge is attributed to the construction of new nuclear plants and the operational lifespan of existing ones. The Financial Times reports that uranium prices have reached an all-time high, with enriched uranium prices hitting $190 per separative work unit, a stark increase from $56 three years ago. This price hike is partly due to big tech firms prioritizing nuclear power for their energy needs. Trade tensions, particularly the proposed 10% U.S. tariff on Canadian energy products, including uranium, could further inflate global uranium prices. Cameco's CFO, Grant Isaac, highlighted this concern in a recent earnings call, noting the potential for significant price inflation in the uranium market. With 27% of the U.S.'s uranium imports coming from Canada, the implications of such tariffs are profound. The global nuclear energy sector is expanding, with 61 plants under construction and over 300 proposed, as reported by Bloomberg. This expansion necessitates a steady supply of uranium, positioning uranium mining stocks as a critical component of the energy sector's future. Direxion’s Daily Uranium Industry Bull 2X Shares (URAA) offers investors a leveraged ETF option to capitalize on the uranium mining industry's growth, albeit with inherent risks due to its leveraged nature. The intersection of AI's energy demands and the shift towards nuclear energy underscores the strategic importance of uranium. As the U.S. and other nations navigate the complexities of energy independence and environmental sustainability, the uranium market's dynamics will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of global energy. title: HSR Backs ZWIA's Updated Zero Waste Hierarchy to Promote Sustainable Resource Management
content_encoded_text: The Zero Waste International Alliance (ZWIA) has unveiled Version 8.1 of the Zero Waste Hierarchy, a critical framework for sustainable resource management, with the support of Happy Stan’s Recycling Services Ltd. (HSR). This update introduces refined principles and definitions aimed at guiding organizations, governments, and communities toward more sustainable practices. Key enhancements in the updated hierarchy include the strengthened Do Not Export Harm principle, which addresses the responsible management of hazardous materials, and the introduction of a new Do No Harm principle to minimize negative social and environmental impacts. Additionally, the update provides clearer definitions for terms such as circular economy , closed-loop systems , composting , and recycling , facilitating a more consistent global application. Jamie Kaminski, Chair of the ZWIA Zero Waste Hierarchy Working Group and President of HSR, emphasized the hierarchy's role in ensuring global alignment with the term 'Zero Waste.' Gary Liss, Chair of the ZWIA Certifications Committee, and Richard Anthony, President of ZWIA, highlighted the hierarchy's importance in addressing current issues like chemical recycling and advancing toward a circular economy. HSR's commitment to aligning its services with these updated standards underscores the company's dedication to responsible and ethical material handling. The full release and updated version of the Zero Waste Hierarchy are available for further exploration, offering a structured approach to waste prevention and material recovery that prioritizes systemic change toward sustainability. title: IotaComm® Relocates Corporate Headquarters to Chapel Hill, Enhancing IoT Innovation
content_encoded_text: IotaComm, Inc., a leader in next-generation wireless communications and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, has announced the relocation of its corporate headquarters to 200 West Franklin Street in Chapel Hill, North Carolina. This move underscores the company's dedication to building a nationwide wireless carrier specifically designed for the IoT, leveraging secure, carrier-grade connectivity and smart infrastructure applications to foster intelligent, efficient, and affordable communication between buildings and cities. Terrence DeFranco, Chairman and CEO of IotaComm, emphasized the strategic importance of the relocation, highlighting Chapel Hill's world-class talent pool, vibrant innovation ecosystem, and shared values around sustainability, technology, and education. The new headquarters, located in a premier Class A creative office space, offers proximity to the University of North Carolina (UNC) campus and Chapel Hill Transit routes, facilitating access to a rich pipeline of research and student talent. The relocation is a pivotal step in IotaComm's expansion strategy, supporting the nationwide deployment of its LoRaWAN® network and the commercialization of its Delphi360™ platform. This platform is instrumental in digitizing building systems, providing real-time insights into air quality, energy use, and asset performance. With a strong foothold in the education sector, IotaComm is poised to extend its impact into manufacturing, hospitality, and government sectors, addressing the growing demand for scalable connectivity and actionable data. Hastings Jones, Vice President at CBRE, welcomed IotaComm to the Chapel Hill business community, noting the strategic advantages of the new location for scaling high-growth technology companies. Despite the move, IotaComm remains committed to its operations in Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania, where it continues to invest in smart manufacturing initiatives and community engagement through its IotaCommUnity programs. This strategic relocation not only positions IotaComm for national growth but also aligns with its mission to drive innovation in IoT and smart infrastructure, leveraging the Research Triangle's ecosystem of talent and innovation to deliver value to customers, communities, and shareholders. title: Brera Holdings PLC Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Share Split to Regain Nasdaq Compliance
content_encoded_text: Brera Holdings PLC (NASDAQ: BREA), an Ireland-based international holding company with a focus on a multi-club ownership strategy in global sports, has announced a 1-for-10 reverse share split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares. This strategic move, effective June 26, 2025, is designed to comply with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement, ensuring the company's continued listing on the exchange. The reverse split, approved by shareholders and the board, will adjust the number of Class A shares from approximately 6.3 million to 633,800 and Class B shares from 17.8 million to 1.78 million, while increasing the nominal share value from $0.005 to $0.05. The implications of this announcement are significant for investors and the company alike. By consolidating shares, Brera Holdings aims to enhance the stock's marketability and appeal to a broader range of investors, potentially leading to increased liquidity and a more stable stock price. This move is a critical step in the company's broader strategy to strengthen its financial foundation and pursue growth opportunities in the global sports industry, particularly in football (soccer) and other sports clubs. The company's focus on social impact through sports underscores its commitment to not only financial success but also contributing positively to communities worldwide. For more details on the reverse share split and its implications, investors are encouraged to review the full press release available here . This development marks a pivotal moment for Brera Holdings as it seeks to navigate the challenges of the public market while advancing its ambitious goals in the sports sector. Based in Providence, Rhode Island, Beeline Holdings is expanding its digital lending platform across the nation, backed by a Net Promoter Score above 80, indicating high customer satisfaction. This growth not only validates the effectiveness of Beeline's AI-driven approach but also sets the stage for future expansion and innovation in the mortgage sector. title: AI Misinformation Surge Amid Israel-Iran Conflict Highlights Digital Warfare Risks
content_encoded_text: The conflict between Israel and Iran has not only escalated tensions in the Middle East but has also triggered a wave of artificial intelligence (AI)-generated misinformation, complicating the digital landscape. Since Israel's attacks on Iran last week, the internet has been inundated with misleading content aimed at distorting the reality of the conflict. This includes efforts to enhance Iran's image and the dissemination of outdated footage by pro-Israel accounts, falsely indicating widespread Iranian public support for Israel against their own government. This phenomenon underscores the growing role of AI in digital warfare, where misinformation can be weaponized to influence public opinion and international perceptions. The situation highlights the urgent need for advanced digital literacy and robust fact-checking mechanisms to combat the spread of false information. Companies specializing in digital media and AI, such as Thumzup Media Corp. , are at the forefront of addressing these challenges, though the scale of misinformation presents a daunting task. The implications of this AI-driven misinformation are far-reaching, affecting not only the immediate geopolitical tensions but also setting a concerning precedent for future conflicts. The ability to quickly generate and spread false narratives poses a significant threat to global security and the integrity of information online. As the digital arena becomes an increasingly contested space, the international community must grapple with the dual challenges of safeguarding free expression while preventing the abuse of technology to manipulate truth. title: InMed Pharmaceuticals Reports Promising Preclinical Results for Alzheimer's Treatment
content_encoded_text: InMed Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ: INM) has unveiled promising preclinical data for its drug candidate INM-901, demonstrating significant potential in addressing neuroinflammation, a key factor in Alzheimer's disease progression. The findings reveal that INM-901 effectively reduces pro-inflammatory cytokines and inflammasome markers, such as IL-6, IL-1β, IL-2, KC/Gro, and NLRP3, in ex vivo models. This reduction was observed to be dose-dependent and statistically significant, offering hope for a novel approach to treating neurodegenerative diseases. What sets INM-901 apart is its mechanism of action, which operates independently of the amyloid beta or tau pathology traditionally targeted in Alzheimer's research. This suggests a broader applicability in treating neurodegenerative conditions beyond Alzheimer's. Additionally, the compound, which is orally administered, has shown promising results in improving cognition and behavior in long-term animal studies, further underscoring its therapeutic potential. InMed Pharmaceuticals is now focused on advancing INM-901 through additional preclinical and Investigational New Drug (IND)-enabling studies, with Alzheimer's disease as the lead indication. The company's commitment to addressing diseases with high unmet medical needs is evident in its strategic pipeline development, which includes programs targeting ocular and dermatological indications alongside Alzheimer's. The implications of these findings are significant, as they open new avenues for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and potentially other neurodegenerative disorders. With the global prevalence of Alzheimer's expected to rise, the development of effective treatments is more critical than ever. InMed's progress with INM-901 represents a hopeful step forward in the fight against this debilitating disease. This news story relied on content distributed by None . A key objective of this partnership is the installation of a D-Wave Advantage2 system at Yonsei University's International Campus in Songdo, Incheon. The collaboration aims to foster mutual research efforts, talent development, and the exploration of quantum computing applications in fields such as biotechnology and materials science. The MOU underscores the commitment of all parties to advancing quantum computing technology and its practical applications. By leveraging D-Wave's expertise and technology, Yonsei University and Incheon City are poised to play a pivotal role in South Korea's quantum computing landscape. This partnership not only enhances the region's research and educational infrastructure but also positions South Korea as a burgeoning hub for quantum computing innovation. title: MNK and Mongolia HD TV Forge Strategic Partnership to Enhance Cultural and Business Ties
content_encoded_text: MNK has announced a strategic partnership with Mongolia HD TV, Mongolia's leading broadcasting network, to develop marketing solutions for Korean and global brands looking to enter the Mongolian market. This collaboration, formalized in Ulaanbaatar, brings together MNK's global marketing expertise and Mongolia HD TV's innovative content production and distribution capabilities. Under the leadership of CEO Khureltulga, Mongolia HD TV has become a powerhouse in the Mongolian media landscape, successfully localizing international formats like Shark Tank and The Voice. The network's multi-platform approach, including traditional TV and OTT services, along with a strong digital presence, has made it a key player in engaging both local and diaspora audiences. The partnership proposes collaborative content projects involving influencers from Korea and Mongolia, aiming to produce culturally resonant content with global appeal. MNK's Executive Director of Global Marketing, Kim Jin-soo, highlighted the potential of this initiative to strengthen cultural and business ties between the two countries. Furthermore, MNK plans to leverage its network of over 2,300 client companies and Mongolia HD TV's media infrastructure to unlock new marketing and distribution opportunities. This strategic alliance is expected to enhance the Korean Wave's presence in Central Asia, offering tailored content that reflects Mongolian audiences' evolving tastes. MNK, a Seoul-based Data-Driven Global Total Marketing Solution company, brings to the table over a decade of experience in combining data analytics with creative strategies. Specializing in 3D, VR, and AR media production, MNK is poised to deliver immersive and innovative marketing solutions through this partnership. This collaboration not only signifies a milestone in cross-border content creation but also sets a precedent for future cultural and commercial exchanges between Korea and Mongolia, promising mutual growth and enhanced visibility for both parties in the global market. title: Creative Biolabs Enhances Neuroscience Research with Cutting-Edge Electrophysiology and Electrode Chip Technologies
content_encoded_text: Electrode chip technology and calcium signaling are pivotal in neuroscience research, facilitating the precise monitoring and stimulation of neuronal activity. These technologies are instrumental in neural interfaces, brain-machine interactions, and disease modeling, contributing to neurotherapeutic advancements. Creative Biolabs is at the forefront, providing researchers with high-performance tools to explore neuronal activity and solutions for therapeutic development. A scientist at Creative Biolabs highlighted the importance of calcium assays in measuring pharmacological agents and their effects on calcium signaling pathways. The company's calcium assay is versatile, capable of handling various samples, including cultured neurons, brain slices, and purified cells from different nervous system regions, as well as samples from animal models or human cell lines. The company's advanced electrophysiology platform allows for the real-time recording of neuronal electrophysiological activity over extended periods. This capability is crucial for drug efficacy analysis, high-throughput drug screening, and neural cell network research. The platform employs the latest system to ensure stable and consistent electrophysiological results, with customizable processes that guarantee experimental accuracy and flexibility to meet specific research requirements. Beyond electrophysiology, Creative Biolabs' electrode chip platform incorporates advanced microfluidic techniques to support neuroscience research. These techniques include cell capture and sorting, where electric fields are used to control, capture, sort, and purify cells directly, enhancing experimental efficiency. Additionally, organ chips integrate metal electrodes and customized microfluidic components to replicate living organisms' microenvironments, facilitating the culture and study of cells, tissues, and organs under physiologically relevant conditions. Creative Biolabs is dedicated to providing specialized solutions to meet the dynamic needs of neuroscience researchers. Its innovative technologies are designed to empower scientists with the tools necessary for groundbreaking discoveries in neuropharmacology. For more information on their electrode chip technology and neuroscience research applications, visit https://microfluidics.creative-biolabs.com/ . content_encoded_text: The journey of Krystle Skin, a high-performance skincare brand, is a testament to the power of financial insight and visionary planning. 'He helped me realize that building something lasting required more than creativity, it required clarity, planning, and long-term vision,' Kelley reflects on the impact of their discussions. Today, Krystle Skin stands as a brand that merges skin science with intention, elegance, and modern wellness. Each product is formulated with natural, results-driven ingredients and infused with gemstones, offering a modern ritual for those seeking both effectiveness and elevation in their beauty routine. Kelley's work at Westlake Aesthetics and Wellness as a Licensed Laser Technician and Medical Aesthetician further underscores her commitment to combining clinical expertise with a restorative approach to skincare. The story of Krystle Skin is not just about the creation of a skincare brand but about the importance of financial literacy and self-trust in entrepreneurship. Kelley's journey highlights how foundational elements like faith, structure, and a clear desire to serve can pave the way for building a legacy. As Krystle Skin continues to unfold, its foundation of clarity, vision, and intention promises a future where beauty and business thrive together. title: Shifa Therapy Launches Global Platform Connecting Muslims with Culturally Competent Therapists
content_encoded_text: Shifa Therapy has introduced a groundbreaking online platform aimed at bridging the gap in mental health services for Muslims around the globe. This initiative provides a secure and straightforward way for individuals to connect with qualified Muslim therapists for online counseling sessions that respect Islamic beliefs and cultural values. The challenge of finding mental health support that aligns with one's cultural and spiritual values is a significant barrier for many Muslims. Issues such as language barriers, stigma, and a lack of culturally competent care often deter individuals from seeking the help they need. Shifa Therapy's platform is designed to overcome these obstacles by offering a directory of Muslim therapists, flexible scheduling, and multilingual options, ensuring that services are accessible to a diverse Muslim population. Ibrahim Hamid, CEO of Shifa Therapy, emphasizes the importance of creating a space where individuals feel understood not just clinically but also spiritually and culturally. The platform's launch is a step toward making mental health support more accessible and less intimidating for those who have felt marginalized by traditional therapy models. Affordability is a cornerstone of Shifa Therapy's mission, with therapy sessions starting from just $57. This pricing strategy is aimed at making mental health care accessible to underserved communities, ensuring that financial constraints do not prevent individuals from receiving the support they need. Shifa Therapy's services are particularly relevant in today's global context, where Muslims in countries like the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom face unique challenges, including Islamophobia and identity struggles. The platform offers a supportive environment for individuals dealing with these issues, providing nonjudgmental, affirming care that is rooted in both cultural understanding and clinical expertise. By offering flexible, affordable plans and operating in multiple languages and time zones, Shifa Therapy is making mental wellness more accessible to Muslims worldwide. Individuals seeking faith-sensitive mental health support can now easily book a therapy session through the Shifa Therapy website, receiving professional care from the comfort of their homes. title: Ferrari's Racing Legacy Celebrated with 1958 250 Testa Rossa Recreation in Ron Sturgeon Collection
content_encoded_text: The addition of a 1958 Ferrari 250 Testa Rossa recreation to the Ron Sturgeon Collection marks a significant moment for automotive enthusiasts and historians alike. This vehicle, a faithful homage to one of Ferrari's most iconic racing cars, embodies the spirit of an era when Ferrari dominated the world of motorsport. The original 250 Testa Rossa was pivotal in securing Ferrari the 1958 Manufacturers' World Championship, thanks to its advanced design and powerful Colombo Tipo 128 V-12 engine. This recreation, built on a 1982 Ferrari 400i chassis, features hand-shaped aluminum bodywork that meticulously replicates the original's design, including its distinctive pontoon-style fenders and rear fairing. Powered by a Dino-sourced V6 engine and a five-speed manual transmission, it offers a driving experience that closely mirrors the visceral thrill of the original. Ron Sturgeon, founder of the DFW Car & Toy Museum, praises the recreation for capturing the essence of the Testa Rossa, from its elegant design to its championship-winning soul. The Ferrari 250 Testa Rossa recreation is more than just a collector's item; it is a testament to the enduring legacy of Ferrari's golden age of racing. Its inclusion in the Ron Sturgeon Collection not only celebrates the historical significance of the original but also ensures that the passion and craftsmanship of that era continue to inspire future generations of car enthusiasts. content_encoded_text: TLC Tender Lawn Care has announced the expansion of its services to include mosquito, tick, and flea treatments for homeowners and business owners in the Winston Salem area, including Jamestown, Clemmons, and other towns in North Carolina. This move comes in response to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) warnings about a significant increase in diseases transmitted by these pests. The new pest control services aim to transform lawns into safe havens, free from the nuisance and health risks posed by mosquitoes, fleas, and ticks. The company offers customizable pest control packages that begin with a comprehensive property assessment to determine the most effective treatment plan. These plans may include perimeter pest control, grub control, and other tailored solutions, all designed to provide long-term relief from pests. TLC Tender Lawn Care is fully licensed by the North Carolina Department of Agriculture and Consumer Affairs, ensuring that all treatments meet state regulations and safety standards. In addition to pest control, TLC Tender Lawn Care continues to provide a range of lawn care services, including grass seeding, fertilizing, weed control treatments, and lawn aeration. The company prides itself on over 30 years of experience in delivering quality lawn care solutions, emphasizing customer service, honesty, and excellence. Guests can also enjoy the exclusive Secret Garden restaurant, offering gourmet dinners with alfresco, waterside seating, and easy access to Fort Lauderdale Beach and Las Olas Boulevard. The hotel's General Manager expressed enthusiasm about welcoming discerning travelers and boat show guests, highlighting the property's unparalleled location and serene ambiance as key attractions. With limited availability expected during FLIBS week, potential guests are encouraged to book early to secure their stay at this iconic hideaway. Recognized as the 'Best Small & Exclusive Hotel in North and South America' by Condé Nast Johansens 2025, The Pillars Hotel & Club continues to uphold its reputation for personalized service and elegant accommodations. This reopening not only revitalizes the hotel's tradition of boutique hospitality but also enhances the FLIBS experience for attendees seeking luxury and convenience. content_encoded_text: Punyam Academy Pvt. Ltd. has announced the launch of its new ISO 37001:2025 Lead Auditor Training course as an online e-learning program. The course covers all ISO 37001:2025 requirements in detail, guiding participants through the full internal auditing process. Key topics include anti-bribery risk management, the standard's documented information requirements, internal audit procedures, and corrective action processes under the updated standard. Core course modules provide an overview of ISO 37001:2025, risk management in an anti-bribery context, and the internal audit process, among others. Participants will benefit from expert audio-visual lectures, real-world examples, and downloadable handouts for in-depth study. The course also includes a comprehensive ISO 37001:2025 audit checklist with over 300 aligned questions to support learners in applying their knowledge. Designed for working professionals, management students, and individuals looking to enhance their careers, the course offers flexible access to materials and repeated review options until the final exam is passed. A free demo of the course is available on the Punyam Academy website, allowing prospective learners to preview the content and platform before enrolling. title: Shift in Heart Disease Deaths Highlights Progress and New Challenges
content_encoded_text: Over the past 50 years, the landscape of heart disease mortality in the United States has undergone a profound transformation. According to a study published in the Journal of the American Heart Association, while heart disease remains the leading cause of death, the types of heart disease fatalities have shifted significantly. The research highlights a 66% decrease in overall age-adjusted heart disease death rates and a nearly 90% drop in heart attack deaths since 1970. However, this progress is juxtaposed with an 81% increase in deaths from other forms of heart disease, including heart failure, arrhythmias, and hypertensive heart disease. The study, which analyzed data from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, found that in 1970, more than half of all heart disease deaths were due to heart attacks. By 2022, this figure had dropped to less than one-third, while deaths from other heart conditions rose to account for nearly half of all heart disease fatalities. This shift reflects the success of public health measures, medical advancements, and life-saving interventions that have improved early diagnosis and treatment, allowing individuals to live longer with chronic heart conditions. Dr. Sara King, the study's first author, emphasized the importance of these findings, noting the medical community's success in managing heart attacks but also the emerging challenge posed by the rise in other heart conditions. The study points to several factors contributing to this shift, including advancements in medical therapies, public health policies, and an aging population. Despite these advancements, the prevalence of risk factors such as obesity, Type 2 diabetes, and hypertension has increased, underscoring the need for continued focus on prevention and healthy aging. The American Heart Association's Life's Essential 8 health measures are highlighted as a key strategy for reducing heart disease risk factors. These measures include improving diet, increasing physical activity, quitting tobacco, and managing weight, cholesterol, blood sugar, and blood pressure. The study's authors call for a renewed focus on preventing heart disease and supporting healthy aging to address the evolving burden of heart conditions. This research underscores the dynamic nature of heart disease mortality and the importance of adapting public health and medical strategies to meet changing challenges. While significant progress has been made in reducing deaths from heart attacks, the rise in other forms of heart disease presents new obstacles that require innovative solutions and continued commitment to heart health. title: Kavalan Distillery's Solist Fino Sherry Wins Whisky of the Year at 2025 International Whisky Competition
content_encoded_text: The International Whisky Competition Committee announced the results of its 16th edition, with Kavalan Distillery's Solist Fino Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky taking the top honor as Whisky of the Year. This achievement is notable as it marks the first time a non-Scottish distillery has won the competition's highest accolade, highlighting the global diversity and excellence in whisky production. The competition, known for its rigorous and impartial judging process, evaluated entries using a strict double-blind tasting format. Kavalan's winning whisky scored an impressive 97.04 points, praised for its balance and complexity. The distillery also earned the title of Distillery of the Year, with an average score of 92.78 points across its entries. Mr. Yu-Ting Lee, Chairman of King Car Kavalan, expressed pride in the achievement, stating it reaffirms Taiwan's position in the whisky world. The tasting notes by Adam Edmonsond, Master of Whisky, described the Solist Fino Sherry as bursting with fruity and nutty aromas, followed by a rich palate and a lingering finish. Other notable winners included Dewar's Double Double 21 Years Old as Best Blended Scotch Whisky, Aultmore® Oloroso Sherry Cask GTR 25 Years Old as Best Single Malt Scotch Whisky, and A. Smith Bowman Cask Strength (Batch #4) as Best American Whiskey. The competition's results underscore the high standards and diversity of the global whisky industry. title: Clive Davis to Receive 2025 Avon Theatre Lifetime Achievement Award
content_encoded_text: The Avon Theatre Film Center has announced that Clive Davis, a monumental figure in the music industry, will be the recipient of the 2025 Avon Theatre Lifetime Achievement Award. This honor recognizes Davis's unparalleled influence on music and culture over the past sixty years, highlighting his role in discovering and nurturing some of the most iconic artists in history. Clive Davis's career is a testament to his visionary leadership and dedication to artistic excellence. As a five-time Grammy Award winner and Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductee, Davis has been instrumental in the careers of legends such as Whitney Houston, Bruce Springsteen, and Aretha Franklin. His ability to identify and develop talent has not only shaped the music industry but also enriched the global cultural fabric. The award ceremony, scheduled for October 14, 2025, at the Avon Theatre - Deborah & Chuck Royce Cinema Arts Center in Stamford, Connecticut, will feature a retrospective of Davis's career and tribute performances. This event underscores the Avon Theatre's commitment to celebrating individuals whose work has a lasting impact on the arts and society. Peter H. Gistelinck, Executive Director of the Avon Theatre, praised Davis for his resilience and creative risk-taking, qualities that resonate with the theatre's values. Deborah and Chuck Royce, founders of the Avon, expressed their enthusiasm for honoring Davis, whose passion for storytelling and innovation aligns with the theatre's mission. The Avon Theatre Lifetime Achievement Award is a prestigious accolade that acknowledges the profound influence of artists and cultural figures. Previous recipients, like Michael Douglas, have been recognized for their contributions to film, television, and advocacy. By honoring Clive Davis, the Avon Theatre continues its tradition of inspiring future generations through the arts. Proceeds from the event will support the Avon Theatre's nonprofit initiatives, including independent cinema programming and educational outreach. This celebration of Clive Davis's legacy not only honors his past achievements but also ensures the continued vitality of the arts in the community. Key features of the BMP AI Chatbot include 24/7 conversational engagement for personalized customer service, seamless order routing to automate the handoff from guest queries to kitchen operations, supplier integration to minimize delays and errors across the supply chain, and team collaboration tools to improve internal flow with real-time staff messaging. NeuralBase AI is already developing the next version of the chatbot, which will introduce advanced analytics for operational insights, multi-channel support including voice and messaging apps, and enhanced automation for inventory, scheduling, and procurement. title: FAA Policy and Global Demand Fuel Growth in Drone-Focused Stocks
content_encoded_text: The commercial drone industry is poised for a major expansion, transitioning from a niche hobby to an essential tool across various sectors including agriculture, defense, and public safety. With the global commercial drone market expected to grow from $10.2 billion in 2023 to over $35 billion by 2030, the sector is benefiting from regulatory approvals, technological advancements, and wider adoption by enterprises and governments. In the United States, the FAA's anticipated finalization of Part 108, which enables Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) drone operations, is set to remove significant barriers to scalability. This regulatory change, coupled with geopolitical tensions and national security concerns, is accelerating investment in domestic drone capabilities, highlighting the strategic importance of drones in modern infrastructure and defense. ZenaTech (Nasdaq: ZENA) is at the forefront of transforming traditional land survey and field service operations into scalable, drone-powered platforms through its Drone as a Service (DaaS) model. The company's strategy of acquiring and modernizing traditional service providers has led to a 92 percent year-over-year revenue increase in the first quarter of 2025, showcasing the potential of drone technology to revolutionize industry workflows. Ondas Holdings (NASDAQ: ONDS) is making strides in autonomous drone innovation, with its Optimus System securing a $14.3 million order from a major defense customer. The company's regulatory head start and strategic partnerships position it as a key player in the autonomous aerial systems market, particularly in defense and public safety applications. Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO) is leveraging its 25 years of experience in unmanned systems to meet the rising demand for modular drone platforms in defense and public safety. Recent developments, including a border-focused drone pilot program, underscore the company's role in advancing drone technology for high-stakes environments. AgEagle Aerial Systems (NYSE: UAVS) is benefiting from regulatory tailwinds and international partnerships, particularly in the agriculture sector. The company's financial turnaround and strategic alliances, such as with India-based Vyom Drones, highlight its potential in the global drone market. As the drone sector enters a new era of utility and scale, these companies represent the forefront of innovation and growth, driven by regulatory advancements and increasing global demand. The implications of these developments extend beyond the stock market, signaling a transformative shift in how industries and governments leverage drone technology for efficiency, security, and sustainability. title: Accredited Solutions, Inc. Launches TEL-CDR Token to Revolutionize Telecom Settlements
content_encoded_text: Accredited Solutions, Inc. (OTC: ASII) has announced the launch of TEL-CDR, the official utility token of the CDRChain ecosystem, marking a significant advancement in the telecommunications industry. This blockchain-based platform aims to revolutionize the settlement of voice and SMS traffic by introducing a more efficient, transparent, and automated process. TEL-CDR will function as the primary transactional and governance medium within CDRChain, facilitating settlements between telecom carriers, MVNOs, infrastructure providers, and messaging aggregators. Eduardo Brito, CEO of Accredited Solutions, emphasized the transformative potential of TEL-CDR, stating it represents a new paradigm in telecom service clearing and settlement. The token is not merely a cryptocurrency but a foundational element for a global system that prioritizes trust, speed, and automation. With an initial issuance of $50 million, TEL-CDR is built on a scalable and eco-friendly blockchain architecture, offering functionalities such as settlement payments, platform governance, staking incentives, and partner access rights. The initiative promises to level the playing field for small and mid-sized telecom providers by enabling them to settle and trade with the same transparency and speed as larger players. Accredited Solutions plans to announce the official token launch and pre-launch dates shortly, encouraging interested parties to visit https://cdrchain.ai/ for more information and to join the waiting list. A detailed white paper is also available at https://cdrchain.ai/utility-token , outlining the token's structure and functionality. In addition to the TEL-CDR announcement, Accredited Solutions addressed shareholder concerns regarding a potential reverse stock split, indicating it is not currently anticipated. The company's strategic moves, including the rescission of the Globetopper acquisition and focus on blockchain initiatives, have reduced its reliance on traditional capital markets. Proceeds from the TEL-CDR token offering are expected to support infrastructure and platform expansion, potentially avoiding further dilution and enabling the reacquisition of convertible preferred stock. This development underscores Accredited Solutions' commitment to leveraging blockchain technology to modernize global telecom infrastructure, offering a decentralized solution that could become the industry standard for telecom settlements. The launch of TEL-CDR represents a pivotal moment for the company and the telecom sector, heralding a new era of efficiency and transparency in digital transactions.
