title: AFC Asia Frontier Fund Wins the Emerging Market Equity Award at the AsianInvestor Asset Management Awards 2025
content_encoded_text: Hong Kong, 24th May 2025, Asia Frontier Capital Ltd. is pleased to announce that the AFC Asia Frontier Fund has been awarded at the AsianInvestor Asset Management Awards 2025 as the best performing fund in the category Emerging Market Equity. Co-Fund Manager Ruchir Desai and Marketing Director Peter de Vries received the award at the award presentation ceremony at the Ritz Carlton in Hong Kong on the 22 nd May 2025. When asked about winning the award, Ruchir Desai, Co-Fund Manager of the AFC Asia Frontier Fund commented: “ This achievement reflects the strength of our investment process and the tremendous growth potential in Asian frontier markets. We remain optimistic about the region’s outlook for 2025 and beyond, driven by monetary easing, earnings recovery, extremely attractive valuations, and a deep focus on economic reforms. We are grateful to our investors for their trust and to our team for its dedication to excellence. ” Thomas Hugger, CEO and Co-Fund Manager of the AFC Asia Frontier Fund, added: “We are deeply honoured to receive this recognition from AsianInvestor, which underscores our team’s commitment to delivering superior returns for our investors,” said Thomas Hugger, CEO and Fund Manager at Asia Frontier Capital. “Our focus on Asian frontier markets, combined with our value approach, has allowed us to uncover unique investment opportunities in some of the world’s most promising, but also overlooked economies by international investors. This award is a testament to the resilience and potential of these markets .” Marc Faber, Shareholder of Asia Frontier Capital, and publisher of the Gloom Boom & Doom report, said: “I am extremely happy that AFC Asia Frontier Fund has been awarded at the Asian Investor Asset Management Awards 2025 as the best performing fund in the category Emerging Market Equity. This award is well deserved because the AFC Asia Frontier Fund has a deep “value strategy”, which I fully support and focuses also on overlooked economies. It is great to see that at a time international investors have been negative about emerging economies, some courageous fund managers were able to unlock great value stocks in neglected markets”. Peter Ryan Kane, the CEO and founder at PerK Advisory, and a member of the panel of judges, said: The Fund had the right mix of performance, idiosyncratic strategy, and forward looking potential to merit the award. Longstanding stewardship of a process in a challenging market universe, with detailed and specific stock selection and an investor first mindset are hallmarks. About Asia Frontier Capital Limited and AFC Asia Frontier Fund: Asia Frontier Capital Ltd. is an independent investment management firm specialising in the high-growth frontier markets across Asia. With a disciplined, research-driven approach, the firm identifies undervalued companies with strong fundamentals and long-term potential. The flagship AFC Asia Frontier Fund offers investors exposure to a diversified portfolio of frontier market equities, benefiting from low correlations to developed markets and significant growth opportunities. The fund’s investment universe spans Bangladesh, Cambodia, Georgia, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Maldives, Mongolia, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Sri Lanka, Uzbekistan, and Vietnam. title: RYO Digital and GRNX Global Partner to Revolutionize Global Grain Trade with Blockchain Innovation
content_encoded_text: Tokyo, Japan, 26th May 2025, RYO Digital and GRNX Global have officially entered into a working agreement to redefine the global grain trading industry through blockchain technology. This strategic collaboration brings together RYO Digital’s next-generation digital payment ecosystem and GRNX Global’s GrainX Protocol grain tokenization platform, creating unparalleled efficiency, transparency, and accessibility in global commodity trading. Transforming Global Grain Trading The $1.6 trillion global agricultural commodities market has long been plagued by inefficiencies, slow transactions, and outdated financial systems. RYO Digital and GRNX Global are changing that by bringing decentralization, security, and frictionless payments to international grain trade. Through this collaboration: RYO Digital will serve as a trusted payment solution, offering lower costs, faster settlement, and enhanced security compared to traditional banking mechanisms. GrainX Global will facilitate a seamless, traceable, and smart-contract-driven marketplace for Canadian grain exports, particularly to Japan’s multi-billion-dollar beer brewing industry. GrainX Protocol will provide new financial tools to facilitate faster farmer payments and lower cost grain buyer inventory lending, which will strengthen the agriculture financial ecosystem. Blockchain-backed lending pools will revolutionize trade finance, ensuring liquidity and reduced risk for producers, buyers, and traders alike. A Groundbreaking Synergy This alliance represents a powerful integration between digital assets and real-world commerce. RYO Digital, a project built from Japan, and recognized for its compliance with Japan’s stringent regulations, provides a stable and secure means for commodity transactions, eliminating inefficiencies associated with fiat-based trade. Meanwhile, GRNX Global’s platform enables real-time settlement, automated contract execution, and verifiable supply chain transparency for grain producers and exporters. Disrupting Japan’s Agricultural Supply Chain Japan’s agricultural and brewing industries rely heavily on high-quality Canadian grain. Through this partnership: RYO Digital will enable Japanese buyers, including major brewing companies, to seamlessly purchase Canadian grain with instant, low-cost blockchain transactions. GRNX Global will ensure full traceability, smart contract settlements, and improved financial instruments to modernize international trade. The collaboration will support Japan’s push for blockchain adoption, ensuring compliance with financial regulations. Blockchain’s Role in the Future of Commodity Trading This partnership redefines how blockchain is applied to real-world industries. Beyond digital transactions, RYO Digital and GRNX Global are reshaping the way commodities are traded, financed, and settled. Real-World Utility: Unlike speculative cryptocurrency projects, GrainX Protocol is directly tied to real-world trade, creating measurable economic benefits for businesses and industries. Institutional-Grade Trust: By aligning with regulatory frameworks and integrating blockchain into established industries, RYO Digital, GRNX Global, and GrainX Protocol are positioned as the go-to digital asset for compliant and secure payments. Scalability & Growth: The model created through this partnership can be replicated across other commodity sectors, including oil, metals, and other agricultural exports. As part of their commitment to sustainable trade, RYO Digital and GRNX Global will explore blockchain-based carbon credit integration to incentivize eco-friendly agricultural practices. This initiative will enhance transparency in carbon trading while supporting greener supply chains. Executive Endorsement Anthony Diaz, Founder & Chairman of the RYO Project, stated: “This partnership with GRNX Global and GrainX Protocol is a game-changer. Together, we are not just integrating blockchain into commodity trading—we are transforming an entire industry. By bridging traditional markets with cutting-edge digital assets, we are creating real economic value, driving financial innovation, and setting a new global standard for efficiency, transparency, and accessibility in trade.” Jason Dearborn, CEO of GRNX Global, added: “Partnering with RYO Digital allows us to unlock the full potential of blockchain in the agricultural trade sector. The integration of digital assets into global grain trading is long overdue, and this initiative will be a game-changer for exporters, buyers, and financial institutions alike. GRNX Global is looking forward to working with such an innovative and respected global digital payment ecosystem partner.” About RYO Digital RYO Digital is a next-generation digital payment ecosystem designed to revolutionize global transactions by providing a compliant, efficient, and secure alternative to traditional financial systems. Built for mass adoption and real-world application, RYO Digital integrates cutting-edge blockchain technology with seamless payment solutions. www.ryocoin.com About GRNX Global GRNX Global is a Canadian partner-driven ecosystem committed to improving the financial outcomes for Canadian grain farmers and licensed grain buyers through integrated technology, services, and financing solutions. It is an innovative blockchain solutions provider focused on real-world asset tokenization, smart contract automation, and trade finance transformation. Through its flagship GrainX Protocol token, GRNX Global is pioneering the digitalization of agricultural commodity trading, enabling seamless cross-border transactions with blockchain technology. www.grnx.global About GrainX Protocol GrainX Protocol is a CeDeFi solution unlocking liquidity for the global grain trade by connecting onchain capital with real-world grain contracts, market data, and verified delivery records. Developed in partnership with GRNX Global, GrainX Protocol aims to become the financial layer for decentralized agricultural commerce. GrainX Protocol has recently opened their token seed round which is available to investors via a SAFT. www.grainx.fi For media inquiries, partnership opportunities, or additional information, please contact: RYO: pr@ryocoin.com www.ryocoin.com GRNX Global: Ken Jackson – kjackson@grnx.global www.grnx.global REVOLUTIONIZING THE FUTURE OF GLOBAL TRADE WITH THE POWER OF BLOCKCHAIN TECHNOLOGY.

title: Jessica Contreras Aims to Spark Tucson’s AI Revolution
content_encoded_text: Tucson, Arizona, 28th May 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , QUICK LOOK: Tucson native Jessica Contreras is turning her hometown into the next AI hotspot by teaming up with the University of Arizona through Vanport Technologies—blending academic brainpower and real-world data to tackle flood mapping and ignite a regional tech revolution. Jessica Contreras, a proud Tucson native, is on a mission to put her hometown on the map as a rising hub for artificial intelligence innovation. Through her newly launched venture, Vanport Technologies, Contreras is combining cutting-edge AI with the academic strength of the University of Arizona to create smarter, more effective AI solutions — starting with floodplain mapping. Contreras’ vision goes beyond improving environmental prediction models. By partnering with the University of Arizona, she hopes to plant the seeds of a thriving technology ecosystem in Tucson — one that mirrors the innovation and economic growth seen in Silicon Valley. Her plan is simple yet powerful: leverage the expertise of faculty and researchers while tapping into the fresh, bright minds of the university’s student body to develop AI solutions that address real-world challenges. “AI is evolving fast, but the key to making it smarter and more impactful lies in blending academic research with practical experience,” Contreras explains. “By working with the University of Arizona, we’re creating AI that doesn’t just calculate — it learns from experts and adapts to real-world conditions.” Vanport Technologies’ first major project — improving floodplain mapping — showcases this innovative approach. By integrating scientific data with AI systems that draw on the University of Arizona research, the company’s models go beyond standard rainfall-based predictions. Instead, they analyze factors like soil absorption, erosion, and infrastructure vulnerabilities to offer more precise, actionable insights that can help protect Tucson’s communities from flooding risks. But Contreras’ ambitions extend much further. She envisions Tucson evolving into a hotbed of AI innovation, where students, researchers, and industry leaders collaborate to develop world-changing solutions. “If we can cultivate an ecosystem where AI taps directly into higher education’s wealth of knowledge, Tucson can become a true leader in AI development,” she says. With her roots firmly planted in Tucson, Contreras’ venture is as much about giving back to her community as it is about technological progress. By creating opportunities for students and collaborating with academic leaders, Vanport Technologies is pioneering a new model for AI development — one that blends learning, technology, and practical experience to build a smarter, safer, and more innovative future for all. title: SALUTS Unveils Robot-Defined Operations at Web Summit Qatar: Pioneering Future AI Autonomy In-Space and On-Earth
content_encoded_text: Munich, Germany, 3rd June 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , SALUTS (formerly Salutes Space) a leader in decentralized AI and space-grade autonomy. As AI-driven autonomy reshapes industries, cyber threats and robotic risks are escalating. At Web Summit Qatar, SALUTS is set to showcase its groundbreaking Robot-Defined Operations, a next-generation framework designed to safeguard autonomous operations across space, defense, and critical infrastructure. SALUTS Forges Strategic Alliance to Pioneer Autonomous Systems In-Space and On-Earth Today, announced a strategic partnership with Unifiaccess , an industrial technology company in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. By combining SALUTS’ deep-tech expertise in ultra-low-power AI chips and secure satellite connectivity with Unifiaccess’ manufacturing scale and regional market insight, the alliance will deliver next-generation IoT, V2X and distributed surveillance solutions powered by space-based infrastructure — and co-develop the first German-Saudi IoT satellite constellation. Together, SALUTS and Unifiaccess will fast-track advanced IoT and V2X applications—from autonomous logistics fleets to distributed surveillance networks safeguarding critical infrastructure. A German-Saudi IoT Satellite Constellation Under SALUTS’ AstraDroid programme, the partners will co-develop and deploy a 16-satellite microsatellite constellation over the next decade. This network will provide global distributed systems, precise navigation and resilient communications for industrial operations, smart cities and defense platforms. Aligning with Regional Visions Saudi Vision 2030: Accelerating sustainability, smart-city deployments and Industry 4.0 with low-latency edge AI; empowering local talent through no-code platforms. UAE Innovation Vision: Bolstering the UAE’s Space Strategy 2030 via orbital autonomy; advancing AI Strategy 2031 with energy-efficient, resilient edge computing. Showcasing Robot-Defined Operations at Web Summit Qatar SALUTS’ Robot-Defined Operations Logo At Web Summit Qatar 2025, SALUTS unveiled its robot-defined operations framework, demonstrating two flagship innovations: CHIRB (Computing on Hybrid Interplanetary Relay Basis) – a natural-language AI control layer that bridges Web 2.0 and Web 3.0, enabling code-free, real-time automation across space, defense, industrial and smart-city environments. NEROnaut – a rugged, ultra-efficient Robot-on-Chip delivering on-device AI for instantaneous, resilient decision-making both in orbit and at the network edge. “Resilient autonomy is the next frontier,” said M. Sobhy Fouda, CEO & Founder of SALUTS. “By processing security telemetry on-chip, we eliminate latency and external vulnerabilities—ensuring satellites, UAVs and critical infrastructure detect and neutralize threats in real time.” Attendees responded enthusiastically to live demos of Saluts’ platforms, energy-efficient industrial computers and intelligent operations system in-space, land and sea. CHIRB: Intelligent Control for Autonomous Operations CHIRB stands for “Computing on Hybrid Interplanetary Relay Basis”. SALUTS’ CHIRB platform transforms mi ssion management by offering: Natural-Language Interface: Intuitive, code-free control and diagnostics via chat. Edge Processing: Sub-millisecond decisions on-device, independent of ground links. Plug-and-Play Integration: Seamless deployment across satellites, UAVs, industrial machinery and smart-city systems. Decentralized Security: Web 3.0-inspired architecture ensuring data sovereignty and built-in audit trails. Multi-Agent Coordination: Real-time orchestration of heterogeneous fleets—from orbital platforms to autonomous vehicles. Offline Resilience: Continuous operation in contested or disconnected environments, with self-healing routines. Revolutionizing AI Security with Robot-on-Chip At the heart of this pioneering approach is Robot-on-Chip, SALUTS’ proprietary decentralized AI technology. This innovation enables real-time, in-orbit, land and water data processing while ensuring cyber resilience against emerging robotic threats. SALUTS’ NEROnaut: Scalable Neuro-Evolving Robot On-chip embedded computer for Satellites, Defense, Drones, IoT and industrial robotics “As the CEO and Founder of SALUTS and the creator of Robot-on-Chip, my mission is to advance AI-driven autonomy while safeguarding human life from robotic risks. Our work is shaping the future of human-machine interactions, ensuring they are not only intelligent but also secure.” — M. Sobhy Fouda, CEO & Founder of SALUTS Robot-Defined Defense: Cyber-Resilient Autonomy Cyber-Proof AI for a Secure Autonomous Future AI systems are prime targets for cyber threats, rogue automation, and adversarial AI attacks. SALUTS’ Robot-on-Chip integrates advanced security layers to detect, isolate, and neutralize robotic threats in real time—ensuring mission-critical operations remain secure. Space-Grade Security for Defense & Industry 4.0 Autonomy must be unhackable. Robot-Defined Defense safeguards: Military UAVs & Satellites from cyber intrusion Autonomous Industrial Operations from adversarial AI attacks IoT & Smart Infrastructure from robotic system breaches Real-Time Threat Response with Robot-on-Chip Unlike conventional AI, Robot-on-Chip processes security data on-device, eliminating latency and man-in-the-middle vulnerabilities tied to Earth-based processing. This enables instant anomaly detection, autonomous countermeasures, and resilient AI decision-making in real time. SALUTS at Web Summit Qatar: Showcasing the Future of AI Security As part of its global mission to secure AI autonomy, SALUTS presented at Web Summit Qatar, one of the world’s leading technology gatherings. The event provides a platform for SALUTS to engage with investors, government organizations, and industry leaders, showcasing how Robot-Defined Defense is shaping the next generation of cyber-secure autonomy. The Next Frontier: Securing AI for the Autonomous Age The future is autonomous—but without security, autonomy is at risk. SALUTS is leading the charge to ensure AI-driven operations are not only smarter and faster but also invulnerable to cyber threats and robotic attacks. SALUTS: A New Name for a New Era With its rapid ascent on the global stage, Salutes Space has rebranded to SALUTS —symbolizing an expanded mission from orbital servicing to critical infrastructure, industrial automation and defense. “Our goal is to develop not only smarter but also more resilient and responsible AI—systems that learn, adapt and operate independently.” — M. Sobhy Fouda, CEO of SALUTS About SALUTS Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Weßling, Germany, with offices in London, Riyadh and Dubai, SALUTS delivers Space Infrastructure as a Service (SIaaS) through ultra-low-power AI chips, autonomous systems and secure satellite links. Its core platforms—CHIRB and NEROnaut—enable real-time, decentralized AI for applications ranging from orbital servicing to smart manufacturing, maritime autonomy and critical-infrastructure protection. A winner of the 2024 “Economics of the Future” award at the Entrepreneurship World Cup and a Top 100 finalist in 2023, SALUTS is committed to human-centered innovation, environmental stewardship, sustainable low-power design and ethical transparency. We invite investors, defense agencies, and technology leaders to join us in building a cyber-proof future. More Information: www.saluts.com SALUTS: as the risks associated with AI and robotics grow, the most effective countermeasure shall be to fight fire with fire—or rather, robots with robots digitally and physically. By deploying our Robot-on-Chip in intelligent machines, we can mitigate life 3.0 threats using the very technology that challenges us. Connect with Us Mobile: +49 173 3894760 Website: www.saluts.com

title: A New Blueprint for DeFi: How AKAS DAO Challenges the Status Quo
content_encoded_text: Denmark, Europe, 4th June 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , Decentralized Finance (DeFi) was once seen as a breakthrough toward democratizing finance — promising transparent, fair, and permissionless financial services. Yet the growing influence of capital forces has led many DeFi projects astray from their original vision. Ironically, some protocols have become new tools for centralized interest groups. In 2021, Olympus DAO pioneered the Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL) model, aiming to reduce liquidity dependence and improve the stability of DeFi ecosystems. While innovative, POL did not fully solve the problems of liquidity manipulation, especially when facing market volatility or whale attacks. This is where AKAS DAO steps in. From Vision to Mechanism: A Radical Response to DeFi’s Broken Promises AKAS DAO is not just patching up legacy frameworks — it rethinks DeFi from the ground up. From its inception, AKAS DAO set an ambitious and unwavering goal: eliminate capital privilege and rebuild a financial system rooted in fairness. To that end, AKAS DAO introduced a revolutionary global fair-launch mechanism — one that prohibits all forms of early access, insider deals, or bot sniping. Every participant, regardless of capital size, starts from the same level playing field. But even more importantly, AKAS executed a symbolic and technical milestone: permanent blackhole burn of all Genesis LP tokens. This hard-coded design cuts off all backdoors, ensuring that no entity can use “internal LP” tokens to manipulate liquidity. In simple terms — no pre-mining, no insider cash-outs, and no capital-powered governance. Not Just Tech — A Governance Revolution These aren’t just technical upgrades; they’re structural reforms. While most DeFi projects attempt to strike a delicate balance between fundraising efficiency and community fairness, AKAS DAO rips up the old rulebook — boldly redefining how power and incentives should be distributed. In an era plagued by broken promises, rug pulls, and centralization masquerading as decentralization, AKAS DAO enters the scene with a radical and timely solution. Its mechanisms and message are a direct response to the crisis of trust that DeFi faces today. Market Response & Future Potential Although AKAS DAO is still in its early warm-up phase, market observers have already taken note of its potential impact. Some believe that this mechanism design — which blocks privileged access from the very beginning — could usher in a new wave of governance structure reform across the entire DeFi ecosystem. It is not merely a call for “more decentralization,” but a real-world demonstration that DeFi can indeed be fair — if one is truly willing to sacrifice vested interests . Whether this model can be widely replicated remains to be seen. But AKAS DAO has undoubtedly presented a new direction worth serious consideration. The future of DeFi does not lie in more complex financial products, but in the practice of simpler and purer principles. What AKAS DAO is doing is returning to DeFi’s original promise: to hand power back to users, not capital. In this volatile and ever-changing crypto world, such conviction may well be the rarest asset of all. Centered on the AS token, it incorporates ten core mechanisms including staking, bonding, burn bonds, and resonance-based rewards — creating an anti-manipulation, transparent, sustainable, and belief-driven community-autonomous system. title: How Decodo Helps to Scale Data Collection for AI Agents
content_encoded_text: Vilnius, Lithuania, 4th June 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , Decodo, a leading platform for testing, launching, and scaling web data projects with proxy and scraping solutions, has introduced new tools and best practices to help companies scale data collection tailored for AI agent development. AI agents, from customer support bots to autonomous research assistants, are only as effective as the data they consume. For fast-growing businesses, the challenge isn’t just building the model. It’s collecting and maintaining high-quality data in real-time. Why scaling data collection matters Most AI projects fail not due to modeling limitations, but because of poor data infrastructure. Training AI agents requires a continuous stream of structured, relevant data that evolves together with user behavior. title: Christie Sikora’s BLOOD and GOLD Reexamines the Tragedy of Munich and the Global Politics Behind It
content_encoded_text: A powerful debut explores the human cost of conflict through one of the Olympics’ darkest chapters — based on factual truths Costa Mesa, CA, 16th June 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , In the summer of 1972, the world turned its attention to Munich for a celebration of unity, peace, and athletic excellence. Instead, it witnessed one of the most harrowing tragedies in Olympic history—an event that shocked international spectators and exposed decades of political neglect, unresolved conflict, and global indifference. In her debut work, BLOOD and GOLD: Athletes, Tragedies & Dynamism of Peace, Christie Sikora offers far more than a historical retelling. Based on factual truths, this compelling book uncovers the personal stories and suppressed narratives behind the Munich tragedy, delivering an empathetic and investigative journey into the heart of a political powder keg. “This isn’t just about what happened in Munich,” says Sikora. “It’s about what led there—and what the world has refused to acknowledge since.” Through emotional storytelling and sharp historical insight, BLOOD and GOLD asks: • What forces drove this moment in history? • What warnings were overlooked? • Who has borne the heaviest losses? • And how can we move toward peace — not just politically, but personally? Sikora challenges simplistic narratives of good versus evil, inviting readers to confront the deeper realities of displacement, propaganda, and global injustice. She holds all parties accountable while pointing to the possibility of healing through truth, empathy, and awareness. A portion of every sale supports humanitarian efforts: • A $0.25 donation goes to Doctors Without Borders, a nonprofit humanitarian organization providing urgent medical care worldwide. • A $0.25 contribution supports Dynamism to Peace International Foundation, which channels those funds to carefully selected nonprofit organizations serving traumatized children, women, and men in the world’s most vulnerable regions. About the Author Christie Sikora’s writing emerges from a place of deep moral courage and unwavering empathy. She refuses to turn away from the hard questions of war, justice, and memory — offering not just critique, but meaningful solutions. Her work urges readers to look beyond propaganda, to reconsider inherited perspectives, and to embrace a more unified, peaceful future. Why It Matters Now BLOOD and GOLD is a timely meditation on history’s unresolved trauma — and a call to action for today’s fractured world. As global conflict, polarization, and disinformation reach new extremes, this book offers clarity, compassion, and hope. Availability BLOOD and GOLD: Athletes, Tragedies & Dynamism of Peace is available at authorchristiesikora.com , Barnes & Noble, and select independent bookstores. Sikora will also host a series of in-person signings, virtual events, and global dialogues throughout the year. For media inquiries, interviews, or event bookings: www.evrimachicago.com

title: Stallard Kane Highlights Critical Workplace Safety Oversights in UK Businesses
content_encoded_text: Stallard Kane, a leading risk and compliance specialist, has brought to light several alarming workplace safety oversights observed during routine assessments across UK businesses. These incidents, ranging from the use of duct-taped hammers to plastic bags placed on active electric hobs, underscore the potential for minor neglect to escalate into serious accidents. The company's initiative aims to raise awareness about the importance of adhering to safety protocols, even in environments perceived as low-risk. Among the examples shared by Stallard Kane, one incident involved an employee unknowingly activating an electric hob by placing shopping bags on the counter, nearly causing a fire. Another highlighted the dangerous practice of using a metal knife to retrieve toast from a plugged-in toaster. These scenarios, along with others like frayed carpets posing trip hazards and overflowing bins leading to hygiene issues, illustrate the widespread nature of workplace safety oversights. According to a spokesperson from Stallard Kane, these incidents are indicative of broader issues such as lack of awareness, inadequate training, and cultures that underestimate the importance of addressing 'small' safety risks. The company stresses the need for proactive risk assessments, comprehensive employee safety training, and clear reporting mechanisms to mitigate these risks before they result in harm. Stallard Kane advocates for the establishment of a strong safety culture within organizations, emphasizing practical measures such as ensuring the availability of appropriate tools, maintaining clean and safe environments, and encouraging employees to report potential hazards. As a consultancy specializing in health and safety, HR, and employment law, Stallard Kane offers tailored services to help businesses achieve compliance and foster safer workplaces. title: Closed Zero-Day Market Offers Targeted Exploits for WhatsApp, Android, iOS, macOS, and Linux
content_encoded_text: New York, US, 5th July 2025, ZEX PR WIRE , A growing number of cybersecurity professionals are tracking a quiet but structured emergence of closed-access platforms offering highly targeted 0day vulnerabilities. One such site, 0dayvulnerabilities.com, claims to maintain a private repository of exploits focused on high-value systems, including mobile communication apps, operating systems, and enterprise-grade platforms. Recent threat intelligence chatter suggests that custom payloads are now being privately offered for sale in categories previously considered difficult to obtain — including mobile messaging platforms and Unix-based systems. While the market for Android and Windows exploits has been active for years, the inclusion of more specialized offerings marks a shift toward tailored offensive capabilities. Sources indicate that interest is especially high in tools to buy WhatsApp vulnerabilities , often targeting encrypted communication flows or remote execution vectors through media parsing. Several underground groups have reportedly leveraged such payloads to conduct targeted surveillance or obtain persistent access to mobile devices without alerting users or triggering detection tools. Similarly, the ability to buy Android vulnerabilities in private settings — especially those that enable privilege escalation or bypass of Secure Boot — is drawing attention from actors involved in both offensive research and counterintelligence operations. Analysts suggest that APT-grade Android exploits are now being sold with infrastructure-ready components, reducing setup time for attack deployment. Beyond mobile, the platform also appears to support offerings related to macOS, long viewed as a less common but increasingly attractive target. The option to buy MacOS vulnerabilities — especially those with kernel-level access or sandbox escape — presents new risks for organizations with mixed-device environments. Meanwhile, security experts tracking mobile threat vectors have also observed growing demand for anyone attempting to buy iOS zero day vulnerability . Due to Apple’s closed ecosystem and rapid patch cycles, private iOS exploits are among the most expensive and rarest in circulation. The inclusion of these on the platform could signal access to exploits previously seen only in government-level operations. Finally, Linux systems — often considered hardened and community-reviewed — are no longer immune to targeted intrusion. The ability to buy Linux vulnerabilities , particularly in container environments or remote daemon access, has started to emerge as a concern for enterprise defenders and DevSecOps teams. These exploits, when used effectively, can compromise critical infrastructure or cloud workloads without relying on phishing or user interaction. At the time of writing, the claims made by 0dayvulnerabilities.com remain unverified, but the platform’s structure, language, and observed presence in deep-web threat forums suggest a serious operational model rather than marketplace noise. title: Comfort Area Foundation Initiates Relief Fund for Texas Hill Country Flood Victims
content_encoded_text: The Texas Hill Country faced unprecedented devastation on July 4th, 2025, when catastrophic floods displaced families, destroyed homes, and overwhelmed local emergency services. In response, the Comfort Area Foundation (CAF), a nonprofit with a 25-year history of serving the region, has established the Comfort Flood Relief Fund. This initiative aims to provide immediate and long-term support to the affected communities, with a focus on Center Point, TX, and surrounding areas in Kendall and Kerr Counties, where the damage has been particularly severe. CAF's relief fund is designed to channel 100% of donations to vetted local nonprofits, ensuring that every dollar contributes directly to the recovery of flood victims, first responders, and rebuilding efforts. The foundation's approach underscores the importance of community-led recovery, as highlighted by Chris Havens, Board President of CAF, who remarked on the critical role of neighbors helping neighbors in small towns like Comfort. The recent floods have brought to light the significance of the Vision 2050 planning initiative, which included the installation of an early warning siren system in Comfort 18 months prior. This event not only tests the community's resilience but also reinforces the foundation's mission to build a stronger future for the Hill Country amidst environmental and growth challenges. Donations to the Comfort Flood Relief Fund can be made through https://comfortfloodrelief.com , offering a way for individuals to contribute to the recovery and rebuilding efforts. The foundation has also expressed gratitude towards volunteers, neighbors, and corporate partners like Charity Ace, Newsworthy.ai, BoosterHub, and USIO, who have played a pivotal role in organizing support and ensuring resources reach those in greatest need. Hennessey underscores the importance of authenticity, advising against the misconception that high-production content is necessary to connect with audiences. Instead, he highlights the effectiveness of simple, relatable content that resonates more deeply with consumers. A notable success story from CertaPro Painters involves partnering with influencers to authentically showcase their services, resulting in significant engagement and follower growth. Looking ahead, Hennessey points to social media management tools like Rallio as essential for franchise organizations aiming to scale their social media efforts efficiently. He also stresses the growing importance of local content, urging franchises to educate their teams on capturing and sharing experiences that reflect their unique markets. This strategy not only enhances brand integrity but also strengthens consumer connections beyond generic corporate messaging. This news story relied on content distributed by None . The company has outlined major initiatives in global motorsports, storytelling content, and branded facilities, aiming to leverage AI-driven live experiences to enhance how audiences interact with content. This strategic pivot not only underscores SEGG Media's commitment to ethical gaming and immersive fan engagement but also positions it as a leader in the digital transformation of sports and entertainment. The rebranding and strategic overhaul of SEGG Media Corporation signal a significant shift in the company's direction, from its origins as Lottery.com Inc. to a broader, more diversified entity in the global sports, entertainment, and gaming industries. This move reflects the company's ambition to capitalize on the growing demand for digital and interactive content, setting a new standard for how fans engage with their favorite sports and entertainment platforms. title: Roland Park Community Foundation Secures Future of Hillside Park with $9 Million Purchase
content_encoded_text: The Roland Park Community Foundation has successfully completed the $9 million purchase of Hillside Park, a 20-acre wooded hillside previously owned by the Baltimore Country Club. This acquisition concludes 25 years of dedicated planning and fundraising efforts by the community to secure the land for public use. The park, located along Falls Road opposite Poly and Western high schools, represents the first new park of comparable size in Baltimore since the establishment of Patterson Park in 1860. Unlike traditional city parks, Hillside Park will be owned and maintained by the Roland Park Community Foundation, a private non-profit organization. This arrangement ensures the park's availability to the public without imposing financial burdens on the city's budget. The foundation has announced that the park will be open to the public immediately, adhering to city park standards with access from dawn to dusk. A ribbon-cutting ceremony and celebration are scheduled for October 10, marking the official opening of Hillside Park. The foundation has also launched a website, https://www.hillsideparkmd.org , to promote the park and gather community support. This initiative underscores the foundation's commitment to enhancing civic amenities and preserving green spaces for future generations. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Former U.S. Sen. Benjamin Cardin Donates Political Papers to Johns Hopkins University
content_encoded_text: Former U.S. Senator Benjamin Cardin of Maryland has made a significant contribution to historical and political research by donating his political papers to Johns Hopkins University’s Sheridan Libraries and University Museums. This collection, encompassing nearly 60 years of Cardin’s legislative career, includes 255 boxes of physical material and 2.8 terabytes of digital content, offering invaluable insights into his work in the Maryland House of Delegates, the U.S. House of Representatives, and his three terms in the U.S. Senate. The donation was celebrated at a luncheon at Evergreen Carriage House, where Cardin emphasized the importance of making historical tools accessible to foster understanding and civic engagement, especially among young people. The collection primarily covers his Senate career from 2007 to 2024, highlighting his advocacy in areas such as health care, retirement savings, environmental protection, and civil rights. Notable topics within the collection include significant political events like the impeachment trials of Judge Walter Nixon and President Donald Trump, the ethics investigation of Newt Gingrich, and the COVID-19 pandemic. This donation not only preserves the legacy of Cardin’s public service but also serves as a resource for future generations to study the complexities of political leadership and policy-making. Johns Hopkins University’s role in curating and providing access to these materials underscores the institution’s commitment to education and research in political history and civic engagement. content_encoded_text: The collaboration between Integrated Pain Associates (IPA) and Lubbock Spine Institute (LSI) represents a pivotal development in the pain management sector, particularly for West Texas communities. This alliance is set to broaden the availability of minimally invasive procedures and therapies, offering patients alternatives to traditional surgeries and medication management. The partnership is seen as a conduit for advancing this clinical model, with both entities committed to delivering top-tier care. Elodie Day, CEO of IPA, pointed out the challenges many practices face in adopting these innovative treatments due to operational complexities and limited training access. The union with LSI is viewed as a catalyst for overcoming these barriers, furthering the paradigm shift in pain management. Dr. Bolkar Sahinler of LSI expressed enthusiasm for the partnership, noting the potential to create a platform where clinical excellence meets strategic innovation. The combined expertise of IPA and LSI is expected to yield significant benefits for patients and providers alike, fostering a healthcare environment that prioritizes effective, minimally invasive treatments. While the financial details of the transaction remain undisclosed, the involvement of investors like Florac and Star Mountain underscores the venture's potential impact. Legal advisories from DLA Piper and Manatt, Phelps & Phillips facilitated the partnership, ensuring a smooth collaboration between the two organizations. This partnership not only signifies a milestone in the evolution of pain management services but also underscores the importance of strategic alliances in healthcare. By leveraging their collective strengths, IPA and LSI are poised to make a lasting difference in the lives of patients across West Texas, offering hope and improved quality of life through advanced medical interventions. title: Universal Parking Expands Its Reach in Florida with New Contracts
content_encoded_text: Universal Parking has recently been awarded parking management contracts for two significant mixed-use developments in Florida, marking a notable expansion of its services in the state. The contracts include managing parking operations for The Central in Downtown St. Petersburg and Wynwood Plaza in Miami, both of which are pivotal in their respective communities for fostering local culture and economic growth. The Central, located at 1301 Central Ave, introduces 540 new parking spaces to St. Petersburg's EDGE District, a vibrant area known for its walkability and mix of office, retail, and recreational spaces. This development, which includes a 15-story hotel, an 11-story office tower, and affordable housing, benefits from Universal Parking's 24/7 operations and EV charging stations, ensuring accessibility and supporting the district's growth. In Miami, Wynwood Plaza stands as a 1 million square foot mixed-use campus designed to promote creativity and sustainability. With 645 parking spaces, the facility serves a 12-story office tower, luxury residences, and extensive retail and dining options. Universal Parking's collaboration with Evolution Parking and Guest Services aims to deliver a parking experience that mirrors the innovative spirit of Wynwood Place, enhancing the visit for tenants, residents, and visitors. Tim Walsh, President and CEO of Universal Parking, emphasized the company's commitment to improving parking operations and supporting the communities it serves. By facilitating easier access to these developments, Universal Parking plays a crucial role in attracting more people to live, work, and engage in these vibrant areas, thereby contributing to their long-term success and vitality. title: Hanover Company Launches Major Industrial Development in Baltimore-Washington Corridor
content_encoded_text: The Hanover Company has officially started the construction of a significant industrial complex in the Baltimore-Washington corridor, marking a pivotal development in the region's industrial sector. This project, consisting of two Class A industrial buildings, is set to transform the industrial warehouse landscape in an area that has been notably underserved, particularly in the Washington D.C. submarket. Located at 765 & 775 Crain Highway North, Gambrills, the development site boasts strategic logistical benefits, including easy access to Maryland Route 3 South, Interstate 95, the Port of Baltimore, BWI Airport, and the Baltimore metropolitan area via Interstate 97. Dan Gordon, Regional Development Partner at Hanover, highlighted the project's potential to leverage the region's connectivity and address the critical shortage of modern warehouse facilities in the D.C. market. The two buildings, Building 1 and Building 2, will offer a combined total of 387,463 square feet of space, featuring 36-foot clear heights, ample parking, and numerous dock and drive-in doors designed to meet the demands of modern logistics operations. John Kamerman, VP of CRE Finance at Comerica Bank, expressed enthusiasm about the partnership with Hanover, underscoring the project's role in fostering regional growth and innovation. With MGMA serving as the architect, Doyle Construction as the General Contractor, and Cushman & Wakefield handling marketing and tenant acquisition, the project is on track for completion by July 2026. David Hudson, President of Hanover’s Industrial Platform, praised the regional team's efforts and hinted at more industrial developments to be announced in 2025, signaling Hanover's commitment to expanding its industrial footprint across the nation. title: Holy Cross Health Launches Jon & Helaine Ayers Rehabilitation Center with Cutting-Edge Therapies
content_encoded_text: Holy Cross Health has officially opened the Jon & Helaine Ayers Rehabilitation Center, a renovated outpatient facility that introduces eight new pieces of state-of-the-art rehabilitation equipment, making it the only center in Broward County to offer such unique therapies. The center, which was made possible by a generous $2 million donation from Jon and Helaine Ayers, focuses on helping patients regain and improve their mobility and balance through innovative treatments. The rehabilitation center provides expert care in physical, occupational, and speech therapy for patients recovering from strokes, brain and spinal cord injuries, or living with conditions such as Parkinson’s disease and multiple sclerosis. The care model emphasizes a one-on-one, team-based approach that addresses the physical, emotional, and cognitive aspects of recovery. Pierre Monice, MBA, FACHE, President and CEO of Holy Cross Health, highlighted the transformative impact of the Ayers' donation on the facility's ability to offer compassionate, innovative care focused on the whole person. Among the innovative equipment introduced at the center is the Balance QuestTRV Chair, designed for diagnosing and treating benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV), and the C-Mill balance and gait treadmill, which uses virtual and augmented reality to simulate real-life walking challenges. The center also features the MyoCycle Pro for patients with neurological disorders, the EksoNR robotic exoskeleton for gait training, and the RT300 UE/LE FES cycle for neurological impairments, among others. Jon Ayers, a Fort Lauderdale resident and member of the Holy Cross Health Board of Directors, shared his personal connection to the center's mission, stemming from his own experience as a quadriplegic following a bike crash. His and Helaine's vision for the center is to inspire and enable patients to achieve significant recoveries through access to cutting-edge therapies and professional support. The Jon & Helaine Ayers Rehabilitation Center is located at the main hospital in Fort Lauderdale and is set to lead in the treatment of neurologic, vestibular, oncologic, and complex orthopedic conditions. With its comprehensive approach to rehabilitation and the latest technology, the center represents a beacon of hope for patients seeking to regain strength, mobility, and confidence. title: Morgan Stanley Downgrades Ciena Due to Margin Pressures and Limited Earnings Growth
content_encoded_text: Morgan Stanley downgraded Ciena Corp. (NYSE: CIEN) to Underweight from Equal-weight, pointing to persistent margin compression and limited near-term earnings potential. The investment bank also reduced its price target for the Hanover, Md.-based optical networking equipment provider to $70 from $73. Analysts expressed concerns over Ciena's increasing emphasis on lower-margin pluggable optical modules, which, despite boosting revenue forecasts, are adversely affecting profitability. According to Morgan Stanley analysts Meta Marshall and Mary Lenox, revenue estimates for fiscal 2026 have risen by 5% since March 2024, while earnings per share (EPS) estimates have decreased by 9%. The analysts attributed the gross margin shortfalls primarily to the expansion in the pluggables business. They noted potential for margin improvement with the adoption of 800ZR and RLS line cards but cautioned that the additional revenue might not carry the same margin profile. Ciena's shares experienced a slight decline following the announcement. The company's strategic shift towards high-speed optical interconnects, including pluggables for data centers and metro networks, places it in a competitive position within cloud infrastructure and AI workloads. However, this transition may dilute earnings in the short term, as analysts and investors weigh growth against profitability. In contrast to Ciena's downgrade, Morgan Stanley raised price targets for three other networking companies—Corning Inc., Coherent Corp., and Lumentum Holdings—reflecting a positive outlook on the optical infrastructure sector. The firm maintained Equal-weight ratings on these companies, citing the increasing demand for fiber and optical transmission due to rising data speed requirements. However, Marshall highlighted that the datacom segment's lower margins mean that top-line growth may not fully translate into EPS upside. The downgrade underscores the challenges Ciena faces in navigating the competitive landscape of high-speed connectivity, where strategic positioning in next-generation networks must be balanced against the imperative to maintain profitability. As the industry evolves, Ciena's ability to adapt its product mix and operational strategies will be critical in addressing these margin pressures and sustaining long-term growth. title: Ninth Annual New York City Math Festival to Illuminate Fosun Plaza with Interactive Math Exhibits
content_encoded_text: The National Museum of Mathematics (MoMath) and Fosun are set to bring the ninth annual New York City Math Festival to Fosun Plaza on Saturday, July 12th, from 10 am to 4 pm. This free, family-friendly event promises a day filled with interactive math exhibits, hands-on activities, and large-scale group constructions, highlighting the joy and relevance of mathematics in everyday life. This year's festival will feature new exhibits from MoMath's traveling exhibition, Math Midway 2 Go, including laser-based shape slicing and tessellation puzzles. Attendees can also enjoy math-themed juggling demonstrations, robotics activities, and large-scale geometric sculpture builds led by David Reimann, MoMath’s 2024–2025 Visiting Professor for Public Outreach. Fosun Plaza, known for its vibrant community programs, will once again serve as the perfect backdrop for this educational and entertaining event. Wei Bo, Fosun Global Partner and Chairman of Four Trees Capital Management, expressed pride in supporting MoMath's efforts to inspire the local community through innovative programming. Highlights of the festival include MoMath’s iconic 120-foot-long Number Line Tightrope and a variety of interactive exhibits designed to engage participants of all ages. Families can also participate in a raffle for a chance to win a free MoMath Family Membership, offering access to exclusive events and programming. The New York City Math Festival not only provides a platform for fun and learning but also underscores the importance of mathematics in understanding the world around us. Through dynamic exhibits and activities, MoMath continues to spark curiosity and reveal the wonders of mathematics to a broad audience. This news story relied on content distributed by None . Additionally, their design combines aesthetic appeal with performance, available in various colors to enhance curb appeal while offering superior protection. Ease of installation is another key feature of the StormFighter FLEX shingles, enabling faster roofing jobs and quicker recovery for families affected by storms. As Texas continues to face the challenges of shifting climate patterns and more frequent harsh weather events, the demand for innovative roofing solutions like TAMKO’s StormFighter FLEX shingles is expected to grow. These shingles represent not just a repair solution but a long-term investment in home resilience, offering Texas homeowners both protection and peace of mind in the face of future storms. Tickets for the event are available at https://worldfairus.com , with special rates for seniors and families. title: Silvercorp Metals Inc. Reports Strong Fourth-Quarter Performance and Growing Investor Appeal
content_encoded_text: Silvercorp Metals Inc. (NYSE American: SVM) (TSX: SVM) has reported its strongest fourth-quarter performance to date, marking a significant milestone in the company's fiscal year 2025. The Canadian mining company, specializing in the production of silver, gold, lead, and zinc, has seen a notable increase in both revenue and operating cash flow. This growth is attributed to higher production volumes and improved realized prices for its key metals. The company's income from mine operations in the quarter surged to $26.1 million, a substantial increase from $13.0 million in the same quarter of the previous fiscal year. Silvercorp has also ramped up its capital investments, allocating $9.9 million to its operations in China and $3.1 million to the El Domo project in Ecuador. Despite these expenditures, Silvercorp has strengthened its financial position, with cash and short-term investments rising to $369.1 million from $354.6 million at the end of December 2024. Additionally, the company holds a $70.9 million portfolio of equity investments and has secured a $175 million stream financing credit to support the construction of the El Domo mine. This financial performance underscores Silvercorp's robust balance sheet and its strategic focus on generating free cash flow from long-life mines, organic growth through discovery drilling, and responsible mining practices. The company's ability to maintain a strong financial position while investing in growth initiatives highlights its appeal to investors looking for stability and growth potential in the mining sector. title: EFM Global Ensures Seamless Execution of Wimbledon and The Open Through Precision Logistics
content_encoded_text: EFM Global, a premier international logistics consultant, has been instrumental in the seamless execution of two of the most prestigious sporting events in the world: Wimbledon and The Open. These efforts underscore the logistical challenges inherent in hosting large-scale international sports events and the specialized skills required to overcome them. Gary Morter, CEO of EFM Global, emphasized the company's commitment to precision and reliability, qualities that are indispensable in the logistics of major sporting events. EFM's portfolio extends beyond tennis and golf, encompassing global tours, the Olympics, and other complex international freight projects, demonstrating its versatility and expertise in the field. The company's recent projects include supporting the Rugby Football Union’s Summer Tour to Argentina and coordinating logistics for international cricket events in the UK. With a track record that includes the 2024 Olympics, the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup, and even the transport of a NASA space telescope, EFM Global has proven its capability to handle projects of any scale and complexity. Stuart Baker, Global VP for Sport at EFM Global, highlighted the teamwork and focus required to deliver world-class sports events. As fans enjoy the spectacle of Wimbledon and The Open, EFM Global continues to work behind the scenes, ensuring that organizers, sponsors, and athletes can focus on delivering exceptional performances. title: ARX Introduces PPE Line Specifically Designed for Women, Addressing Longstanding Industry Gap
content_encoded_text: ARX, a pioneering women-owned personal protective equipment (PPE) brand, has unveiled its inaugural product line specifically designed for women, marking a significant step towards inclusivity in industries traditionally dominated by male-centric safety gear. Founded by Dr. Hilary Gallin, a physician with expertise in anesthesiology and surgical care, and Kaitlin McCarthy, a leader in commercial real estate, ARX emerges from the founders' firsthand experiences with ill-fitting PPE in their respective fields. The launch of ARX's product line, including the Original Vest and Original Shirt, introduces the proprietary Multipoint Fit System, ensuring a tailored fit, breathability, and unrestricted mobility without sacrificing protection or durability. This innovation addresses the critical need for PPE that accommodates the diverse body types of women in the workforce, particularly in construction, where the demand for such gear has been historically overlooked. The timing of ARX's launch coincides with updated OSHA regulations mandating that PPE must properly fit all construction workers, underscoring the importance of ARX's ANSI-107 Type R Class 2 Certified vest in meeting these new standards. The brand has already garnered trust from leading companies like Tocci Building Companies and NorthBridge Partners, highlighting the industry's readiness for change. ARX's initiative not only enhances safety and comfort for women on jobsites but also challenges the broader cultural norms within male-dominated industries. By providing gear that fits and respects the wearer, ARX is paving the way for increased confidence and equality in the workplace. With plans to expand into additional sectors, ARX is setting a new benchmark for what safety gear should embody. The ARX PPE line is currently available at www.shoparxppe.com , with more styles and industry-specific offerings expected in the near future. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Redwood Logistics Expands to Querétaro, Strengthening Cross-Border Supply Chain Services
content_encoded_text: Redwood Logistics, a leading fourth-party logistics (4PL) provider in North America, has inaugurated a new office in Querétaro, Mexico, marking a significant step in its cross-border supply chain strategy. This expansion is part of Redwood's commitment to nearshoring and improving supply chain efficiencies for its clients across various industries, including automotive, aerospace, and consumer goods. The Querétaro office is strategically located near Mexico City within the BajÃo region, a key industrial area home to major manufacturers. This location offers Redwood direct access to critical manufacturing corridors and a skilled workforce, enhancing its ability to deliver integrated, technology-driven logistics solutions. Jordan Dewart, President of Redwood Mexico, emphasized the strategic importance of this move, stating it allows the company to be closer to its customers and provide real-time supply chain visibility with local expertise. Redwood plans to grow its team in Querétaro to 100 employees within three years, increasing its total workforce in Mexico to over 200. The new facility will host all business divisions, including technology solutions and managed services teams, to offer comprehensive support to clients. This expansion follows the successful opening of a Monterrey office in 2023, underscoring Redwood's growth in Mexico despite global trade challenges. Dewart highlighted Mexico's record foreign direct investment of $21.4 billion through Q1 2025, driven by nearshoring trends as manufacturers seek shorter, more reliable supply chains. Redwood's expansion into Querétaro is a testament to its long-term strategy to support Mexico's emergence as a global manufacturing hub and to provide seamless cross-border logistics solutions between Mexico and the U.S. For more information on Redwood's cross-border services, visit https://www.redwoodlogistics.com/shipping/cross-border . Ryan Goggins, Vice President at Sunbeam Properties & Development, emphasized the program's importance in creating lasting positive impacts on the community's youth. The initiative not only offers recreational activities but also serves as a platform for mentorship and the development of strong bonds between participants and police officers. Beyond 'Hangin’ with 5-0', Sunbeam Properties & Development has a history of supporting various local causes and nonprofit organizations in Miramar, including contributions to the Ansin Sports Complex and the Ansin Family Gallery at the Miramar Cultural Center. Their involvement in the community underscores a broader commitment to fostering positive development and engagement among Miramar's residents. The increased support for 'Hangin’ with 5-0' reflects a recognition of the program's value in bridging gaps between law enforcement and the community's youth, particularly those from underserved backgrounds. By providing opportunities for positive interactions and experiences, the camp plays a crucial role in shaping perceptions and building trust, which are essential for the well-being and safety of the community. title: Maryland Faces Multiple Challenges: Heat Wave Deaths, Political Races, and Environmental Agreements
content_encoded_text: A late June heat wave in Maryland resulted in eight deaths and 472 emergency room visits for heat-related illnesses, marking a significant health crisis. The State Health Department reported these figures from June 22 through June 28, a period when the heat index soared to 110 degrees in some areas. This surge in heat-related incidents underscores the escalating public health challenges posed by extreme weather conditions. In the political arena, the race to challenge Democratic Gov. Wes Moore in the 2026 primary election is heating up, with a diverse group of candidates from the Republican, Democratic, and Green parties expressing their intentions to run. This development signals a potentially competitive election cycle ahead for Maryland's chief executive position. Environmental efforts are also in focus as officials revise the Chesapeake Bay cleanup agreement, adopting a more data-driven approach with staggered deadlines and flexible targets. This strategy reflects lessons learned from the 2014 agreement's shortcomings and aims for a more adaptable and effective cleanup process. Additionally, the state's economy faces a potential $1 billion loss due to declining international student enrollment, a consequence of the current administration's policies. International students contribute significantly to Maryland's economy, supporting thousands of jobs, and their reduced presence could have far-reaching economic implications. Other notable developments include Howard County's introduction of a new flag, Baltimore County's efforts to depoliticize the selection of inspectors general, and the rejection of additional funding for an affordable housing project in East Towson. These events highlight the diverse challenges and changes occurring across Maryland's communities and governance structures. This news story relied on content distributed by None . title: Labrynth Introduces AI Model to Streamline Regulatory Processes and Boost Economic Growth

Labrynth's team, led by Lacey, includes seasoned professionals with extensive experience in technology, regulatory systems, and growth strategy. Their collective expertise is pivotal in scaling the company's mission to transform the regulatory landscape. The initial focus of Labrynth's AI platform is on the PROPEL buyer cohort, which includes permitting authorities, real estate developers, infrastructure owners, and other key stakeholders in the permit-dependent sectors of the U.S. economy. By compressing approval cycles and reducing consultant spend, Labrynth aims to address the significant delays and rising costs caused by regulatory inefficiencies. With over $1.2 trillion in global infrastructure spending delayed annually due to permitting and compliance backlogs, Labrynth's AI platform presents a timely solution. The company's transparent, outcome-based models are designed to unlock hundreds of billions in economic throughput across regulated industries, offering a smarter, faster, and fairer regulatory system. Labrynth's approach is built on trust and transparency, with a proprietary logic framework that mirrors legal reasoning. This ensures that all decisions are justified by evidence, precedent, and outcomes, maintaining safety, standards, and accountability while accelerating progress. title: A. Aubrey Bodine: A Pioneer in Pictorial Photography
content_encoded_text: A. Aubrey Bodine, celebrated as one of the twentieth century's finest pictorialists, left an indelible mark on the world of photography with his unique blend of documentary precision and artistic flair. His career, spanning 47 years, was characterized by a relentless pursuit of creativity, using the camera and darkroom as tools akin to a painter's brush or sculptor's chisel. Bodine's work, which began in 1923 with the Baltimore Sunday Sun, showcased a remarkable ability to capture the essence of Maryland's diverse occupations and activities, elevating newspaper photography to an art form. Bodine's photographs were not merely taken; they were meticulously made. His innovative techniques, including the use of dyes, intensifiers, and even scraping negatives, allowed him to manipulate images to match his artistic vision. This approach, reminiscent of a painter working from a model, emphasized the importance of mood, proportion, and design over strict adherence to reality. His dedication to craftsmanship and experimentation earned him top honors in national and international salon competitions, solidifying his reputation in photographic circles worldwide. Today, Bodine's legacy lives on through more than 6,000 photographs available for viewing and purchase at www.aaubreybodine.com . These images, ranging from documentary shots to artistic compositions, offer a glimpse into the mind of a photographer who believed in the power of photography as a creative discipline. The website also hosts the full text of 'A Legend In His Time,' a biography by Harold A. Williams, Bodine's editor and closest friend, providing deeper insight into the life and work of this remarkable artist. Bodine's contribution to photography extends beyond his technical innovations and artistic achievements. He challenged the conventional boundaries of the medium, proving that photography could be as expressive and nuanced as any traditional art form. His work remains a testament to the idea that the picture, not the process, is paramount, a principle that continues to inspire photographers and artists today. The recent deposit from an African client to deploy the Easy FEN system underscores the potential of these technologies to transform agriculture in the continent. title: Jupiter Neurosciences Advances in Treating Neuroinflammation and Aging with JOTROL™ and Nugevia™
content_encoded_text: Jupiter Neurosciences Inc., a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company, is pioneering treatments for neuroinflammation and aging, with a focus on central nervous system disorders such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, alongside rare diseases. The company's innovative approach combines the development of therapeutic drugs with a direct-to-consumer longevity product line, Nugevia™, aimed at generating revenue while advancing its clinical pipeline. Central to Jupiter Neurosciences' research is JOTROL™, an enhanced orally administered resveratrol formulation. According to the company, phase 1 trial results have shown that JOTROL™ achieves blood plasma levels 8-10 times higher than those of naïve resveratrol, marking a significant advancement in the delivery of therapeutic compounds. This development is crucial for treating conditions where inflammation plays a key role, such as in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases. Christer Rosen, chairman & CEO of Jupiter Neurosciences, emphasized the importance of the company's direct-to-consumer line, Nugevia™, in sustaining the business while pursuing long-term clinical goals. Nugevia™'s first three formulations target mitochondrial support, mental clarity, and beauty from within, catering to the booming longevity and aging market. Rosen highlighted the dual benefits of their approach: reducing inflammation to treat brain diseases and increasing mitochondria to regenerate cells. The company's strategy addresses a critical need in the pharmaceutical industry by offering potential treatments for debilitating diseases and tapping into the growing demand for anti-aging products. With the aging population increasing globally, Jupiter Neurosciences' work could have far-reaching implications for healthcare and quality of life in the elderly. For more information on Jupiter Neurosciences' developments, interested parties can watch the full interview with Christer Rosen on Benzinga's All-Access . title: HG Insights Forecasts $5 Trillion in Global IT Spend by 2025, Highlighting Growth in Software and Services
content_encoded_text: HG Insights, a leading provider of AI-powered market insights, has released its latest IT Spend Report, forecasting that global external IT spending will approach $5 trillion by 2025. This marks a significant milestone in the IT industry, reflecting the sector's resilience and growth amidst global economic challenges. The report provides a comprehensive analysis of IT spending across four main categories: Software, Hardware, Services, and Communications, with detailed forecasts for each. The report highlights that software is the fastest-growing category, with a projected global spend of $1.5 trillion. This growth is driven by investments in ERP Applications, Industry-Specific Applications, and Security and Operations Management. IT Services, the largest category, is expected to reach $2.1 trillion, fueled by Cloud Services, Application-Led Outsourcing, and IT Consulting. Hardware and Communications are also projected to see substantial investments, with $757 billion and $470.7 billion in global spend, respectively. Regionally, the Americas are leading in IT spending, with a projected $2.05 trillion, followed by Asia-Pacific at $1.59 trillion, and Europe, the Middle East, and Africa at $1.17 trillion. The report underscores the importance of strategic decision-making in navigating the evolving IT landscape, with AI and increased data center demand being key drivers of growth. Rohini Kasturi, CEO of HG Insights, emphasized the report's value in uncovering opportunities within the B2B IT market, advising companies to remain agile to adapt to new regulations and economic policies. title: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. Reports Promising Initial Results from Storm Copper Project Exploration
content_encoded_text: Aston Bay Holdings Ltd. (TSX.V: BAY) (OTCQB: ATBHF) has shared initial findings from its 2025 exploration program at the Storm Copper Project located on Somerset Island, Nunavut. The project, operated by American West Metals under a 20/80 joint venture, has revealed promising early results from a magnetotelluric (MMT) geophysical survey. This survey identified several large conductive anomalies that align with known copper mineralization, underscoring the project's potential to contribute significantly to the copper supply chain. Initial diamond drilling at the Cyclone Deeps target intersected 47 meters of visual sulfide mineralization. This finding is consistent with the distal edge of the Cyclone Deposit and suggests the proximity to a fault-offset continuation. Such discoveries are pivotal as they hint at the presence of substantial copper resources, which are increasingly in demand due to their critical role in the energy transition and the global push towards renewable energy sources. The exploration program benefits from the support of Nunavut’s Discover Invest Grow (DIG) program, highlighting both regional backing and the strategic importance of copper in today’s economy. Copper is a key component in renewable energy technologies, including electric vehicles and solar panels, making the Storm Copper Project's findings particularly relevant. For more detailed information on the preliminary results, interested parties can view the full press release here . The ongoing exploration at the Storm Copper Project represents a significant step forward in understanding the region's mineral potential and its contribution to meeting the growing demand for copper in the energy sector. title: Veris Residential Enhances Liquidity Through Strategic Financial Transactions
content_encoded_text: Veris Residential, Inc., a Northeast-focused Class A multifamily REIT, has successfully amended its $500 million credit facility, a move that underscores the company's commitment to reducing leverage and enhancing its balance sheet. The amended facility, which includes a $300 million Revolving Credit Facility and a $200 million delayed-draw Term Loan, introduces a leverage-based pricing grid, potentially lowering borrowing costs and improving financial flexibility. This strategic adjustment is part of Veris Residential's broader 2025 corporate plan aimed at selling non-strategic assets and achieving a Net Debt to EBITDA ratio below 10.0x by the end of 2025. Mahbod Nia, Chief Executive Officer of Veris Residential, highlighted the significance of the amended facility, noting an initial improvement of 55 basis points in corporate borrowing costs. This development, coupled with the recent $85 million sale of Signature Place, which was used to reduce the Term Loan by $80 million, positions the company favorably to continue executing its corporate plan. The sale of Signature Place is a testament to Veris Residential's strategy to divest non-strategic assets and focus on optimizing its portfolio for long-term value creation. The financial institutions involved in facilitating the amended credit facility include JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and The Bank of New York Mellon as Joint Lead Arrangers and Joint Bookrunners, with additional support from Bank of America, N.A., Capital One, National Association, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, and Royal Bank of Canada. This collaboration underscores the confidence of leading financial institutions in Veris Residential's strategic direction and financial health. These liquidity-enhancing transactions are pivotal for Veris Residential as they not only reduce borrowing costs but also provide the company with the financial agility to pursue its corporate objectives. By aligning its financial strategy with its operational goals, Veris Residential is reinforcing its position as a forward-thinking REIT committed to delivering value to its stakeholders and maintaining a strong presence in the Northeast's Class A multifamily market. title: Safe Pro Group Inc. Recognized in UN WFP Innovation Program for AI-Powered Landmine Detection
content_encoded_text: Safe Pro Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SPAI), a leader in AI-powered security and threat detection, has achieved significant recognition as its subsidiary, Safe Pro AI, was selected as a finalist in the United Nations World Food Programme's Humanitarian Innovation Accelerator Innovation Weeks. This selection comes from a pool of 579 global submissions, with Safe Pro AI's project focusing on the use of artificial intelligence to detect landmines in Ukrainian agricultural fields standing out as one of the eight chosen projects and the sole U.S.-based AI solution to be selected. The competition offers finalists the opportunity to secure up to $150,000 in funding and a place in a 12-month accelerator cohort. Safe Pro's SPOTD platform, which utilizes drone imagery and proprietary AI technology, has been instrumental in identifying over 150 types of threats. To date, the platform has analyzed more than 1.66 million images across 6,705 hectares in Ukraine, demonstrating its effectiveness and scalability in real-time threat detection. This accolade not only underscores Safe Pro Group's commitment to advancing humanitarian demining efforts but also highlights the critical role of AI in enhancing global food security. By providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional human-based analysis methods, Safe Pro's innovative solutions are paving the way for significant advancements in security and defense technologies. The recognition by the United Nations World Food Programme further validates the potential of AI to address some of the most pressing humanitarian challenges of our time. title: Mathnasium Reaches 100 International Centers with UK Leading Expansion
content_encoded_text: Mathnasium Learning Centers has achieved a significant milestone with the opening of its 100th international center in Hammersmith, United Kingdom, marking the UK as its largest market outside of the U.S. with 37 centers. The Hammersmith center, owned by Dan Tregoning, a multi-unit franchisee, is set to serve approximately 20,000 students across 30 schools, offering them a strong foundation in math and fostering a love for learning. The UK's prominence as Mathnasium's largest international market outside of North America is underscored by its recognition as the 2024 Franchise of the Year by the British Franchise Association. Mathnasium's global reach continues to expand, with recent openings in Vietnam and Romania, and plans for further growth in countries like Saudi Arabia, Australia, and Mexico by the end of 2025. Benjamin Simon, Regional Vice President of International at Mathnasium, highlighted the franchise's hands-on approach to math education, which has resonated with families worldwide. The new Hammersmith center, which opened in May 2025, aims to empower children to achieve excellence in math and life, with a grand opening event scheduled for the fall. Mathnasium's franchise model offers an affordable entry point with comprehensive support, making it an attractive opportunity for entrepreneurs looking to make a difference in education.
