title: Survey Highlights PostgreSQL's Role in Mitigating Cloud Outage Risks for Businesses
content_encoded_text: A recent survey commissioned by pgEdge, Inc., in partnership with The Foundry, sheds light on the growing reliance of businesses on PostgreSQL to safeguard against the repercussions of cloud service outages. The findings underscore the database's capability to meet stringent uptime requirements, with 91% of organizations demanding no more than 4 minutes of downtime per month for applications powered by PostgreSQL. The survey, which targeted mid-to-senior IT leaders at SaaS companies and large enterprises, highlights the acute awareness among technology decision-makers of the risks posed by cloud region failures. Notably, 82% of respondents expressed concern over such failures, reflecting a broad recognition of the potential for data loss, operational delays, and reputational damage. PostgreSQL's adoption is not just about risk mitigation; it's also about strategic deployment. More than half of the respondents (51%) use PostgreSQL within a hybrid database environment, while 35% rely on it as the primary database for customer-facing applications. This demonstrates PostgreSQL's maturity and versatility in supporting both integrated and front-line business processes. Despite the varied approaches to achieving high availability—58% utilize read replicas and automated failover within a single region, and 47% deploy PostgreSQL across multiple cloud regions with multi-master replication—the survey reveals a clear trend towards distributed database architectures. Seventy-nine percent of respondents are either evaluating or considering such solutions in the next 12 months, indicating a robust market opportunity for technologies like pgEdge Distributed PostgreSQL. The consequences of exceeding downtime thresholds are severe, with 56% of affected organizations reporting delayed business operations, and others citing damage to brand trust (40%) and spikes in support demands (49%). Conversely, the benefits of high availability solutions are equally compelling, with 53% of organizations experiencing increased uptime and 36% realizing cost savings compared to proprietary databases. Phillip Merrick, Co-founder and CEO of pgEdge, remarked on the survey's findings, stating, 'IT leaders are increasingly concerned with downtime for mission-critical applications and the risks of cloud region failure impacting their business.' The survey not only validates the strategic importance of PostgreSQL in today's digital infrastructure but also positions pgEdge as a key player in addressing the enterprise demand for distributed database solutions. title: States Show Varied Trends in Unemployment Claims, According to WalletHub Study
content_encoded_text: The latest findings from WalletHub's study on unemployment claims reveal a nuanced picture of the labor market's recovery across the United States. While new unemployment claims saw a 2.2% decrease week-over-week as of June 30, they were still 2.3% higher than the same period last year. This data underscores the ongoing challenges and disparities in employment recovery post-pandemic. Interestingly, the study identified New Hampshire, Alabama, and Montana as the states with the most significant decreases in unemployment claims last week. Conversely, Virginia, Illinois, and Rhode Island were among those with the least improvement. This variation highlights the uneven nature of economic recovery across states, with some regions bouncing back more robustly than others. Moreover, the report sheds light on a concerning trend: 24 states, including Nebraska, Tennessee, and South Dakota, along with the District of Columbia, reported higher unemployment claims compared to the same week last year. This indicates that for certain areas, the labor market has not only stalled in its recovery but has worsened over the past year. The implications of these findings are significant for policymakers and economists. They suggest that while the national economy may be on a path to recovery, the journey is far from uniform. Targeted interventions may be necessary to address the specific needs of states lagging in employment recovery. The WalletHub study serves as a crucial tool for understanding these disparities, offering a detailed look at where support might be most needed. For those interested in delving deeper into the data, the full rankings and analysis can be found here . This comprehensive study not only ranks states based on recent unemployment claims but also provides valuable context for understanding the broader economic landscape. title: Capital Square Housing Trust Announces Series 2 Preferred Stock Offering
content_encoded_text: Capital Square Housing Trust, a real estate investment trust (REIT) sponsored by Capital Square, has announced the offering of up to four million shares of its Series 2 Class A and Class I Redeemable and Convertible Preferred Stock at $10 per share, exclusively for accredited investors. This move is part of the REIT's strategy to raise between $40 million and $45 million. The funds are earmarked for acquisitions, UPREIT transactions, preferred stock redemptions, and other real estate-related investments, alongside general corporate purposes. Louis Rogers, founder and co-chief executive officer of Capital Square, highlighted the success of the Series 1 preferred stock offering as the impetus for launching Series 2. The new offering includes Class A shares for broker-dealer sales and Class I shares for registered investment advisor sales, catering to different investor segments with varying minimum investment requirements and dividend rates. Class A investors are projected to receive a 9.0% annual dividend, while Class I investors could see a 9.75% annual dividend, both paid monthly. An innovative feature of this offering is the conversion option available after the fourth anniversary, allowing either the REIT or shareholders to convert preferred stock at a discounted price. Additionally, the Preferred Distribution Reinvestment Plan (DRIP) offers investors the option to reinvest their dividends into additional shares, free of fees or sales commissions. Whitson Huffman, co-chief executive officer and chief investment officer of Capital Square, emphasized the offering's benefits, including attractive yields, monthly income, and the potential for future growth through conversion. This initiative supports the REIT's strategic objectives, including accretive acquisitions and UPREIT transactions, aligning with its vision for a robust portfolio of housing communities. Investors are advised to consider the material risks associated with private real estate investment trusts, as detailed in the private placement memorandum (PPM). The offering represents a significant opportunity for accredited investors to participate in the growth of Capital Square Housing Trust's portfolio, with the potential for both income and capital appreciation. title: New Advisory Board to Guide HR in Leveraging People Data and Analytics

Debbie McGrath, CEO of HR.com, emphasized the critical role of analytics in modern business and the board's mission to guide HR professionals in moving beyond mere data reporting to leveraging analytics for leadership. The upcoming State of People Analytics 2025 Virtual Event, scheduled for November 12, 2025, will serve as a platform for sharing insights and strategies developed by the advisory board. This event is part of HR.com's broader effort to support HR professionals through research and thought leadership in people analytics. Previous research, such as the HR.com's State of People Analytics 2024-25 report, has laid the groundwork for this initiative, offering valuable insights into the current state and future directions of HR analytics. This development underscores the growing importance of data and analytics in HR, highlighting the need for professionals to adapt to the changing landscape. By fostering a deeper understanding of how to effectively use people data, the HR Research Institute and its new advisory board aim to empower HR leaders to navigate the complexities of the modern workplace with confidence and strategic insight. title: Kairos Pharma Ltd. to Showcase Oncology Innovations at H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference
content_encoded_text: Kairos Pharma Ltd. (NYSE American: KAPA), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing innovative cancer therapeutics, has announced its participation in the H.C. Wainwright 27th Annual Global Investment Conference. The event, taking place from September 8 to 10, 2025, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel in New York City, will feature Kairos Pharma in one-on-one meetings and a virtual presentation accessible through their website. This participation underscores the company's commitment to advancing its lead candidate, ENV105, an antibody targeting CD105, a protein implicated in resistance to cancer treatments. The significance of Kairos Pharma's presentation at the conference lies in the potential of ENV105 to revolutionize cancer treatment by overcoming drug resistance, a major challenge in oncology. CD105's elevation in response to standard therapies leads to resistance and relapse, a hurdle ENV105 aims to overcome. Currently, ENV105 is undergoing Phase 2 clinical trials for castrate-resistant prostate cancer and Phase 1 trials for lung cancer, targeting areas with significant unmet medical needs. The company's approach, leveraging structural biology to combat drug resistance and immune suppression, positions it as a pioneer in the field of oncology therapeutics. For investors and stakeholders in the biopharmaceutical sector, Kairos Pharma's presentation at the H.C. Wainwright conference represents a pivotal opportunity to gain insights into the company's strategic direction and the therapeutic potential of ENV105. The conference serves as a platform for Kairos Pharma to showcase its scientific advancements and engage with the investment community, potentially influencing future collaborations and funding opportunities. title: Splash Beverage Group Announces First Quarter 2025 Results and Strategic Financial Improvements
content_encoded_text: Splash Beverage Group, Inc. (NYSE American: SBEV) has reported its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025, showcasing a period of transition aimed at overcoming previous liquidity challenges. The company's efforts to strengthen its financial foundation have begun to bear fruit, with notable improvements in its balance sheet and strategic positioning. Key financial updates include the exchange of approximately $12.7 million in outstanding convertible notes and accrued interest for newly designated preferred equity, a move that significantly reduces the company's debt obligations and enhances shareholder equity. Additionally, Splash has issued $20 million of preferred shares to acquire contractual and governmental water rights in Costa Rica, a strategic asset that could support future initiatives given the exceptional purity and quality of the spring water from the volcanic aquifer. The company has also strengthened its leadership team with the appointment of William Devereux as Chief Financial Officer and Tom Fore as Chair of the Audit Committee, bringing valuable expertise in capital markets and corporate governance to support Splash's growth objectives. Despite facing liquidity constraints, Splash has maintained its operational infrastructure and core team, setting the stage for resumed commercial activities as financial conditions improve. Management's commentary reflects optimism about the company's direction, emphasizing the importance of recent transactions in reducing debt and positioning Splash for future opportunities. content_encoded_text: Woofie’s, a leader in mobile pet care services, has announced a significant partnership with the American Kennel Club (AKC) to integrate the AKC S.A.F.E. Upon successful completion, franchises will be recognized as AKC S.A.F.E. Groomers and Salons, a testament to their commitment to upholding the highest safety standards in pet grooming. Gina M. DiNardo, President and CEO of the AKC, highlighted the importance of this partnership, noting Woofie’s dedication to client and community service through the prioritization of grooming safety. Amy Addington, Co-Founder and President of Woofie’s, expressed pride in aligning with the AKC, the gold standard in canine care, to ensure that pet parents can trust in the professionalism and care their dogs receive. This partnership not only benefits pet owners by providing peace of mind but also sets a new benchmark for the pet care industry. By adhering to the AKC’s rigorous standards, Woofie’s reinforces its commitment to excellence and the well-being of pets nationwide. For more details on the AKC S.A.F.E. title: Ladew Gardens Honors Leith Symington Griswold by Naming Director Role in Her Honor
content_encoded_text: Ladew Topiary Gardens has taken a significant step to honor the legacy of Leith Symington Griswold, one of its visionary founders, by naming the Director of Horticulture and Facilities position after her. Griswold, who passed away in 2013, was instrumental in transforming what was once Pleasant Valley Farm into the globally recognized Ladew Topiary Gardens. Her efforts not only preserved the gardens but also ensured they would remain a public treasure. Emily Emerick, the Anne and Robert Kinsley Executive Director of Ladew Gardens, highlighted Griswold's pivotal role in the garden's preservation. Griswold's leadership and philanthropy were key to establishing Ladew as a 501 c 3 non-profit, securing its future. Her legacy is not just in the physical beauty of the gardens but in the community and culture she helped foster around them. Adrienne Gettman, the current Director of Horticulture and Facilities, expressed her honor in holding a position that now bears Griswold's name. Gettman emphasized how Griswold's vision continues to influence the garden's preservation and enhancement efforts. The naming of the position serves as a testament to Griswold's enduring impact on Ladew and its mission. The Griswold family's dedication to Ladew continues, with her descendants actively involved in supporting the garden's mission. This deep-rooted connection underscores the lasting influence of Griswold's work and vision. The recent celebration of her legacy by Ladew staff, supporters, and board members further cements her status as a foundational figure in the garden's history. Ladew Topiary Gardens stands as a testament to Griswold's vision, a place where her love for gardening and conservation has created a lasting legacy. title: ZRG Consulting Solutions Embraces Human-Centered Approach to Disrupt Traditional Consulting
content_encoded_text: Susan Gallagher, President of ZRG’s Consulting Solutions, is spearheading a transformative approach in the consulting industry, emphasizing the integration of talent, culture, and strategy to drive real business results. With a career spanning leadership roles at some of the most respected firms in the industry, Gallagher brings a wealth of experience and a fresh perspective to ZRG, aiming to challenge the status quo and redefine what consulting can achieve. Gallagher's strategy involves building a collaborative team that operates across functions and geographies, focused solely on addressing clients' most pressing challenges. This approach is rooted in a culture of radical curiosity and honesty, where the team is committed to telling the truth, even when it's uncomfortable. Gallagher believes that this people-first methodology will not only differentiate ZRG in a crowded market but also deliver more impactful and lasting results for clients. title: EPA Challenges Maryland's Offshore Wind Farm Permit Process
content_encoded_text: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has raised concerns over a permit issued by the Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE) for an offshore wind farm near Ocean City. In a letter dated July 7, EPA Region 3 Administrator Amy Van Blarcom-Lackey pointed out that the permit incorrectly directed appeals to state courts instead of the EPA’s Environmental Appeals Board. This discrepancy could lead to the permit's invalidation and cause confusion among stakeholders regarding the proper venue for appeals. The permit in question, issued by MDE’s Air and Radiation Administration, concluded that the construction and commissioning of the offshore wind project would not violate any air pollution control regulations. This permit is a critical step for US Wind, the company behind the project, which has been developing the wind farm for nearly a decade. The project is among the most advanced offshore wind initiatives planned for Maryland's coast. MDE spokesperson Jay Apperson stated that the agency is reviewing the EPA's letter and emphasized its commitment to transparent and lawful permit processes. US Wind expressed confidence in the validity of its permits, despite the EPA's concerns. The situation highlights the complexities of regulatory compliance in large-scale renewable energy projects and the importance of clear, correct procedural guidelines to prevent delays or legal challenges. title: Eton Solutions Announces $58M Series C Funding to Fuel AI and Product Innovation

This strategic move comes as the global number of single-family offices is projected to grow significantly, with Asia Pacific expected to outpace North America in growth speed by 2030. Satyen Patel, Executive Chairman at Eton Solutions, highlighted the company's unique ecosystem designed to meet every wealth management need securely and efficiently. The investment will enable Eton Solutions to further innovate and expand its AI-driven solutions, catering to the evolving demands of wealth managers and their clients worldwide. Navis Capital Partners, managing over $5 billion in assets, emphasized Eton Solutions' unique market position and the transformative impact of its technology on family offices. title: Ucore Rare Metals Inc. Secures $18.4 Million DoD Funding to Bolster U.S. Rare Earth Elements Supply Chain
content_encoded_text: Ucore Rare Metals Inc. (TSX.V: UCU) (OTCQX: UURAF) has taken a significant step towards strengthening the United States' position in the global rare earth elements (REEs) supply chain by securing an $18.4 million funding agreement from the U.S. Department of Defense (DoD). This funding is earmarked for the development of Ucore's domestic rare earth processing facility, the Strategic Metals Complex (SMC) in Alexandria, Louisiana. The initiative is part of broader efforts to reduce the U.S.'s dependence on China, which currently dominates the REE supply chain. The SMC will utilize Ucore's proprietary RapidSX(TM) technology, a more efficient and environmentally sustainable alternative to conventional solvent extraction methods. This technology is designed to separate both light and heavy REEs, including neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium, and terbium. These materials are crucial for the production of permanent magnets used in electric motors and defense systems, highlighting the strategic importance of the project. The development of the SMC represents a pivotal move towards achieving American independence in the REE supply chain. By establishing a domestic source of these critical materials, the U.S. can safeguard its defense and clean energy sectors from potential supply disruptions. The project underscores the growing recognition of REEs' role in national security and the transition to a green economy. For more information on Ucore Rare Metals Inc. and its initiatives, visit https://www.Ucore.com . content_encoded_text: Capital Square has announced the full capitalization of its offering, Capital Square Glendale BFR, LLC, marking a significant milestone in the development of a 320-unit build-for-rent community in Glendale, Arizona. This development underscores the increasing appeal of build-for-rent communities in strategic locations. Louis Rogers, founder and co-chief executive officer of Capital Square, highlighted the project's success, noting its expected completion under budget and on time. The community will feature 102 detached single-family homes and 218 townhomes, offering modern amenities such as a pool, spa, fitness center, and sports courts. With approximately 10% of the units already delivered, leasing and initial move-ins are currently underway. The location of Ironwood Homes at The Rosefield offers residents access to a variety of retail and entertainment options, including The Village at Prasada shopping center and the Desert Diamond Casino. Its proximity to downtown Phoenix, Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, and Luke Air Force Base further enhances its appeal. Whitson Huffman, co-chief executive officer and chief investment officer of Capital Square, emphasized the project's potential to meet the high demand for quality rental housing while providing value to investors. The Phoenix metropolitan area, ranked as the 10th largest in the U.S., has seen a 30% increase in rent growth since March 2020, the highest in the nation. The Glendale industrial submarket's ongoing development, including a significant logistics park, signals strong economic fundamentals that support the viability of build-for-rent communities like Ironwood Homes at The Rosefield. title: Blo Blow Dry Bar Opens in Austin's Goodnight Ranch, Enhancing Local Beauty Services
content_encoded_text: The recent opening of Blo Blow Dry Bar in the Goodnight Ranch community marks a significant addition to the beauty services available in Southeast Austin. Located at 9021 Goodnight Ranch Blvd., this new establishment, spearheaded by local resident Laurie Vazquez-Campagna, aims to fill the gap in beauty resources east of I-35. With a focus on inclusivity and self-care, Blo Blow Dry Bar offers a variety of hair and makeup services designed to make every guest feel pampered and confident. Vazquez-Campagna, a weekly patron of beauty services herself, was motivated to bring the Blo Blow Dry Bar franchise to her community to ensure locals have access to high-quality beauty treatments. The bar features a menu with five signature hair styles, a la carte options, hair treatments, and five signature makeup looks, alongside a new section for customized styles. This variety ensures that every guest can find a look that suits their personal style and occasion. The establishment operates with a mission to welcome individuals of all ages, ethnicities, and orientations, creating a space where everyone feels represented and valued. The expertly trained staff, referred to as 'blo-ers', are available seven days a week to provide consultations and services, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience for all visitors. The bar's sophisticated yet fun environment complements its wide range of services, from sleek and straight hair styles to bouncy curls and professional makeup applications. Operating hours are designed to accommodate the busy schedules of the community, opening from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Thursday, 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Friday and Saturday, and 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. on Sunday. For more details, visit https://blomedry.com/blo-goodnight-ranch/ . The introduction of Blo Blow Dry Bar to Goodnight Ranch is not just about expanding beauty services; it's about building a community where self-care and confidence are prioritized. As the area continues to develop, Vazquez-Campagna hopes her business will inspire more establishments to join, making Goodnight Ranch a premier destination in Austin. title: Sweet Addison Launches First Ever Protein Cookie in Collaboration with Wellness Expert Taylor Dukes
content_encoded_text: Sweet Addison's, a clean dessert brand founded by Addison Labonte, has launched its first-ever Protein Cookie, developed in collaboration with Texas-based wellness expert Taylor Dukes. This innovative product is designed to meet the needs of health-conscious individuals looking for snacks that combine taste with nutritional benefits. The cookie is notable for its 17g of protein content, derived from Taylor Dukes' signature Unflavored Bone Broth Protein Powder, and is free from grains, dairy, soy, refined sugars, and preservatives. The collaboration between Sweet Addison's and Taylor Dukes was a natural progression, given their shared values of balance, wellness, and the use of real ingredients. The Protein Cookie stands out in the market for its soft-baked texture and nostalgic flavor, achieved without compromising on health. It is a testament to the brand's commitment to reimagining classic baked goods with a better-for-you twist. Addison Labonte, the founder of Sweet Addison's, emphasized the importance of creating a product that aligns with the wellness goals of their customers while satisfying their sweet tooth. The Protein Cookie is the result of extensive testing to ensure the perfect balance of flavor, texture, and nutrition. It is positioned as an ideal snack for various occasions, from post-workout recovery to a healthy dessert option. Looking ahead, Sweet Addison's plans to continue innovating with seasonal flavors and functional twists on traditional treats. The brand remains focused on evolving with consumer demands while staying true to its mission of offering nostalgic, health-conscious desserts. The launch of the Protein Cookie marks a significant step in Sweet Addison's expansion into the protein snack market, reflecting the growing consumer interest in functional foods that support a healthy lifestyle. title: Emerald Coast Heart & AFib Expands to Fort Walton Beach, Enhancing Cardiac Rhythm Care Access
content_encoded_text: Emerald Coast Heart & AFib, a specialized cardiology practice focusing on heart rhythm disorders, has announced its expansion into Fort Walton Beach, Florida. This move is set to provide residents of Northwest Florida, including areas like Navarre and Milton, with enhanced access to expert care for atrial fibrillation (AFib) and related arrhythmias. Founded by Dr. Ian Weisberg, a fellowship-trained electrophysiologist with over a decade of experience, the practice is renowned for its dedicated approach to cardiac rhythm management. The expansion follows the successful establishment of the practice in Crestview earlier this year. Dr. Weisberg, who performs over 300 AFib ablation procedures annually, emphasizes the clinic's mission to offer high-quality, individualized treatment using the latest technologies. The practice's services include personalized AFib treatment plans, advanced catheter ablation therapy, and the implantation of pacemakers and defibrillators, among others. What distinguishes Emerald Coast Heart & AFib is its commitment to patient education and empowerment. The clinic not only provides treatment but also serves as a resource for patients to understand their conditions and care options. Dr. Weisberg's digital education platform, https://DrIanWeisberg.org , offers accessible, evidence-based information on atrial fibrillation, further supporting this mission. The Fort Walton Beach location, details of which are to be announced, will operate on a 'patients-first' model, ensuring responsive care, thorough consultations, and tailored treatment pathways. This expansion is a testament to the growing demand for specialized cardiac rhythm care in the region and Emerald Coast Heart & AFib's dedication to meeting this need with clinical excellence and compassion. title: Newton Law Firm Champions Legal Support for LGBTQ+, Trans, and Polyamory Communities
content_encoded_text: DangerLaw, LLC, a Newton-based law firm, is making strides in providing specialized legal services to the LGBTQ+, trans, and polyamory communities. With a focus on estate planning, pre- and post-nuptial agreements, and other critical legal matters, the firm is dedicated to safeguarding the rights and assets of diverse family structures during life's most significant transitions. Deborah Danger, Esq., the leading attorney at DangerLaw, LLC, emphasizes the firm's commitment to offering both legal precision and personal support. 'We often see the best people in the hardest moments of their lives,' Danger stated, highlighting the firm's approach to guiding clients through planning for the unexpected or navigating unanticipated challenges. The firm's practice areas are meticulously designed to address the complexities faced by their clients, including estate planning, confirmatory adoptions, and name changes. DangerLaw, LLC's expertise is rooted in a deep understanding of the stakes involved in these legal matters, ensuring that clients' relationships and future plans are prioritized. Attorney Deborah Danger brings a wealth of knowledge to her practice, with advanced degrees in business administration, law, and taxation. Her accolades, including being named a Massachusetts Super Lawyer and Rising Star, underscore her expertise in estate planning and probate. Similarly, Attorney Kerry Reilly, with her background in securities and private wealth management, focuses on making estate planning accessible to all, believing in the importance of leaving 'love behind, not logistics.' Located at 383 Elliot Street, Suite 10, Newton Upper Falls, MA, DangerLaw, LLC stands as a beacon of hope and support for those in the LGBTQ+, trans, and polyamory communities seeking to navigate the legal landscape with confidence and security. title: Dr. Jeremy Saul Launches Scholarship to Support Future Healthcare Professionals
content_encoded_text: Dr. Jeremy Saul has established the Dr. Jeremy Saul Scholarship for Medical Students, a $1,000 award aimed at undergraduate students in the United States who are pursuing careers in medicine, nursing, or related healthcare fields. This scholarship seeks to reduce the financial strain on students dedicated to healthcare, while also encouraging a blend of academic excellence and a deep commitment to serving others. Applicants must be enrolled in an accredited U.S. college or university, maintain a GPA of 3.0 or higher, and demonstrate a history of community service or volunteer work. The selection process includes an essay submission, where candidates reflect on a personal experience that influenced their healthcare aspirations and how they plan to integrate compassion and creativity into their future careers. The scholarship underscores Dr. Saul's belief in the importance of nurturing healthcare professionals who are not only skilled but also empathetic and innovative. With an application deadline of February 15, 2026, and the winner announced on March 15, 2026, this initiative represents a significant opportunity for students to receive support as they prepare to make meaningful contributions to the healthcare sector. Dr. Saul, a respected figure in family and community medicine, views this scholarship as an investment in the future of healthcare. By assisting students who embody the values of compassion, integrity, and leadership, he aims to foster a new generation of medical professionals committed to improving community health and well-being. title: Baolai Steel Enhances Global Fire Safety with High-Quality Sprinkler Pipes
content_encoded_text: Fire safety in residential and commercial properties hinges on the reliability of fire sprinkler systems, with the quality of sprinkler pipes being paramount. Baolai Steel, with three decades of expertise in steel piping, specializes in producing fire sprinkler pipes that adhere to rigorous safety standards, ensuring effective management of fire hazards. The integrity of fire sprinkler systems is crucial for immediate response to fire outbreaks, significantly mitigating risks to life and property. Baolai Steel's products meet international standards such as ASTM A795, ASTM A53, ASTM A135, EN 10255, and AS 1074, offering solutions like FBE fire pipes, galvanized steel pipes, and black steel pipes, each designed for specific environmental conditions and applications. Quality and compliance are at the forefront of Baolai Steel's operations, with products certified by FM, UL, ISO, COC, and SII, and each pipe undergoing a 100% hydrostatic pressure test. This commitment ensures that contractors, bid issuers, and government procurement officials can rely on Baolai Steel for fire protection products that meet the highest standards. Understanding the unique needs of each project, Baolai Steel offers tailored solutions, including expert guidance on materials, sizes, and configurations, alongside a comprehensive range of fittings, valves, and accessories. The company's deep processing services, including painting, epoxy coating, and galvanizing, cater to a wide array of customer requirements, with an annual production capacity of 800,000 tons of deep-processed products. Baolai Steel's dedication to innovation and sustainability is evident in its investment in research and development, leading to more efficient and cost-effective fire sprinkler solutions. The company's use of recyclable materials and energy-efficient processes underscores its commitment to minimizing environmental impact. With a global presence, Baolai Steel's fire pipes have been integral to projects in over 50 countries, including the Saudi Future City Project and Colombia's Metro and Airport Projects, showcasing its role in enhancing fire safety standards worldwide. Baolai Steel's unwavering commitment to quality and tailored solutions ensures the creation of safer environments, protecting lives and properties across the globe. title: Q.ANT Secures €62 Million to Pioneer Photonic Processing in AI and High-Performance Computing
content_encoded_text: Q.ANT, a leader in photonic processing technology, has successfully raised €62 million in a Series A funding round to further develop and commercialize its energy-efficient photonic processors. This investment, co-led by Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners, and imec.xpand, alongside other deep tech investors, represents one of Europe's most substantial deep tech funding efforts. The company's innovative approach to computing with light instead of electricity promises to overcome the limitations of traditional CMOS technology, offering significant improvements in performance and energy efficiency. The global scaling of AI infrastructure has highlighted the limitations of current chip technology, with increasing energy demands and performance stagnation. Q.ANT's photonic processors, built on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate (TFLN), offer a solution to these challenges. Real-world tests have demonstrated up to 30 times energy efficiency and 50 times performance improvement, with the potential to significantly increase data center capacity without the need for complex cooling systems. Dr. Michael Förtsch, founder and CEO of Q.ANT, emphasized the company's vision to redefine computing by utilizing light, a goal supported by this recent investment. The funding will enable Q.ANT to scale production, advance next-generation processor development, and expand its team and operations, including a planned expansion into the US market. The addition of semiconductor experts Hermann Hauser and Hermann Eul to Q.ANT's advisory board further strengthens the company's position in the industry. Industry leaders and investors have recognized Q.ANT's potential to transform the data center semiconductor landscape. Christian Meermann of Cherry Ventures and Andreas Unseld of UVC Partners highlighted the company's innovative technology and its alignment with the need for sustainable AI infrastructure. Cyril Vancura from imec.xpand pointed out the untapped potential of photonic computing, with Q.ANT leading the way in addressing core technological challenges. Q.ANT's Photonic Native Processing Server (NPS) is now available for early access evaluation, offering a glimpse into the future of high-performance, sustainable computing. The company aims to establish its photonic processing technology as a foundational element of global AI systems by 2030, enhancing scalability and energy efficiency in the process. Support from political and industry figures, including Bob Sorensen of Hyperion Research and Johannes Heinloth of L-Bank, underscores the broader implications of Q.ANT's technology for sustainable growth, job creation, and international competitiveness. Berthold Schmidt, CTO at TRUMPF, and Manfred Rauhmeier of the acatech Foundation have also praised Q.ANT's innovative approach and its potential to shape the future of computing. For more information on the energy challenges addressed by Q.ANT's technology, refer to the International Energy Agency's report available at https://iea.blob.core.windows.net/assets/6b2fd954-2017-408e-bf08-952fdd62118a/Electricity2024-Analysisandforecastto2026.pdf . title: Burleigh Pottery: A Legacy of British Craftsmanship Now Accessible in North America
content_encoded_text: Burleigh Pottery, a name synonymous with British ceramic excellence, has announced its availability to collectors in the U.S. and Canada. This marks a significant moment for enthusiasts of traditional craftsmanship, as Burleigh's tableware is renowned for its unique production process and historical significance. Each piece is meticulously handcrafted in Stoke-on-Trent, England, at the Middleport Pottery, a Victorian factory that continues to operate on the principles it was founded upon. What sets Burleigh apart is its commitment to preserving the art of tissue transfer printing, a labor-intensive technique that few potteries still practice. This method ensures that every item boasts intricate patterns with unmatched depth and character, making each piece a testament to the skill of its artisans. The brand's dedication to sustainable, small-batch production and a UK-based supply chain further enhances its appeal in today's environmentally conscious market. Among Burleigh's most celebrated collections are its blue tableware patterns, including the iconic Blue Calico and the recently reintroduced Blue Prunus, based on a design from 1913. These pieces not only serve as functional tableware but also as artifacts of cultural heritage, offering a sense of quiet luxury and a connection to British history. For those interested in exploring Burleigh's rich heritage and collections, more information can be found at https://www.burleighpottery.com/pages/all-made-here , https://www.burleighpottery.com/collections/shades-of-blue , and https://www.burleighpottery.com/collections/blue-prunus . title: KR New Materials Introduces AluCore™ Decking, Revolutionizing Outdoor Construction
content_encoded_text: KR New Materials Co., LTD (KR WPC) has unveiled its latest product, KR AluCore™ Decking, marking a significant advancement in outdoor construction materials. This innovative decking solution merges the visual appeal of wood plastic composite with the robustness of a reinforced aluminum core, offering superior performance in span, load capacity, and dimensional stability compared to traditional WPC decking. The AluCore™ Decking is designed to meet the rigorous demands of commercial platforms, poolside installations, and high-traffic public spaces. Its technical advantages include an extended joist span of 60–80 cm without the need for additional substructure reinforcement, near-zero thermal expansion to prevent warping or contraction, and enhanced load-bearing capacity for large-scale outdoor environments. As a leading composite decking manufacturer, KR WPC emphasizes quality and sustainability in its production processes. The materials used in AluCore™ Decking, including wood fiber, high-density polyethylene (HDPE), and advanced chemical additives, are extruded through custom molds using high-temperature extrusion technology. These eco-friendly products are also fire- and water-resistant, UV-stable, and have a lifespan exceeding 20 years. KR WPC's global reach and expertise are underscored by its 36 production lines operating around the clock, in-house mold design capabilities with over 340 mold types, and certifications including CE and FCS. The company supplies its innovative products to more than 24 countries, catering to a wide range of outdoor construction needs beyond decking, such as composite exterior cladding, fencing panels, and wall panels. With the launch of AluCore™ Decking, KR WPC continues to lead the way in providing durable, customizable, and eco-friendly outdoor solutions. This product not only enhances the structural integrity of outdoor projects but also offers aesthetic versatility, making it a game-changer for designers, builders, and suppliers worldwide. Greg Robertson expressed enthusiasm about the opportunity to demonstrate how senior living communities can achieve unified communication without discarding their current investments. title: Vancouver Firm Specializes in Scanning Historic Artifacts for Preservation
content_encoded_text: Micro Com Systems, a Vancouver-based company, has carved a niche for itself in the scanning and preservation of historic artifacts. With decades of experience, the team has successfully digitized a wide array of items, from linen drawings from the 1800s to rare books and computer printouts from the 1970s. Their work underscores the importance of preserving historical documents and artifacts in a digital format, ensuring they remain accessible for future research and education. The process of scanning these artifacts is not without its challenges. Handling delicate and often irreplaceable items requires a high level of expertise and care. Micro Com Systems has demonstrated its capability in this regard, offering services that not only capture the visual aspects of these items but also extract relevant metadata, providing a comprehensive digital record. This meticulous approach to digitization mirrors the ancient practice of recording information on stone tablets, highlighting the timeless human endeavor to preserve knowledge. One of the key benefits of digitizing historic artifacts is the ease of sharing and accessing information. Unlike physical artifacts, which are susceptible to damage from environmental factors or human error, digital copies can be easily duplicated and distributed. Micro Com Systems facilitates this by providing digitized files on thumb drives, a modern solution to the age-old problem of information preservation. This service is particularly valuable for museums and archives looking to safeguard their collections while making them more accessible to the public. For those interested in learning more about Micro Com Systems' scanning services for historic artifacts, further information is available at https://www.microcomsys.com/scanning-services-for-historic-museum-artifacts/ . The company's expertise in document imaging and management, along with a range of other services, positions it as a leader in the field of digital preservation. title: The Strategic Importance of Proactive Air Conditioner Replacement in Vancouver
content_encoded_text: Homeowners in Vancouver often face the dilemma of whether to replace their air conditioning units before they fail or wait until a breakdown occurs, typically during a heatwave. The decision, however, is not just about comfort but also involves significant financial and practical considerations. Waiting for a complete failure can lead to higher costs, rushed decisions, and uncomfortable periods without cooling, especially during peak demand seasons. Several factors should influence the decision to replace an air conditioner, including the unit's age, repair history, energy efficiency, and performance during peak seasons. Systems over 12–15 years old, requiring frequent repairs, or leading to increased energy bills and reduced comfort are prime candidates for replacement. Proactively replacing an air conditioner can prevent the hidden costs associated with emergency repairs, such as longer wait times and limited part availability, which often result in more expensive solutions. Moreover, early replacement offers the opportunity to upgrade to a more energy-efficient system, potentially reducing monthly energy costs and improving home comfort. Proper installation by certified HVAC technicians is crucial to ensure the new system is correctly sized for the home, avoiding issues related to underperformance or excessive energy use. For homeowners considering renovations, installing a new air conditioner can also enhance energy ratings and prevent last-minute complications during inspections. While the upfront cost of a new air conditioning system may seem daunting, the long-term savings in repair costs, energy bills, and improved comfort make it a wise investment. Homeowners are encouraged to assess their current systems and consider the benefits of early replacement to avoid the pitfalls of emergency breakdowns. For more information on making an informed decision, visit https://nationheating.ca/should-you-replace-your-vancouver-air-conditioner-before-it-breaks-down-a-cost-vs-risk-breakdown/ . title: New Construction Painting Guidelines Released by Maple Ridge Residential Painters
content_encoded_text: Timing is critical in the painting phase of new construction projects, as highlighted by Pedigree Painting, a residential painting service in Maple Ridge. The company has developed a comprehensive timeline to guide the scheduling of interior and exterior painting, aiming to prevent common pitfalls such as delays, rework, and increased costs. Properly timed painting ensures a flawless finish and efficient workflow among all construction teams involved. For exterior painting, the ideal conditions are mild and dry, typically from spring through early fall in the Lower Mainland. Painting should commence once the structure is weather-tight, with siding installed and surfaces dry. This timing prevents poor adhesion and premature wear. Coordination with other professionals, such as landscapers and scaffolders, is essential to avoid obstructions that could hinder the painting process. Interior painting should begin after the drywall is installed, finished, and fully dry, with the space enclosed and climate-controlled to ensure stable humidity and temperature levels. The recommended order of operations includes priming and painting ceilings, followed by trim and doors, walls, and concluding with a walkthrough and final inspection. Delays can be minimized by coordinating with builders or general contractors to ensure uninterrupted timelines and by selecting paint colors and finishes well in advance. Pedigree Painting emphasizes the importance of these guidelines for achieving high-quality finishes in new construction projects in Maple Ridge. For more detailed information, visit https://www.pedigreepainting.com/blog/surrey-new-construction-painting-timeline-when-to-schedule-interior-and-exterior-painting . title: Coastal Weather Exacerbates Chimney Damage in North Vancouver, Highlighting Need for Regular Maintenance
content_encoded_text: The unique coastal weather conditions in North Vancouver pose a significant threat to chimney structures, with moisture and freeze-thaw cycles leading to potential damage. Brick and mortar, common materials in chimney construction, are particularly vulnerable to water absorption, which can cause mortar to crumble, bricks to loosen, and cracks to form, compromising both the efficiency and safety of the chimney. Many homeowners may not realize the extent of damage that persistent rain and coastal winds can inflict on their chimneys. Water penetration can damage the flue liner, leading to mould or mildew growth, which not only weakens the structure but also affects indoor air quality. Since chimneys are often out of sight, these issues can go unnoticed until they require extensive and expensive repairs. Regular professional inspections are crucial in identifying early signs of chimney deterioration, such as spalling bricks or eroded mortar joints, before they escalate into more severe problems. Nickel Masonry & Construction, with their expertise in local weather conditions and masonry structures, offers specialized services to ensure repairs are durable and structurally sound. They emphasize the importance of addressing chimney lining issues promptly to maintain safety and performance. For residents of North Vancouver and surrounding areas, understanding the impact of coastal weather on chimney integrity and the necessity of professional maintenance can prevent future complications. More information on chimney repair and maintenance can be found at https://www.nickelconstruction.ca/residential-chimney-repairs-in-north-vancouver-and-west-vancouver-how-coastal-weather-conditions-increase-the-need-for-timely-maintenance/ . content_encoded_text: Rainmaker Worldwide Inc., a leader in water technology solutions, has announced the successful deployment of another fully containerized Seawater to Tap system in the Turks and Caicos Islands. This system, operational at Northwest Point Condominiums in Providenciales, draws from a deep saltwater well with salinity levels exceeding 40,000 PPM, producing over 2 million litres of high-quality, remineralized drinking water in just four months. The R/OCell® system, designed for rapid deployment and operational flexibility, integrates with SmartCell remote monitoring and is supported by local partnerships. This deployment underscores Rainmaker's commitment to providing decentralized, energy-efficient water infrastructures in remote and island communities worldwide. Chris Potts, Chairman of Northwest Point Condominiums, highlighted the system's reliability and the importance of access to fresh, safe drinking water. Michael O’Connor, Chairman and CEO of Rainmaker Worldwide Inc., emphasized the role of local partnerships in the system's success, particularly the support from Been Construction Ltd. This installation is part of Rainmaker's broader efforts to strengthen water infrastructure in the region, showcasing the potential of combining advanced technology with local expertise to address global water challenges. title: FingerMotion Inc. Reports Modest Revenue Growth Amid Expansion into New Segments
content_encoded_text: FingerMotion Inc. (NASDAQ: FNGR), a mobile services, data, and technology company, announced its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026, revealing a 1% year-over-year revenue increase to $8.46 million. Despite a 1% decline in its core Telecommunications Products & Services business, which generated $8.31 million, the company saw promising growth in its emerging segments. The DaGe Platform contributed $10,938, the Command and Communication segment added $109,241, and the Big Data segment posted $27,310 in revenue. However, the company faced challenges as gross profit plummeted by 78% to $152,521, attributed to rising costs, while operating expenses decreased by 9% to $2.14 million. The net loss widened to $2.01 million, or $0.04 per share. CEO Martin Shen highlighted the momentum in newer, higher-margin segments and reiterated the company's commitment to long-term, data-driven growth strategies. This financial update underscores FingerMotion's strategic pivot towards diversifying its revenue streams beyond its traditional telecommunications offerings. The growth in newer segments, albeit from a small base, indicates potential for higher margins and sustainable expansion. For investors and stakeholders, these developments signal FingerMotion's adaptive strategies in a competitive and rapidly evolving tech landscape, focusing on leveraging data and technology to drive future growth. title: Energy Fuels Inc. Achieves Commercial Production of On-Spec NdPr, Marking a Significant Milestone in U.S. Rare Earth Elements Production
content_encoded_text: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE American: UUUU) (TSX: EFR) has announced a significant achievement in the production of rare earth elements (REEs) with the commercial production of separated neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) at its White Mesa Mill in Utah. This milestone is notable as the NdPr produced meets the stringent product specifications required by manufacturers of REE-based alloys, which are essential for the permanent magnets used in electric motors for battery-powered electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid vehicles. The company has reached full design capacity of its new phase 1 REE separation circuit, capable of producing 850 to 1,000 metric tons of NdPr annually. With commercial quantities expected to be available for shipment by the end of the month, this marks the first time in decades that a U.S. company has produced on-spec separated REE from monazite on a commercial scale. This development is a significant step forward in reducing the United States' reliance on foreign sources of rare earth elements, which are critical for a wide range of technologies, including renewable energy systems and defense applications. Energy Fuels' achievement underscores the growing importance of domestic production of critical minerals. The ability to produce NdPr on a commercial scale not only supports the burgeoning EV market but also enhances the U.S. position in the global rare earth elements supply chain. title: Transparent Solar Windows: A Leap Towards Sustainable Energy
content_encoded_text: The traditional image of solar panels as dark, opaque fixtures mounted on rooftops or spread across fields is set to change, thanks to a groundbreaking development by scientists from Michigan State University. They have introduced a revolutionary design that makes solar panels transparent, effectively turning ordinary windows into sources of clean energy. This innovation could redefine how buildings generate power, making solar energy more accessible and integrated into daily life. The implications of this development are vast. By converting windows into solar panels, buildings could significantly reduce their reliance on traditional energy sources, lowering both costs and carbon footprints. The integration of these transparent panels with stationary energy storage systems, such as those offered by SolarBank Corp. , could further enhance energy efficiency and sustainability for families and businesses alike. This advancement not only represents a significant step forward in solar technology but also aligns with global efforts to combat climate change by promoting renewable energy sources. The potential for widespread adoption of solar windows could accelerate the transition to green energy, making sustainable living more practical and achievable for the average person. As this technology becomes more prevalent, it could play a crucial role in meeting the world's energy needs in an environmentally friendly manner. Investors and market participants are closely monitoring the situation, hopeful that the outcome will foster innovation and stability in the cryptocurrency space. title: CMUV Bancorp Shareholders Approve Sale to Frontwave Credit Union
content_encoded_text: CMUV Bancorp, Inc. has reached a pivotal moment as its shareholders voted in favor of the sale of assets and assumption of liabilities to Frontwave Credit Union during a Special Meeting held on July 15, 2025. This decision paves the way for the subsequent dissolution of the Company, a move that has been anticipated since the announcement of the Transaction. Shareholders are set to receive cash distributions from the proceeds, with expectations set at approximately $25.00 per share, distributed in multiple installments. The first distribution is anticipated shortly after the closing of the sale, expected around September 30, 2025, pending the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals. Shareholders are advised to locate their stock certificates if held directly through Computershare, as these will be required to receive distributions. Those unable to find their certificates are urged to contact Monica Garcia at 760-352-1889 or via email at mgarcia@yourcvb.com. Shareholders holding shares through 'book entry' or a broker will not need to submit a stock certificate. In the coming weeks, transmittal materials from Computershare will be sent out, detailing the process for returning stock certificates and instructions to ensure timely receipt of distributions. The Company has also announced that third-quarter dividends for 2025 will not be issued separately but will be included in the distribution amounts to shareholders, consolidating the financial adjustments resulting from the Transaction. This development signifies a major shift for CMUV Bancorp and its stakeholders, with the Transaction expected to finalize pending regulatory green lights. The focus now shifts to the seamless execution of the sale and the efficient distribution of proceeds to shareholders, marking the culmination of a significant chapter in the Company's history. title: Study Reveals Insights into Lung Cancer Among Non-Smokers
content_encoded_text: Lung cancer, traditionally associated with smoking, is increasingly diagnosed in individuals who have never smoked, accounting for about a quarter of all cases. This surprising trend has prompted the scientific community to explore the underlying causes and develop targeted treatments for this demographic. Companies such as Calidi Biotherapeutics Inc. (NYSE American: CLDI) are at the forefront of researching and creating effective therapies for lung cancer, including those cases unrelated to smoking. The discovery that a significant number of lung cancer patients are non-smokers challenges previous understandings of the disease's risk factors. It underscores the need for further research to identify other potential causes, such as genetic predispositions, environmental exposures, or other yet-to-be-determined factors. The implications of these findings are profound, suggesting that lung cancer screening and prevention strategies may need to be broadened to include non-smokers. As the medical community seeks answers, the focus on developing treatments for non-smoker lung cancer patients is intensifying. This shift in research priorities highlights the importance of understanding all facets of lung cancer, not just those linked to smoking. The work of companies like Calidi Biotherapeutics Inc. is crucial in addressing this unmet medical need and offers hope for more effective treatments in the future. title: Trump's Copper Tariffs Pose New Challenges for the American Auto Industry
content_encoded_text: The American auto industry is bracing for additional challenges following the recent announcement by former President Trump imposing a 50% tariff on copper imports, effective August 1st. This decision has sparked concerns among auto manufacturers and suppliers, who are already grappling with rising costs and taxes. The tariffs are expected to further strain the industry, making it more difficult for companies to manage their expenses and maintain profitability. Copper is a critical component in the manufacturing of vehicles, used in everything from electrical wiring to batteries. The increased cost of copper imports could lead to higher production costs for auto manufacturers, which may, in turn, result in higher prices for consumers. This development comes at a time when the auto industry is already facing significant headwinds, including supply chain disruptions and shifting consumer demands. For companies involved in copper exploration, such as Aston Bay Holdings Ltd., the tariffs underscore the importance of strategic planning and diversification. Firms that can adapt to changing market conditions and explore alternative sources of copper may be better positioned to navigate the challenges posed by the new tariffs. The situation also highlights the broader implications of trade policies on the auto industry and the economy at large, emphasizing the need for careful consideration of the impacts of such decisions. The announcement has reignited debates about the effectiveness of tariffs as a tool for protecting domestic industries. Critics argue that while tariffs may provide short-term relief for certain sectors, they can also lead to higher costs for businesses and consumers, potentially undermining the competitiveness of the American auto industry on the global stage. As the industry adjusts to this latest development, stakeholders are calling for a balanced approach that considers the long-term implications of trade policies on the economy and the auto sector. title: ESGold Corp. Introduces Innovative Mining Model Focused on Revitalizing Legacy Sites

Unlike speculative exploration, ESGold's approach targets sites abandoned not due to resource depletion but because previous operators lacked the resources to fully exploit their potential. With gold prices reaching historic highs and a surging demand for minerals, ESGold's strategy positions it as a key player in a market attracting renewed Wall Street attention. This model not only reduces the risks associated with mining ventures but also offers a more attractive proposition for investors wary of the industry's cyclical nature and significant capital requirements. ESGold's innovative approach aligns it with other leading mineral miners such as Teck Resources Ltd. (NYSE: TECK) (TSX: TECK), Alamos Gold Inc. (NYSE: AGI) (TSX: AGI), and Pan American Silver Corp. (NYSE: PAAS) (TSX: PAAS), highlighting the potential for significant impact on the mining sector. By leveraging existing assets, ESGold aims to streamline project timelines and enhance profitability, marking a pivotal shift in how mining operations are conducted. This strategy not only underscores the importance of sustainable and efficient mining practices but also reflects a broader trend towards revitalizing underutilized resources. As the demand for minerals continues to grow, ESGold's model could serve as a blueprint for future mining ventures, offering a balanced approach to risk and reward in an industry at the crossroads of innovation and tradition. title: AI's Potential to Create New Employment Opportunities Despite Job Loss Fears
content_encoded_text: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has been met with concerns over widespread job displacement and the erosion of traditional career paths. However, industry experts are now highlighting the potential for AI to not only transform existing roles but also to create new employment opportunities across various sectors. This perspective offers a counter-narrative to the prevailing anxiety about AI's impact on the workforce. AI's influence is undeniable, with its integration into industries ranging from healthcare to finance and beyond. Companies such as Thumzup Media Corp. (NASDAQ: TZUP) are already harnessing AI to innovate and streamline operations. This adoption of AI technologies underscores the transformative potential of AI, not just in automating tasks but in enabling new forms of work and employment. The discourse around AI and employment is evolving, with a growing recognition of the technology's dual role as both a disruptor and a creator of jobs. While certain roles may become obsolete, AI is also expected to generate demand for new skills and professions, particularly in areas related to AI development, maintenance, and ethical oversight. This shift necessitates a reevaluation of workforce development strategies to prepare individuals for the jobs of the future. The implications of AI's impact on employment are profound, affecting not just individual workers but entire economies. The potential for AI to spur job creation highlights the importance of adaptive policies and education systems that can equip workers with the skills needed in an AI-driven economy. As the debate continues, the focus is shifting from fear of job loss to strategies for leveraging AI to enhance employment opportunities and economic growth. title: Safe Pro Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SPAI) Receives Buy Rating and $8 Price Target from Litchfield Hills Research
content_encoded_text: Safe Pro Group Inc. (NASDAQ: SPAI), a technology company specializing in AI-powered drone imagery solutions for defense and security applications, has been initiated with a Buy rating and an $8 price target by Litchfield Hills Research. Analyst Theodore R. O’Neill emphasized the company's patented mine detection technology, which has been proven effective in Ukraine, as a modern solution to traditional demining methods. The SpotlightAI(TM) platform, capable of detecting threats in less than 0.2 seconds, operates through cloud or edge computing and has processed over 1.6 million drone images. The company's diverse operations include Safe Pro AI, which develops its proprietary AI analysis engine; Airborne Response, offering drone-based critical infrastructure inspection and public safety solutions; and Safe-Pro USA, manufacturing body armor and EOD suits. Safe Pro Group serves a range of clients, including Florida Power & Light, Motorola Solutions, and humanitarian organizations in Ukraine. The recent One Big Beautiful Bill Act, allocating $33 billion in federal funding to AI and drone technologies, is expected to further benefit the company. O’Neill's valuation thesis is supported by SPAI's proprietary AI ecosystem, including its SPOTD and SpotlightAI platforms, which provide scalable image processing for defense, infrastructure, and agriculture applications. The $8 target price is based on a discounted earnings model, reflecting anticipated revenue growth, strong insider ownership, and a unique technological advantage. With increasing demand for autonomous surveillance and threat detection tools, Litchfield Hills views SPAI as undervalued and well-positioned for long-term growth in both government and commercial markets. content_encoded_text: Beeline Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BLNE), a technology-driven real estate platform, has recently been initiated at Buy by Ladenburg Thalmann, with a price target set at $4.50. Mattson highlighted the company's AI-enhanced digital mortgage and title platform as a key disruptor in catering to the increasing number of digital-first homebuyers, especially those with non-traditional income sources. A significant growth driver for Beeline is its pioneering cash-out equity product, enabling homeowners to sell a portion of their home equity without incurring debt. This product, supported by a stablecoin structure, has the potential to significantly boost revenue with minimal operational costs. Following its first transaction in June, Beeline anticipates a national rollout by August 2025. Ladenburg projects that this offering could generate $15 million in revenue by 2026, supplementing the company's existing lending, title, and SaaS segments. Ladenburg's forecasts suggest a bright future for Beeline, with revenues expected to more than double from $12.3 million in 2025 to $30.6 million in 2026, and EBITDA turning from a loss of $8.9 million to a positive $7.1 million. The firm sees considerable upside potential based on Beeline's capacity to monetize AI-driven innovations across mortgage origination, equity access, and digital sales. title: Maribel Piza Recognized as 'Person of the Year' for Her Advocacy and Leadership in Immigration and Media
content_encoded_text: Maribel Piza, a distinguished immigration attorney and media entrepreneur, was honored with the 'Personalidad del Año' (Person of the Year) award by the Organización de Periodistas Iberoamericanos (OPI) on July 12, 2025. The ceremony, held at Florida International University’s Graham Center, celebrated Piza's dual role in advocating for immigrant rights and her efforts to amplify Latino voices through media. Since 2006, Piza has dedicated her career to serving the South Florida immigrant community, founding her own immigration law practice with offices in Ft. Lauderdale and West Palm Beach. Her legal work has provided thousands of immigrant families with pathways to stability and safety. Beyond the courtroom, Piza's investment in Noticias Newswire, a Hispanic press release distribution platform, has enabled Latino businesses and organizations to reach broader audiences in both English and Spanish-speaking markets. In her acceptance speech, Piza emphasized her commitment to justice and information equity, stating, 'This award is not only a personal honor but a tribute to every immigrant family whose story I’ve had the privilege to tell, defend, or empower.' Her multifaceted approach to advocacy includes authoring a monthly op-ed column, frequent appearances on local and international broadcasts, and hosting a Spanish-language radio show, 'Encontrando una Luz en su Caso,' which educates the public on immigration policy and legal rights. Piza's leadership extends to her involvement with the Rotary Club of Fort Lauderdale/Cypress Creek, reflecting her dedication to community service. The OPI's 'Personalidad del Año' award recognizes individuals like Piza who have made significant contributions to their communities and serve as influential voices in Latin American and Hispanic public life. title: VERSAGYM™ The Leader In Mobile Fitness, Is Expanding Their Footprint In Florida With Their Newest Launch In Palm Beach County
content_encoded_text: VERSAGYM™ is leading the way in the world of mobile fitness by providing a unique concept for both trainers and clients. They have combined convenience and quality to provide luxury fitness services to a clientele that is committed to their health. After a successful launch in Naples, Florida followed by out-of-state success in Dallas, Texas, they are now excited to be opening in Palm Beach County. VERSAGYM™ was created with the intention of defeating excuses surrounding people's health, and that's exactly what they've done. No need to drive to an over-crowded, messy fitness center any more, the folks at VERSAGYM™ have developed a far better solution. VERSAGYM™ launched as an outdoor fitness concept prior to the height of the COVID-19 pandemic as a safe and more convenient alternative to public gyms. Transported to clients’ driveways, backyards, garages, or businesses in a 6-foot-wide, 12-foot-long, 5,000+pound luxury trailer; the VERSAGYM™ expands in less than 15 minutes into a multi-station fitness center designed for one-on-one training sessions or group classes for up to 12 people. Each unit is accompanied by a highly-trained certified personal trainer who never has to enter a client’s home, providing additional privacy and safety. VERSAGYM™ keeps things simple with their services provided. They market just one private residence training package which includes: 3 1-hour sessions per week, a certified personal trainer, nutrition plans, and more. Their fee for this package covers an entire household, allowing a spouse, or even the whole family to get involved and starts at a price of $1,000 per month. "Nutrition is just as important, if not more than the workout itself." Founder Carlos Garcia said, "All of our trainers work within your specific needs and restrictions to not only create a custom-tailored workout plan, but also a custom nutrition plan." VERSAGYM™ is 5-star rated on google with over 50+ reviews. According to a satisfied customer, “This is such a convenient way to get a great workout in, even with my busy schedule! They can come to you if you don’t feel comfortable leaving your home. Versa gym has all the equipment you need for a great workout and weight training... I love it!” "Kyle Claypoole, a Palm Beach resident whose family has resided there for over 50+ years, is excited to introduce the VERSAGYM™ brand to his neighbors, clients, and all those living in the nearby areas. “VERSAGYM™ is the future of fitness on this coast.” Kyle said, “Those unattainable goals have never been easier to reach. With our amazing custom rigs, we are able to provide the highest quality personal training money can buy. I’m really excited about bringing this new concept to my community and being able to help others change their lives for the better. My goal is to expand this concept and have a VERSAGYM™ in every driveway.” Carlos Garcia, the CEO and founder of VERSAGYM™, is equally as excited for Claypooles' launch. "Kyle’s work ethic and passion for helping others through health & fitness is going to help him distinguish himself in the Palm Beach fitness community." Garcia said, "It's an honor for us to be able to continue the expansion of VERSAGYM™ and extend the reach of our unique services. Kyle embodies every quality we look for in a VERSAGYM™ business owner, and we look forward to watching him grow the business on the other coast." For booking or questions in Palm Beach County, please contact Kyle Claypoole directly.
